las dang brku ba dang srog bcad pa dang gang yang gzhan sdig pa'i las rnams bya ba dang / mgo bkrus na ku co 'byung ba dang / khrus byas na ma dang pha skrag pa dang / chos gos gyon na sdug pa la khrag 'dzag pa mthong ba dang / chos gos de mi 'chang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te gyon na shākya rnams kyi mdun du bgo bar bya'o—/ /tshor ba'i nyi ma la bya ba'i las rnams ni yid dang mthun pa dang yid dga' bar bya ba dang / tshong dang bran bcang ba dang nor dang zhi ba dang chu la brgal bar bya ba dang / mgo bkrus na 'jigs pa dang khrus byas na yid sdug bsngal ba dang / gos sar pa bgos na ci ltar byed pa de ltar 'gyur te/grogs po rnams kyi mdun du gos bgo bar bya'o/ /sred pa'i nyi ma la bya ba'i las rnams ni/ nor dang 'bru dang rdzas bsags par bya ba rnams ma thogs shing myur ba dang / mgo bkrus na skra 'bye ba dang / khrus byas na 'jigs pa che ba dang / chos gos byas na rtag du mgu bar 'gyur te/ nyi ma de la gos bgo bar mi bya'o/ /len pa'i nyi ma la bya ba'i las rnams ni/ nor dang zhi ba dang bya ba myur ba dang / slob dpon du gnas par bya ba dang / sma ra dang sen mo'i las dang pho nya mngag pa dang / sman bya ba dang / gzhan gyi thud med la bgrod par bya'o/ /mgo bkrus na 'byer bar 'gyur ba dang khrus byas na nor rnyed pa dang chos gos byas na thung bar 'gyur te de la blta bar mi bya'o/ /srid pa'i nyi ma la bya ba'i las rnams ni/ smad 'tshong ma dang 'grogs pa dang grogs po bya ba dang las thams cad 'grub pa dang smrang spang bar bya ba dang mgo bkrus na bza' ba dang btung ba'i dga' ston dang khrus byas na bzang ba dang gos gsar pa bgos na bzang por 'gyur ba dang nyi ma de la gos bgo bar bya'o/ /114—957

ba ngu ba brtag ①pa rdzogs so// //ma rig pa'i nyi ma la mgrin pa nas sgra grag na/ byang phyogs nas mgron po 'ga' zhig 'gri ba 'ong ngo / /'du byed kyi nyi ma la sgra grag na bya ba cung zad 'byung ngo / /rnam par shes pa'i nyi ma la sgra grag na bzang ngo / /ming dang gzugs kyi nyi ma la sgra grag na snyan pa thos so/ /skye mched drug gi nyi ma la sgra grag na ring po nas 'dri ba 'ong ngo / /reg pa'i nyi ma la grag na ku co 'ong ngo / /tshor ba'i nyi ma la grag na bzang ngo / /sred pa'i nyi ma la grag na 'dod pa skye'o/ /len pa'i nyi ma la grag na shi ba thos so/ /srid pa'i nyi ma la grag na gos rnyed do//skye ba'i nyi ma la grag na 'dri bar byed pa 'ong ngo / /rga shi'i nyi ma la grag na bzang ngo / /mgrin pa'i sgra brtag pa rdzogs so// //ma rig pa'i nyi ma la rkan 'gul na mgron po gces pa 'ong ngo 'du byed kyi nyi ma la rkan 'gul na khyim gyi dpon po bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa'i nyi ma la 'gul na mgron bo 'ong ngo / /ming dang gzugs kyi nyi ma la 'gul na gos rnyed do/ /skye mched drug gi nyi ma la 'gul na sems khral 'ong ngo / /reg pa'i nyi ma la 'gul na bde ba'i thabs 'byung ngo / /tshor ba'i nyi ma la 'gul na 'jigs shing skrag go/ /sred pa'i nyi ma la 'gul na khyim skor ba 'ong ngo / /len pa'i nyi ma la 'gul na 'dir 'ga' zhig 'chi'o/ /srid pa'i nyi ma la 'gul na mgron po 'ong ngo / /skye ba'i nyi ma la 'gul na rkun ma 'ong ngo / /rga shi'i nyi ma la 'gul na khyim la bzang ngo / /rkan 'gul ba 114—965

so—/ /rga shi'i nyi ma la byud na mya ngan dang mgu ba 'ong ngo / /rkang pa dzred pa brtag pa rdzogs so// //ma rig pa'i nyi ma la rkang pa'i sgra grag na gter chen po rnyed pa'am mgron po myur du 'ong ngo / /khyi za na ring po nas 'ga' zhig 'ong ngo / /gos tshig ①na don nyams par 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na rtsod pa chen po 'byung ngo / /bya rog skad sgog na rigs can 'dri ba 'ong ngo / /gos la snum 'bags na 'ga' zhig 'chi ba thos so/ /sa 'gul na rgyal po nus pa dang ldan no/ /'du byed kyi nyi ma la rkang pa'i sgra grag na don med pa gnyis 'byung ngo / /khye za na rgyal po'i dgos pa cung zad skye'o/ /bya rog skad sgog na cung zad snyan pa thos pa dang / khrag mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gos tshig na bzang por 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na khyem 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gos la snum 'bag na gos rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /sa g.yos na thab mo dang mu ge dang pha rol gyi dmag 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par shes pa'i nyi ma la rkang pa'i sgra grag na gzhan mu stegs 'ong ngo / /khye za na rkun ma 'ong ba dang rdzas rnyed do/ /bya rog skad sgog na ku co 'byung ngo / /gos tshig na nor cung zad rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na stor ba rnyed do/ /gos la sgrum 'bags na ma dang pha skrag go/ /sa g.yos na rgyal po gcig la gcig thab mo'i don du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ming dang gzugs kyi nyi ma la rkang pa'i sgra grag na grog po 'ong ngo / /khyi za na der 'ga' zhig 'chi'o/ /bya rog skad sgog na sdug pa dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na cung zad brlag pa dang rnyed pa gnyis 'byung ngo / /gos 114—967

tshig na bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /gos la snum 'bags na ma dang pha cher dran par 'gyur ro/ /sa rab tu g.yos na 'jig rten gyi rkun ma zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /skye mched drug gi nyi ma la rkang pa nas sgra grag na ring po nas 'ga' zhig 'ong ba'am khyim gyi gtso bo la bzang bar 'gyur ro/ /khyi za na ku co 'byung ngo / /bya rog skad sgrog na kha cig 'ongs nas 'byor bar byed do/ /gos tshig na ku co dang nor rnyed do/ /byi bas gos zos na me'am chu'am 'ga' zhig 'chi bar 'gyur ro//gos la sdum 'bag skye/na skrag go/ /sa g.yos na rgan pa rnams 'chi bar 'gyur ro / /reg pa'i nyi ma la rkang pa nas sgra grag na sgra snyan pa thos so/ /khye za na rkun ma 'ong ngo / /bya rog skad sgog na skrag rngupar 'gyur ro/ /gos tshig na 'ga' zhig 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na nor rnyed do/ /gos la snum 'bags na gnyen rnams la bzang ngo / /sa g.yos na ku co dang rtsod pa 'byung ngo / /tshor ba'i nyi ma la rkang pa nas sgra grag na don dang don med pa gnyis dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /khye za na rtsod pa'am ku co 'byung bar 'gyur ro//bya rog skad sgrog na mgron chen po 'ong ngo / /gos tshig na bya ba cung zad skye bar 'gyur ro/ /byi bas gos zos na gos de gos 1la gtso bo blta bar byas na bka' drin rtsol bar 'gyur ro/ /gos la snum 'bags na yid mi bde bar 'gyur ro/ /sa g.yos na pho nya 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /sred pa'i nyi ma la rkang pa'i sgra grag na nor rnyed do/ /khye za na rtsod pa chen po 'byung ngo / /bya rog skad sgog na bu'i sgra thos so/ /gos tshig na na ba dang gos rnyed do/ /byi bas gos zos na der 'ga' zhig 'chi'o/ /gos la snum gos na dpal rnyed do/ /sa g.yos na shar phyogs su dgra ldang ngo / /lho phyogs su 'chi'o/ /nub phyogs 114—968

bsdur mchan/949 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈snar 〉〉pa rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i 'khor lo zhes bya ba bzhugs / zhes 'khod/ chos tshan 'di〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa mi bzhugs pas 〈〈pe 〉〉pa gzhi bzung nas 〈〈snar 〉〉dang dpe bsdur byas yod/96༷ ① 〈〈snar 〉torajig961 ①〈〈snar 〉〉〉nga /963 ①〈〈snar 〉〉bos/964 ①〈〈snar 〉〉sted/965 ①〈〈snar 〉〉〉ge/966 ①〈〈snar 〉〉rtogs/967 ①〈〈snar 〉〉zags/968 ① 〈〈snar 〉torabags/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉bskrag khya〈〈snar 〉〉〉de/97༷ ①〈〈snar 〉〉 pa'i/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (12)114wa 972

256na༄ga /thub pa chen po drang srong gar gas ltas kyi rjam pa bstan pa bzhugs/①༄4/ /thub pa chen po drang srong gar gas ltas kyi rnam pa bstan pa zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gza' skar rig pa'i pha rol phyin/ /thub pa'i tshogs mchog gar ga la/ /bha gu ①ris ni phyag 'tshal te/ /thal mo sbyar nas yongs su zhus/ /lha yi mig ldan dka' thub che//skal ldan rgya mtsho che lta bu/ /shes rab mchog gis rab rtogs ④pa'i/ /rigs bupa de ni thob ④par 'tshal/ /yul gyis ⑥dngos dang dngos med dang / /bstan dang 'bras bu grub pa dang / /mi rnams kyi ni pham rgyal dang / /sprin byi kha dog gzugs rnams dang / /de bzhin nyi ma zla ba dang / /lha yul bar snang sa bla yi⑦/ /ltas su byung ba'i mtshan ma dang / /'phral gyi char pa'i mtshan ma dang / /dus mtshan ④chags dang dge mi dge/ /nyi zla dag gi nyin 'khor nas⑨/ /skar mda' lhung dang gnam grum ⑩dang / /dri za yi ni grong khyer dang / /sa 114—976

nang dang 'thab pa dag gis 'tshe ①bar yang 'gyur②/ rgyal po yang 'tshe ①zhing /mu ge dang / mi ngas dag gi ④tshogs chen por 'gyur ro/ /mi rnams kyang nye du phu nu dag dang mi mthun zhing 'gal bar ⑤'gyur ro/ /mi'i bu rnams mngal du yang 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang nyi ma 'od zer dang bral zhing mi 0long bu ⑦lta bur snang na/ de yang nges par rgyal po 'jigs ⑧par rig par bya'o/ /yang na nyi ma nam mkha' la khrag gi 'od can lta bu snang ba ⑨de'i tshe rgyal po rnams dang /de la brten pa rnams dang / yul rnams dang / de bzhin du dbang po rnams dang ⑩/ phan tshun du gsod par 'gyur ro/ /⑪de'i tshe skye bo thams cad chos dang mi mthun par phyin ci log par ⑫spyod pa'i ltas yin no/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma 'char ba na/ gzhu ltar rab tu sgu ⑫bar snang zhing / sprin dmar dag gis khebs na/ de'i tshe pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dag 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma 'char ba na/ gzugs ④brnyan dag snang ba de'i tshe na 'jigs pa chen po 'ong bar bstan (geto/ / de dag ⑫gi tshe nyi ma 'char ba dang / nub pa kho na de'i kṛrtetshe nyi ma mgo bcad pa lta bu'i sprin gyis khebs pa de'i ()tshe na/yul du 'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /yang nyi ma 'char ba ⑩nub pa kho na'i tshe nyi ma 'khyams 0pa dang / skan mda' rtsang ⑪ba dang / sa g.yo bar gyur pa de'i tshe ⑫rgyal po gsod par 'gyur ro/ /yang gal te nyi ma ⑫gzugs bu gu can dang / bong ④bu dang / khrag lta bu'i ⑫nyi ma phyed dus gsal ⑫bar snang na/ mi'i bdag po mtha' dag 'tshe ⑩ba dang / nad dang /mu ge dag ldang bas 3skye bo bas pa'i dus su 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma ⑥zla ba dag 'khyams zhing dzu dkyil 'khor tha dad du chud la/ rtsub par gyur pa de'i tshe 114—978

ni the tshom med par dmag 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du nyi ma dang zla ba dag 'khyams ①pa dang / dkyil 'khor mtha' bdag khrum yin pa dang / rtsub cing rnam par gzhag sdepa dang / nyams par gyur pa de'i tshe 'char ba dumed par 'gyur zhing / mu ge dang mi ngas dag 'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /gang du nyi ma dang zla ba dag rma bya'i mgrin pa lta bu 'khyams rjopar gyur pa de'i tshe na des dhimu ge 'byung bar bstan ⑦to/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma sprin gyi kha dog lta bu dang /'ja' 'dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor chung bar gyur pa de'i tshe na 'phral ⑧'phral du char pa 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma dang ⑨/ zla ba dang ()/gza' rnam ⑪gsum 'gal bar gyur pa ni zhag gsum tshun chad char pa ⑫'bab pa dang / zla ba gsum tshun chad du ⑫'jigs pa chen po ⑫'byung bar rig par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe zla ba chu la ⑫zla brnyan dag snang bar 'gyur na yang ⑩zhag gsum tshun chad char pa 'bab pa dang / zla ba gcig la ⑩'jigs pa chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro⑫/ /gang gi tshe zla ba 'khyams shing ngan ⑪du nub par rab tu snang na⑩/gza' rnams kyi yang zil gyis non par 'gyur ro⑪/ /de bzhin du snang ba chung bar gyur pa de'i tshe na⑪/ dmag dpon rnams 'chi bar 'gyur la/ de bzhin du yul de ⑫yang lo nyes dang / mu ge dang / mi ngas pa ⑫dag kyang 'byung /rgyal po yang 'tshe ⑫bar 'gyur ba dang / chom rkun pa dag kyang brgyal ⑩bar 'gyur ba'i ltas su bstan to/ /yang zla ba'i gzugs 'khyams pa dang ()/gza' rnams phan tshun du mtho ⑫zhing zhum par yang gyur pa de ⑥ni/ lus can rnams shin tu mnar ⑩bar 'gyur bar bstan to/ / zla ba'i gzugs 'khyams pa na/⑩ gang gi tshe⑫/ zla ba khrag gi mdog lta bu'i kha dog tu gyur pa de'i 114—979

tshe na ①dmag khrag gi 'dam rdzab can 'byung bar ④'gyur ro/ /nyi zla'i ltas kyi ①le'u ste dang po'o// //gza' skar gyi ltas la drang srong chen po gar ga la legs ldan phyogs kyi skyong ba dag ji ltar gnas pa dang / gza' dang rgyu skar dag gi che chung dang / ji ltar rgyu ba dang / skar ma dag gang nas rjo'abyung zhing ji ltar rtsang ba dang /rnam par rgyu ba dag skyes bu dam pa tshangs pa lta bu'i rjogazi brjid can gyis bdag la bstan du gsol zhes nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa'i slob ma bha gu ris kun du dris pa dang / rig pa'i gnas thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pas bshad pa/phyogs skyong dag ni bzhi ste/ rang gi phyogs la yang dag par brten pa dag go/ /gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyi steng na sme bdun dag gnas shing / de dag gi 'og na ni spen pa dag gnas so/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni dpag tshad brgya rjostong du brjod do/ / zla ba ④ni bcu drug tu brjod do/ /sgra gcan 'dzin ni nyis 'gyur ro/ /snar ma dang / gro bzhin dang / rgyal dang / mgo dang /byi bzhin ⑧dang / nag pa dang / sa ri dang / sa ga dang / lag dang /spyon dang / snrubs dang / nab ⑨so dag ste/ rgyu skar bcu gnyis pa ⑩dag gi dkyil 'khor ni dpag tshad gnyis gnyis so/ /de bzhin du skar ma phra mo gzhan dag gi tshad du rgyang grags tsam mo/ /de dag gi ⑫grangs ni dung phyur phrag gnyis dang / bye ba phrag brgyad dang sa ya phrag lngar bshad de/ rgyu skar gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas pa dag yin no/ /rgyu skar me bzhi dang / nag pa dang /sa ri dang / sa ga dang /⑫ lag dang / de bzhin du mgo dang / nab ⑫114—980

bslad cing phan tshun thob par 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyu skar sa ga dang / smin drug dang / rgyal dang / khrums stod dang / bha ga'i lha gang yin pa 'di dang / mchu dang / gshin rje'i lha gang yin pa 'di dag dbang ba'i dus su sa g.yos pa'am/ gnam grum pa 'byung ①bar gyur na me'i phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor la bab pa'i shugs kyis ①gnod pa 'byung bar rig par bya ste/ mkhris dzeepa'i rigs las gyur pa'i gnod pas skye dgu shin tu gzir ba dang / bud med rnams la khrag nad 'byung ba dang / ba dang ma he zho skam pa dang / bsod nams bya bar brtsams dhishing bsam pa thams cad kyang 'grub ⑤par mi 'gyur la/sems can rnams la yams dhind 'byung ba dang / de bzhin du nad dang /rgyal po las kyang gyur pa 'byung ba dang / skye dgu rnams kyang phan tshun dga' ba dag byed nas mi mthun par yang 'gyur zhing nyin mtshan du phyogs rnams su gnas me zhi bar yang mi 'gyur/ sprin yang char pa 'bebs par mi 'gyur/de bzhin du 'dod 'jo dag kyang 'o ma med par 'gyur ba dang / shing ljon pa'i ⑦rigs dang / lcug ma dag kyang me tog dang / 'bras bu nyung ba dang /chu'i gnas khron pa dang / rdzing dang / lteng ka la sogs pa yang skam par 'gyur zhing / mu ge dang nad kyis nyen pa 'byung ba dang / yul 'khrug par yang 'gyur/⑧ chom rkun kyi 'jig rten rnams kyi mthu dang / ri dwags rnams kyang 'dren par 'gyur/ sha sbrang dang / sbrang bu mchu rings ⑨rnams dang /de bzhin du rigs ngan gye rigs dag kyang 'phel bar 'gyur te/ de ltar me'i phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor du chos lugs de rnams 'byung bar shes par bya'o/ /khrums smad dang / chu lha dang / de bzhin du nam gru dang / bden bral gyi 114—982

gyur pa dang / gzhan yang glo bur du byung ba gzhan ji ltar 'byung ba yang der ni bstan bcos rig pa'i thub pa rnams kyis mi dge ba med par bstan te/ lo tog dag shin tu phun sum tshogs pa dang / lo legs pa dang / chom rkun med pa dang / bram ze rnams kyi sbyin sreg dang / mchod sbyin gyi bya ba thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhing / rig ①par byed pa'i rgyal po thams cad kyang sa srung bar byed par 'gyur ba dang / rigs kyang rang gi chos la gzhol zhing /sems chos la mngon par dga' ba dang / dus ji lta ba bzhin du char chu 'bab pa dang / shing rnams me tog dang / 'bras bu smin par byed pa dang / skye bo mtha' dag rab tu dga' ba dang / lhags pa rnams phan tshun dga' bar 'gyur zhing / sprin rnams don med par ma ②yin te/ sa gzhir ①char pa legs par 'bab par 'gyur ba dang / mi rnams kyi bya ba ji ltar brtsams pa rnams kyang phal cher grub dupar 'gyur zhing lus can rnams la yang gnod pa byed pa ⑤rnams dang / grog sbur rnams dang / sbrul dang / byi ba la sogs pa dang / de bzhin du yams kyi nad rnams dang / ba la sogs pa rnams kyang yang dag par 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gzhan du na dbang po chen po'i dkyil 'khor dbang bar gyur na chu dang / me dang / rlung las gyur pa bad kan dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa'i nad ⑥rnams dang / de bzhin du rlung las gyur pa rnams 'byung ste/ de dag ni gzhan du ma yin no zhes pa ⑦bstan torka/ /gza' rnams kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //skar mda'i ltas la skar mda' 'di dag ni de dag ni ⑧mtshan ma bstan 114—984

ma shar ba dang ①nub pa kho na'i tshe nyi ma'i zur nas 'gro bar gyur na de ni skye bo zad par 'gyur ba'i nad dang / mtshon ④la sogs pa 'byung bar rig par bya'o//yang sprin gyi gzugs 'gog pa can lta bur gyur cig① /rdul gyi tshogs 'dren par byed pa'i rlung drag po dang bcas pa 'byung rjob ni rgyal po dang skye bo phal pa ⑤dag 'chi ba dang / yul 'khor dang / dgon pa na gnas pa dag la gnod par bstan to/ /nam mkha' la sprin med par 'brug zer ba rjodang / 'brug zer la char med pa'i sprin ni gnod pa 'byung ba'i sprin yin no/ /'od glog dang 'ja' rlung gi ltas la gang gi tshe nyi ma'i drung lho phyogs ngos nas glog 'byung bar 'gyur la/ de'i dus su rgyal po'i pho brang dang / rta babs dang / glang po che dang / rta'i byes kyi khang steng dang / rgyal po'i lam dang / khrom lam gyi bzhi mdo dang / grong khyer gyi sgo dang / shing chen po rnams la thog dang ser ba 'bab pa'am/ skar mda' dag kyang lhung bar gyur ⑦na der lo gcig tshun chad du 'jig rten kun du zad par 'gyur bar rig par bya zhing / yul der rgyal po gzhan 'ong bar yang the tshom med do/ /nyi ma la 'byung ba'i glog de nyid rgyal po'i rta babs dang / pho brang gi sgor bab na rgyal po dang / de la brten pa dag kyang ④'chi bar 'gyur⑨/ rta byes dang glang po che'i byes su bab na de'i srung ma nges par 'jigs ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /ra bar babs ⑪na dmag mi'i gtso bo dag 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe me'i phyogs nas glog 'od me lta bu 'byung ba ni nad rnams kyis 'khrug pa dang / rlung drag pos ⑫gnod pa 'byung ba'i ltas yin no/ /bden bral gyi phyogs nas glog 'byung bar byed pa de'i tshe ni rlung dal ba 'byung bar byed cing nad kyis 'jig rten zad par yang 'gyur ro/ /114—990

de'i tshe dbang pos zla ba bzhin du rtag tu char 'bebs shing 'bru la sogs pa lo tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / rgyal po rang gi chos kho nas ①gnas shing chos dang ldan pa dang / skye dgu thams cad chos la dga' zhing phan tshun phan par 'dod pa la dga' rangs pa dang / ba dang bzhon charnams kyang 'o ma mang bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs su dbyar zla ba ①'bring po nya ba'i tshe glog dang / de bzhin du rlung 'byung dubar gyur cing sprin sgra byung bar yang gyur pa de'i tshe ni chu'i char chen po 'bab par 'gyur ba dang / bde ba dang / nad med pa dang / lo legs pa dang / lo tog phun sum tshogs pa dang / skye dgu rnams nad med cing phan tshun byams pas rnam par 'byel pa can du 'gyur ba dang / rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba dang / de bzhin du yams kyi nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur zhing / sa las skye ba dhithams cad kyi me tog dang / 'bras bu la sogs pa rjo'abyung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbyar ka 'brug gi sgra drag ⑦tu yang 'byung na sgra brnyan gyis nyams pa'i sgra gnam lta bu dang bcas pa grag pa der ni lus can rnams la shin tu dman par 'gyur bar bstan pa'o/ / so ga'i ④dus su phyogs brgyad nas 'brug glog dang rlung la sogs pa ldang ba'i ltas kyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //bar snang las 'byung ⑨ba'i ltas la ⑩gang gi tshe skar mda'i char pa 'bab pa dang / khrag gi char pa dang / mar dang / 'bru mar dang / zhag gi char pa bab na rgyal po dang bcas pa'i grong khyer 'jig par 'gyur ro/ / yang grong khyer ram/thokye khyem tho)du sol ba'i char pa 'bab cing / phub ma dang /114——994

tha dad pa'i sgra byung na sdug bsngal bar grags ①pa de'i tshe ni ②rang gi yul 'khor du bcas ①pa'i rgyal po 'chi bar 'gyur/ nad dang / mu ge dang / gnod par yang 'gyur zhing / 'jig rten yang zad par 'gyur/ ④rgyal srid ngan pas kyang brlag pa dang / bu smad dang yang 'bral ⑤bar 'gyur ro/ /bar snang las byung ba'i ltas kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //phyi rol 'byung ba chen po'i ltas la gang gi tshe shing ljon pa dang / gel pa dag las dus dang mi ldan par 'bras bu 'byung dhin rgyal po'i yul phyogs su gtogs pa gsod par 'gyur ro/ /yang gang gi tshe mchod sbyin gyi shing dang /lha rten byas pa dang / ka ba ⑦dang / gzugs la sogs pa shing skam po dag las lo ma skye bar rtsol ba ni rgyal po 'chi ba'i ltas dang / de bzhin du skye bo dag 'khrug pa'i ltas su bstan to/ /yang yul dang / grong dang / grong khyer gang dag tu shing dang / shing ljon pa dag las me tog dang / 'bras bu phyin ci log tu skye bar ④gyur na de ni bdag po 'chi ba'i rtags yin no/ /gang gi tshe snga dro'i dus su shing dang mi'i grib ma ⑨shar phyogs su gnas par gyur pa dang /phyi dro yang mi dang shing gi grib ma nub phyogs su gnas par gyur na rgyal po 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /chu zab mo dang / khron pa dang / rdzing dang / mtsho la sogs pa ⑩srog chags chu na rgyu ba rnams gang du skam spyopa der ni ring por ⑫mi thogs par skye bo 'jigs par 'gyur zhes bstan to/ /rlung med par glo bur du khron pa dang / rdzing rnams kyi chu dag kun 'khrug par 'gyur ⑫ba gang yin pa der ni rgyal po dang / yul dang yul 'khor la mi dge bar bstan to/ /gang 114—997

du rlung med par glo bur du grong gi nye 'khor du 'jug pa'i shing ljon pa a shwad tha dang pa ta la la ①sogs pa rtsa ba zugs pa rtsa ba ②'gyel bar gyur na grong de 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /yang rlung ma langs par yang thog rtsang ①ba dang /lus mi snang bar tshig mi snyan pa zer ba dang / sha za mo'i glu sgra rjo'abyung ba ni 'phral du rgyal po la 'jigs pa 'ong bar bstan to/ /gal te glo bur du gdugs kyi shing dang / khri dang / khri'u dang / khang pa'i srog rten gyi shing dang /de lta bu'i rnam pa dag gi shing rdo chag grums su gyur pas ⑤ni de dag gi bdag po dhi'achi bar ston to/ /yang rgyal po nges par ⑦'chi bar gyur pa'i ⑧tshe ni rlung dri nga ba dang / zas sungs ⑨pa lta bu'i dri dang / khyi dang / bya dang / bye la dang / bong bu la sogs pa'i dri dang / de bzhin du phye ma lta bu'i dri 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyal po 'chi ba'i tshe ni rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo dang / rta babs dang / sgo gang dag tu ser ba 'bab cing me med par yang me mdag rtsang ⑩bar 'gyur ro/ /rtse ⑪mo dang / rol mo'i sgra mi snyan pa dang / mtshon rnam pa sna tshogs mi mdzes par gyur pa ni yul 'khor dag tu 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i ltas yin no/ /gang du mtshon rnams 'gul ba dang / ral gri shubs dang bral bar gyur pa dang / gzhu ma bdungs pa bdungs ⑫par gyur na de ni nges par dmag mi bzad pa 'byung ⑫bar ston to/ /gang gi tshe phyogs thams cad du ni ⑫nyin mo'am/ mtshan mo yang rung ste/ nags kyi me snang bar gyur pa de ni lo nyes pa dang / skye bo ngas ⑫par 'gyur ro/ /nyin mo'am/ yang na mtshan mo yang rung ste/ nam mkha' sprin gyis kun du khebs pa na phyogs tsha bar gyur pa de'i tshe ni rgyal po gsod par 'gyur ro/ /gal te dgun ni dro bar gyur 114—998

ga dang / rang gi phyogs nas rlung gis bskyod par 'gyur ba ①de'i tshe ni zhag bdun bdun du char pa 'bab par rig par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe shar ram byang nas ④kha ba 'bab cing rlung 'byung la phyogs dud ka ④dang / sngo bsangs dhisu byed pa de'i tshe ni chu cher 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe nyi ma shar ba'am/dus tshigs kyi chags pa 'byung bar char pa'i thigs pa 'bab pa de'i tshe ni nges par char mo che (9'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te yang nyi ma shar ba'i tshe sbal pas skad ran cing snyan pa 'byung ( kyeb de'i tshe char mo che 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /mi gzhan zhig lag na gdugs thogs nas char pa'i mtshan ma dris ⑦sam khyim 'gengs bzhin du dris na ④de'i tshe rtag tu char pa ⑨'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gos gsher bas kyang dris na char pa'i rgyu yin te/ de la mod kho nar char du 'bab par 'gyur ba the tshom med do/ /chu'i phyogs su 'dug nas dris kyang rung ste / char pa 'bab par blta bar bya'o/ /byi la dang / sre mong dang /sbrul rnams dang / gang yang gzhan dag tu gan du gnas pa dag gal te drod ⑩mi mthun par rgyug par byed na mod la char ⑩'bab par ston pa yin no/ /byis pa lus 'jim pas byugs pa dang / mgo me tog phreng bas dkris pa gang na 'dug pa dar 7ni/ 'phral du char pa mngon par 'bab par byed do/ /lus rdul kyis byugs pa'i byis pa dag rdul gyis rtse bar byed pa dang / yur ba 'gengs par byed na phral 7du char pa 'bab pa'i rgyu yin te/ char pa 'bab pa'i mtshan nyid la mkhas pa rnams kyis de ni 'phral du char pa 'bab par bshad pa yin no/ /gang gi tshe sprin kyang med/ kha ba yang med par rlung shin tu bsel ba dag 'byung zhing / lus can grang bar byed pa ni der 'phral du nges 174byed1004

mi ston pa ltar snang ba de dag kyang 'dir thub pa lha'i mig can de dag gis bstan pa bzhin nges pa can du gzung bar bya'o/ /gang dag kha cig tu dngos po mi srid pa lta bu zhig tu brgya la snang na/ der yon tan zhig na dge zhing bzang ba dang / phyin ci log cig na'ang mi dge ba'i don du rig par bya'o/ /de ltar mi dge bar gyur pa'i mtshan ma de dag ni gnyen po so sor brten pa dag gis zlog par 'gyur srid de/ de dag kyang gang zhe na/ bsod nams la ①rab tu gnas pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / rnam par dag pa la rten ②pa dag dang / sbyin sreg dang / bzlas brjod la brtson par bya ba dang /ser sna bcom pa dang / lha dang bram ze dag la mchod pa dang / zhi ba dang rgyas pa'i bzlas brjod dang / sbyin sreg gi cho ga bya ba dang / bsam pa dri ma med pas nor rab tu sbyin pa dag gi mtshan ma ngan pa dzeedag gis mi tshugs shing rnam par 'jig par byed do/ /gal te gnyen po byed pa'i stobs dag gis kun du zlog ④par gyur na yang rgyal po 'chi ba las rab tu bcad de tshe nur/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / yul 'khor de dag rgyug cing rnam par 'jig pa yang yun ring du gnas pa tsam du 'gyur bar bstan to/ /thub pa'i tshogs mchog gar ga la/ / bha ra dhwa dza ⑤go ta mas/ /lha yul bar snang sa bla rjodang / /gza' skar srog chags rnams kyi ltas/ /sa bdag mi yi rgyal po dang / /grong dang yul 'khor gnas pa la/ /gnod par gyur pa'i ltas 'byung ⑦la/ /cho ga gang dang gang dag gis/ /zhu bar 'gyur ba zhus pa las/ /thub pa gar gas lung bstan pa/ /phan par 'gyur ba'i cho ga gang / /go ta mas ⑧nyan par gyis/ /dang por ⑨sbyin pa gtang ⑩bya ste/ /lha dang bram ze mngon ⑪mchod na/ /sbyin 114—1011

tshogs bstan pa zhes bya ba'i ltas ji snyed pa rdzogs so// //ārya byā stika ra ṇa'i nang nas 'byung ba gza' dang rgyu skar gyi ②rang bzhin bshad pa rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni 'di lta ste/ smin drug dang / snar ma dang /mgo dang / lag dang / nab ①so dang / rgyal dang / skag dang / mchu dang / gre dang / dbo dang / me bzhi dang / nag pa dang / sa ri dang /sa ga dang / lha mtshams dang / spyon dang / snrubs dang / chu stod dang /chu smad dang / bye bzhin rjodang / gro bzhin ⑤dang / mon gre dang / mon gru dang / khrums stod dang / khrums smad dang / nam gru dang / tha skar dang / bra nye dang / 'di rnams ni dhirgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /de la rgyu skar ni du/ dbyibs ni ji snyed yod/ yud tsam dang ldan pa ji snyed/ zas ni ci/ rus ni ci/ lha rnams ni gang / kye bram ze padma'i snying po can smin drug ni skar ma drug ste/ dbyibs ni spu gri lta bu'o/ /yud tsam sum cu dang ldan pa'i ⑦cha drug dang bcas pa'o/ /⑧zas ni zho'o/ /lha ni me lha'o/ /rus ni rje'u rigs kyi rgyud do/ /rgyu skar snar ma ni skar ma lnga ste/ dbyebs ni shing rta ⑨lta bu'o/ /yud tsam ni ⑩bzhi bcu rtsa ⑪lnga dang ldan pa'i cha ⑫bdun dang bcas pa'o/ / kha zas ⑫ni zho dang sbrang rtsir sbyar ba'o/ / lha ni skye dgu'i bdag po'o/ /(sngerus ni go ta ma'o/ /rgyu skar mgo ni skar ma gsum ste/dbyibs ni ri dwags kyi mgo lta bu'o/ /yud tsam ni sum cu dang ldan pa'i cha dang bcas pa'o/ /zas ni ri dwags kyi sha'o/ /lha ni zla ba'o/ /rus ni bha ra dhwa dza'/ /rgyu skar lag ni skar ma gcig ste/ dbyibs ni sog le lta bu'o/ /114—1013

shar phyogs kyi gling du ①ma ta ra ti ba dang / mon yul ka ma ru ba dang / shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas pa ⑧dang / gser gyi gling na gnas pa dang /chu bo gang bā'i rgya mtsho'i snegating du 'bab pa dang / 'gram na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar skag gi nyi ma la sa g.yos na klu rnams dang / sbrul rnams dang / sdig sbrul rnams dang / grog ma rnams dang /grog ma mang po rnams dang ④/ srin bu sna tshogs dang / khye dang / rmig pa gcig pa rnams dang / dug rnams dang / dug sbyor zhing byed pa'i mi rnams dang / sems can gang dag ri khrod na gnas pa rnams dang / yul mtha' 'khob na rku 'phrog byed cing 'joms pa'i mi rnams dang / zol pa dang /rku thabs kyis 'thab mo 'gyed pa'i mi rnams dang / sdig pa'i las la dga' ba'i mi rnams dang / mi blun po rnams dang / mi ngan pa dang / tshig ngan pa smra ba rnams dang / yul to sa la dang / yul ko sa la ⑤dang / grong khyer kaspyo dudang / yul ling ga ⑦dang / yul an dra dang / yul an dra'i byang phyogs dang / yul ya ma'i grong rdal ⑧nyams dga' ⑨dang / ri byen dha dang / ri byen dha ⑩byang phyogs kyi ⑪ngos dang / ri de'i drung dang / rtse mo dang / srangs sa ⑫na gsum pa'i skye bo rnams la gnod pa drag po nad dang /me dang / mi ngas dang / than chen dang / ser ba dang /⑫ yang dang yang mtshon kar ⑫'gyed pas yul de phyogs na mya ngan byed cing 'gro ste/ sa g.yo bas gzi brjid nyams nas gnod pa de lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar mchu'i nyi ma la sa g.yos na rgyal po chen po mya ngan byed par 'gyur ro⑫/ /mchod sbyin byed pa dang / dad pa rnams ldog ⑩par 'gyur/ mi mang po 'du 114—1031

skar nag pa la sa g.yos na ri mo 'bri ba'i las rnams ma rung bar 'gyur①/ ri mo 'bri ba rnams dang / shing mkhan rnams dang / bzo bo dang / gser mgar dang /dzee rdo rje ④gsor ba'i las byed pa dang / bzang ④kan dang /nor bu 'brug cing nor bu mdog rjopa dang / rgyan la dga' ba dang / tshong pa dang / mig sman spyor shes pa'i mi dang / rgyan byed pa'i mi dang / yul pra dub ka sha dang / yul a ni la'i grong rdal ⑦dang / yul ma gyi sma dang / yul a pan ti sgedang / ri sa rgya'i ⑨drung dang / ri byin mda'i ⑩'khor na gnas pa'i skye bo rnams dang / mi dra ma ⑩rnams la de ltar sa g.yos na gnod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar sa ri la sa g.yos na chom rkun byed pa'i mi rnams dang /mgar mkhan rnams dang / 'tshe zhing gnod pa'i mi rnams dang / la 'phrang 'joms pa'i mi rnams dang / yul gangs ⑫ri'i byang phyogs kyi shod na gnas pa'i mi rnams dang / rol mo mkhan dang / bzhad gad mkhan dang /dka' thub can zas su rlung za ba dang / tshul ma yin pa'i dka' thub ⑫grub pa'i mi rnams dang / mi dge ba dam pa'i mi ⑨rnams dang / nga rgyal can rnams dang / yul sa ha ta'i mi dang / yul an dar ste'i spre)mi dang /yul bi pu ⑩la dang / yul ka tsa'i skye bo mang po phal po che dang / yul ba ya ba dang / yul ba shud krang ⑩ka dang / yul da ra ga ⑫zhes bya ba'i grong dang /phal po che'i ()mi dang / gling sna tshogs na bud med dam pa gnas pa dang /rkang 'gros kyis gang bar rgyas shing grong khyer ku be ra zhes bya ba la 'byor zhing rgyas par gnas pa dang / ri dam pa brad dza ya ho zhes bya ba'i drung na ⑩gnas pa'i mi dang / rgya mtsho'i 'gram na gnas pa'i mi dang / yul bri sna dang /114—1034

yul an dra ga dang / ma du zhes bya ba'i mi dang / sa twa ta zhes bya ba'i mi dang /'di dag gi gnas rnams dang / mi'i sde dha sha na ①zhes bya ba rgya mtsho chu'i 'gram ②grong khyer rnam pa brgya dang / grong khyer rnam pa stong snyed du gnas pa de dag la sa g.yos na rab tu gnod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar sa ga la sa g.yos na mi ①las su bya ba rnams ma rung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze dam pa me la rjed ④pa rnams dang / gsal ba ma 'khrul pa ⑤smra ba rnams dang / til dang / bal gyi sa bon dang / mon sran sde'u rjodang / bu ram shing gi khu ba dang / 'bru rnams dang / mi rgan pa dzeernams dang / mi phal po cher gnas pa rnams dang /'bras so ba dang / sa bon btab pa sman las sran chung dang / sran ma dang /sran tsa na sha ⑧ka dang / rgya sran nag po dang / yungs kar dang / yul du ⑨ra'i mi dang / yul ma ku ra'i mi dang /⑩ yul ba ya na dang / de bzhin du yul ri ma ka'i mi dang / yul ba par na mi mang pos gang ba dang / yul ka mar a di sta ⑩ta zhes bya ba na gnas pa'i mi de dag la sa g.yos na gnod pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar lha mtshams la sa g.yos na mdza' bo ⑫byams shing sdug pa 'bye bar 'gyur ro⑫/ /chung ma dang nor byi bya ba la sogs pa rnam pa bcu gcig tu bshad pa/ gnyen byas spyozhing / bag ma blang ba la sogs pa dang spyo/ yo byad bsags ⑫shing spel ba dang / bag ma blang ba rnams dang / mchod sbyin bya ba rnams ⑩de dag gi las bya ba dang / bkra shis par bya ba rnams dang / ltas su blta ⑫ba rnams dang / bram ze zhi ba dang ldan pa rnams dang / dka' thub can rnams dang / thub pa dang ldan pa rnams dang / dka' thub dang ldan pa rnams dang / brtul zhugs dang 114—1035

ldan pa rnams dang / yul ka sha zhes bya ba na rgyal srid chen po rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i yul dang / rgyal po'i mtha' 'khor ①yug na gnas pa 'bra go sdetshal nyams dga' ba'i gnas na 'bra snegos srog 'tsho ba rnams dang / skad rnam pa sna tshogs shes pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams dang / gzi brjid mi mngon par byed/ gzugs dang / gos dang / rgyan dang / spyod pa dang /byed pa dang / 'gro ba dang / cha byad rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa zas su nya sha za zhing lus nyams bde ba skyid pa de lta bu'i mi rnams la sa g.yos na rab tu gnod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar sgon la sa dhigayos na ri chen po bsnyil bar 'gyur—/ 'jig ⑤pa'i rlung rab tu ldang / yul a mra ka zhes bya ba'i yul du yul ka rjosha'i mi dang / rkun po dang / mi ngas dang / than chen dang /ser ba dang / yang dang yang ⑦mtshon kar 'gyed pa yul de phyogs na mya ngan byed cing 'gro ste/ sa g.yos pas gzi brjid nyams nas gnod pa de lta bu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul ma yin pa dag gis phan tshun du gnod pa byed par 'gyur ro/ /mi g.yon can dang / rgyal po dang / rgya'i ④mi dang / de bzhin du sgo lcags 'byed cing rku ba'i mi rnams dang / yul an dra'i mi rnams dang / yul pu ⑨linda na gnas pa'i mi rnams 'jig ⑩par gnas par 'gyur/mdza' ba'i dpung dang ldan pa rnams dang yang phyed par 'gyur/ rgyal po ⑪chen po dang / stom ⑫las dang ldan pa rnams kyang tshar gcod pa dang⑫/ bya rog dang / ri dwags pri sha dang / gcan gzan dang / gcan gzan drag shul can chen po rnams dang / yul ka ra dang / yul pa ra dang / yul shud dha se na ⑫na gnas pa'i mi dang / yul ma la ya'i mi rnams dang / tho 114—1036

stong snyed dang / bru sha ①yul la sogs pa dang / yul sa gar de'i skye bo rnams la gnod par ④'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar gro bzhin la sa g.yos na rgyal pos bkur ba'i mi rnams dang / bram ze rig byed slob pa'i mi rnams dang /bstan bcos la ④mkhas pa'i mi rnams dang / snyan dngags shes pa'i mi rnams dang / yul gan da dur nas yul kau shāsthā'i ⑤bar dang / yul me ta dur ste na gnas pa ⑦rnams dang / se ⑧nis kyi yul gnyis dang yul du spra ⑨sa ha dang /yul du mi la rjed pa'i mi dang / yul sa ge ⑩ka'i mi dang / yul lam ba ka'i mi dang / yul na ga ha ra dang / yul tsa ta bi sha ya dang / yul ga tsi ⑪ka na gnas pa ma rung ⑫ba du ma dang / yul la ba zhes bya ba'i ri la ⑫gnas pa dang / mtha'i rgyal po chen po rnams dang / yul ki sad ta ⑫dang / yul sa ba ti ra ⑫dang / yul ba ri ra za ⑫dang / yul brna ⑩pu ri'i grong rdal ⑫dang / klu'i gnas rnams dang / 'di dag la sa g.yos na gnod pa 'byung ⑪bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar mon gre la sa g.yos na mi phyug po dang / ra lug dang /bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / dre'u dang / wa dang / ri dwags kyi rnam grangs tha dad pa dang / ma te dang / 'phong dang / rtsal che ba dang /'dun khang sna tshogs dang / grong khyer rmi ⑪tshong dpon rnams dang / yul kha ga dang / yul swa ti ⑪man ta dang / yul khi la ⑫dang / yul mu na dang /yul ba twa ka ra dang / yul gon tha ma'i ⑫rnams dang / yul bo za dang /yul sā ④la'i grong khyer bru sha ⑫yul dang / gu zan dang / yul dzin dra ⑪dang /chang zhim po sna tshogs dag la dga' ba rnams dang / ri sha sha'i ri logs na gnas pa'i mi sna tshogs la sa g.yos na gnod par 'gyur ro/ /rgyu skar mon gru 114—1039

rig 'dzin dang / klu rnams dang / de bzhin du sman rnam pa ①stong snyed la gnod pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sa g.yos pa'i rjes la zhag bdun tshun chad du sa la phan pa'i sprin sngo gnag ④'jam po mig bsku ①ba'i sman gyi mdog ri chen po 'dra ba las 'brug sgra zab mor sgog cing nye bar 'brug sgra drag la glog rnam pa sna tshogs 'gyu zhing / nam mkha' la sngon po shur shur po lta bu dhisnang ba'am / sgra 'byung ba'am/ skar mda' lta bu med la rlung me drag pa ldang zhing tshub ma lta bu mi sdug pa ni med/ sprin gyi gzugs bkra shis kyi ri mo sna tshogs dang / dbang po rdo rje lta bu snang ba dang / nang par nyi ma 'char ba dang / nyi ma nub nas zla ba 'char ba'i tshe ⑤sprin gyis ma chog par char rjopa dang / nam mkha' ⑦sprin dal la snyoms pa dzee'ajam po'i gzugs rgyang ring por song ba ⑨glog phan tshun du 'phro ba'i sprin de lta bu ni dge ba'i mtshan ma yin no/ /sprin 'jam la dal snyoms te/ bar chad med cing sprin gyi gzugs lag ⑫pa mi snang ba de lta bur snang ⑪na sprin ⑫mtshan ma de lta bu dang / ldan pa ni lha'i dbang po'i ⑫sa g.yos par bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar gang dang gang du sa g.yos pa'i phan gnod kyi 'bras bu'i dmigs ni 'jigs shing dngangs pa med par yid rton ⑫la sa bon thams cad thob shig⑫ /las dang 'tsho ⑫nam rnams kyang gyis shig /rnam par rgyal bar 'gyur bar ⑩yang bstan to/ /tshong pa yang de'i tshe kun du song yang 'jigs pa med do/ /yang sa g.yos pa'i rjes la zhag bdun tshun chad du nam mkha' la ⑫sprin gyis khebs te/ thar chags su sprin ⑫bal ltar dal snyoms par song la/ nub phyogs su nam mkha' la chu srin byis pa gsod pa dang / sbal pa rnams dang / nya dang / chu srin 'dra ba'i 114—1043

bar lus ①par 'gyur/ de ltar sa g.yos pa ni ngan cing mi dge ste/ me'i sa g.yos pa zhes bya'o/ /de la snga ②dro sa g.yos na rgyal po dang / dmag gi dpung dang ldan pa/ rta dang / glang po che dang / dmag dpon snedang /blon por bcas pa la mi dge'o/ /nyi ma gung la sa g.yos na nad kyis 'debs so// phyim red ④sa g.yos na ba lang dang / phyugs dang / dmangs rigs dang /de bzhin du rje'u rigs rnams la gnod par 'gyur ro⑤/ /nang par dang /nyi ma nub pa dang / nam gyi gung dus mtshams su sa g.yos na rkun po dang /gos dmar po gyon pa'i mi rnams la mi dge'o/ /mtshan mo srod la sa g.yos na gnod pa byed pa dang / mtha' 'khob na gnas pa'i rkun po rnams dang / ma ning rnams dang / mtshan gyur pa durnams dang / phyug po rnams dang /tshong spogs byed pa'i tshong pa dang / zhing rmed ⑦pa la mi dge'o/ /zla ba mar gyi ngo'i nam gung ⑧la sa g.yos na gtum po drag shul can ngan byed pa rnams la mi dge'o| /zla ba yar gyi ngo'i nam chung la sa g.yos na mchod ⑨sbyin byed pa'i yo byad dang / bram ze mchod sbyin byed pa rnams la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /sa g.yos kyi le'u ste nyi shu ⑩bzhi pa'o// //nyi ma dang zla ba'i 'od dang / gzugs brnyan gyi mtshan ma bstan pa/yul gang du nyi ma shar ba'i tshe nyi ma dang ⑪'dra bar nam mkha' la snang na de'i lho byang gi phyogs kun du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs rab tu gsal ba ⑫yang ma yin| 'od zer yang mi gsal la/ sprin gyis kyang nam ⑫kun chod na de ni char pa 'bab pa yin te/ dbyar gyi tshe ni nyi ma 'dra ba rtag par yang 'byung ngo //114—1045

dang me tog ku mu da ①dang 'dra/ tshes grangs bzhin du zla ba skye zhing shas cher ②snang na/ dkyil 'khor 'od zer ldan te ①nyams pa med par 'gro ba yin④/de ltar 'od zer bsil ldan mi rnams rgyal bar 'gyur/ zla ba 'char zhing 'gro bar ⑤bshad pa'o // //dhi rgyu skar dang / rgyu skar gyi khyim gyi nang du gza' mig dmar zhugs pa'i mtshan ma bstan pa/ rgyu skar rgyu skar ⑦gyi khyim gang yang rung ba'i nang du ⑧gza' mig dmar 'od kyi mdog 'jam pa dang ldan zhing chen por 'gyur ⑨te/zla ba brgyad dam/ zla ba ⑩bdun gyi bar du zhugs shing 'dug pa las 'od kyi kha dog dang / bongs ⑩che ba nyams na de ni mi dge ba yin te/ rgyu skar gang dang gang gi nang du gza' mig dmar zhugs pa de nyid la gnod par 'gyur ro/ /gza' mig dmar tshul de lta bur zhugs pa ni skye bo rnams la gnod par 'gyur ro//yang gza' mig dmar yon par ⑫'gro zhing 'jug pa dang / phyir yang 'khor zhing zhugs pa dang / mig dmar gyi 'od dang mdog nyams pa dang / gza' mig dmar rgyu skar dang nye zhing 'od 'dres pa dang / mig dmar las dud pa 'thul ba dang / 'bar ba dang / mig dmar gyi rtse mo lus ⑫'od zer dang ldan par 'gyur ba ④dang / phan tshun du 'pho zhing 'gro ba'am/ lam gcig tu 'dug la 'od dmar po'am/ yang na dud pa mi sdug pa cher 'thul na gnod pa byed 'dod pa ⑫de ni rgyal po 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gza' mig dmar 'od dmar po 'bar na 'byung po thams cad la mi rung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na gza' mig dmar nam mkha' la rgyu zhing shar nub ltas mi snang bar 'gro na/114—1052

〈〈snar 〉〉ba'i/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bal/ rjo〈〈snar 〉stabad/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉'orgya ba de'i/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉min/ ⑨〈〈snar 〉mi la/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉mi/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉〉bltas/bsdur 'bras re'u migasna tshogs/ (14)114wa 1067

ste—/ /rtog ge pa yis ①mi shes so/ /lha mo 'di rnams legs bzung la/ /dge dang mi dge bshad par gyis④/ /lha ①mos gsol pa/ dbang phyug chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /lha yi lha mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /lam lnga legs par khyed kyis gsungs/ /da yang bdag la cung zad tsam/ /zhu ba dumachis pas gsan du gsol⑦/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed 'char ba ci/ /dbyangs kyi grangs ni du zhig mchis/ /de bzhin gsal byed grangs ni du/ /ring thung bye brag ji ltar 'chararjo/ /dkar nag phyogs la gang 'char lags④/ /bdag gis mi shes lha khyod la/ /nges par the tshom med par yang / /ma lus pa ni bdag zhu bas/ /de rnams mthar thug bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ji ltar khyod kyis bdag zhus pa/ /thams cad bshad kyis mnyan ④par gyis/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed bzang po rnams/ /ji ltar 'char ba'i nges pa ni/ /dpyid zla 'adzreng sogs ⑨zla ba yi/ /bcu drug (rtenas bzung ⑪stong gi bar/ /dkar phyogs ⑫zhes bya ri sras mo/ /⑫de yi tshes ④gcig nas brtsams te⑩/ /nya yi bar ni ⑩nag phyogs 'dod/ /de la dpyid 'bring ⑩zla bar grags/ /de ltar rim bzhin shes par bya/ /de la dpyid 'bring la sogs pa'i/ /tshes la ⑫'char ba'i dbyangs rnams ni/ /⑪a yig dang ni i ⑩yig dang / /de bzhin gsum pa u yig stestso/ /e yig lha mo yid 'phrog ma/ / 3o yig dang ni ⑫lnga ru 'dod/ /de ltar nga yis ④dbyangs su brjod⑫/ /dbyangs kyi rang bzhin rim bzhin du/ /sa ⑩dang chu ⑦me snyerlung dang ni/ /nam ⑫mkha'i sbyor bas ⑪shes par bya/ /stsodri dang ⑫ro ⑫dang ④gzugs spyodang ni//⑫reg bya sgra ⑫rnams rim bzhin dran/ /dbyangs ⑪lnga zhes bya lha chen ma/ /bya 714—1075

ba kun la shes par bya/ /ring ba lnga rnams ①dkar phyogs la/ /lan ⑤gsum du yang 'gyur ba yin/ /ka nas ha yi mthar thug pa①/ /nga nya ṇa gsum spangs pa yisakhyo/ /gsal byed phyogs gnyis dag las ⑤'chararjo/ /dkar ⑦phyogs nag phyogs dag la yang / /mdzes ma yi ge sum cur 'gyur/ /gsal byed ka nas da yi bar/ /dkar po'i phyogs la ⑧rim bzhin 'char/ /dkar phyogs ring ba ⑨lan gsum ste/ /ka ⑫sogs rnams dang lan gcig ⑪'gyur/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes rnams dang / /nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes la yang /dga' ba nas rgo brtsams nas su/ /lan gsum du yang 'char ba yin/ /ṛ dzā lo lbo spangs pa yi/ /dbyangs yig thung ngu lnga po rnams/ /nag ⑩po'i phyogs la 'char ba ni/ /dha sogs ⑫rnams dang lhan cig 'char④/ /so so'i tshes kyi byed pa rnams/ /bdag por ⑩lan gsum du yang 'gyur/ /⑩dzan ⑩ma ⑩ha ⑪ni du an 0ta 3ka 3 /dzan rngum 3ha stsoni rim pa bzhin ⑦/ /byes sdepa gzhon ⑫nu lang tsho ⑩ rgan/ /rngu smin ⑫te shi ba rim pa bzhin/ /a sogs dbyangs kyi bye brag dang / /tshes ni lnga la rim pas 'usbyar/ /byes pa rgan ④pa la sogs la/ /dar rgud 'ulas kyi bye brag byed/ /tshes la 'char ba'i dbyangs rnams dang / /⑪ming gi dbyangs rnams sbyar bar bya/ /dpyid 'bring dkar phyogs sogs ⑫brtsams nas/ /dbyangs rnams 'char ro lha mo kye/ /nyin zhag spyobadun cu rtsa gnyis 'u la/ /dbyangs ( 7 ni re re 'char bar 'gyur/ /de rgyabazhin zhag ni bcu gnyis shyil/ /dbyangs ni re re 'char ba dang 63/ /de bzhin ④zhag lnga dag la yang / /dbyangs rnams 'char bar 'gyur ba dang (ste/ /nyin re bzhin du dbyangs re 'char/ /thung 7dang ring 7ba'i dbyangs lnga po65/ /nyin ()lnga 114—1076

yod na shin tu bzang ba ste/ /de yi grogs po ①yod kyang bzang / /btang stoms la ni btang snyoms 'gyur/ /nya yi khyem bdag phur bu ste①/ /de yis zhu mthong ba'i sa rnams larī/ /de dang grogs po yod na bzang / /dgra ⑤rnams yod na mi dge ste/ /bdun la 'u dgra yod 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dge sdig ⑦gang dāyod stobs che ste/ /dran pa'i stobs su rab tu ⑨grags/ /de nas gzhan yang dus spyor gyi/ /dum bu sum cu'i ⑪cha shas bshad/ /lug tu nyi mar cha shas bcuskye/ /glang thul zla ba 1nacha shas ④gsum/ /kar ka ⑫phur pa ⑩lnga ⑩yang dge/ /bu mo gza' lhag bco lnga'o/ /srang du spen pa mkha' mig ⑫dang / /chu srin mig dmar nyi shu brgyadablu7 / /nya la pa sangs ( 7nyi shu bdun/ /cha shas rjo'adi dag yun la dgeka 5 / /rā spyos thunas ni bgrangs snyepa yi/ /bdun pa ⑪la ni mi dge ba rte/ /lug tu spen pa nyi shu ste 3 / /kar ka mig dmar nyi shu brgyad/ / bum par snye 7gza' lhag bco lnga ste/ /bu mor du pa sangs nyi shu bdun/ /sdig par zla ba gsum yin ⑪no/ /chu srin phur pa lnga yin no⑫/ /srang du nyi ma cha shas bcu/ /'di dag cha shas yun la 3ngan/ / tad kā ④la yi ⑫dus spyor la//zhing ke 4bdag ⑫gza' ni 'char ke 5ba dang / /de las gzhan pa'i khyem rnams su/ / 7khyem bdag gza' rnams 'char ba'i kyi tshe/ /de yis dgos stsopa'i don rnams ni / /'grub 'gyur mdzes dga' bde skyed ma/ /rang gi skye 6ba'i khyer dang ni/ / tad kā la yi 5dus sbyor nas④/ /mthong ba'i sa ⑤ni bdun yin te/ /gsum dang bcu spyol rkang pa gcig /bzhi dang brgyad la rkang ⑩pa gsum/ /lnga dang dgu la phyed mthong bshad/ /bdun pa —thams cad rdzogs par mthong / / te bzhi ni mi mthong mdzes dga' ma/ /mthong dga' zhu stobs kyi bye brag bshad/ /114byed1086

sgra gcan shar na dgra yang ①pham②/ /zla bas ④rang rgyal gza' lhag rtsod/ /pa ba sangs kyis don rnams 'grub/ /phur bus sngags rnams 'grub par ston/ /mdor dhin skye ⑤gnas bdun pa la/ /bzang ngan zhi drag gnas pas 0shes/ /de ltar rā dzeeshi'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /cho ga'i bye brag bdag gis bshad/ /g.yo ⑧ba zung ni ⑨'phyang ba khyod/ /legs par rtogs sam 'dod dga' ma⑩/ /bram ze rnam par dag pa'i tshogs⑪/ /phung po ⑫gsum mkhyen thub dbang po/ /sgra yi bstan bcos don spangs ⑫pa/ /klags ④pas chog pa don grub ⑫pa/ /nyan par 'dus pa'i sems dge ⑫ma/ /bla ma ⑩dam pa'i rim pa yis mchog tu gsang ⑫ba'i bstan bcos ⑪'di/ /gzi ⑦brjid dga' ba ⑫ma lus mthong / /'di ni g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud las/ dus sbyor gyi gza'i ⑫dum bu drug gi don rab tu phye ba chen po ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //lha mos gsol pa/ skal ldan lha yi lha mchog gtso/ /ri bong can gyis dbu la brgyan/ /mchog tu dge ba thams cad mkhyen/ /ji ltar dus sbyor dge mi dge/ /bzhi ⑫dang cho ga sngar gsungs ⑫nas/ /lha chen rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba khyed⑫/ /dus sbyor phrin las thams cad ni/ /mi gsung bzhugs pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dka' zlog ⑪lha mo mchog tu ni/ /gsang ba bshad kyis grogs mo nyon/ /bsam pa ⑫sngon du legs bzhag ste/ /bye brag so sor legs bsams te3/ /snga dro'i dus su sems dge bas⑥/ /mngon sum dran pa sor bzhag nas/ /mdun bsdad ⑪gdong ni mngon ⑪phyogs te/ /yid ches the tshom med dga' bas/ /gus 114—1091

pas phyag ni btsal byas te/⑫// /yon phul nas ni mnyes par byasakhye/ /de ltar sngon du byas nas ni/ /langs dang rgyab kyis phyogs pa min/ /g.yas dang g.yon nas sgom yin par/ /mdun du dma' sar bsdad ⑤nas ni/ /dgos pa'i bsam pa sngon btang ste6/ /don ④gsal kyetshig gis ⑨dri bar bya/ /slob dpon sbyimakhas shing bye brag shes/ /dga' zhing blo gsal yid gzhungs pas/ / tad kāl 'u/ dus sbyor rab shes pas/ /dum bu drug gi ⑫bye brag mthong / /gza' kyernams thukhyem dang rgyu skar mul/ /gnas pa'i longs spyod shes pa dang / /gza' teskar tshes dang byed spyor sogs/ /rnam par dag pa ⑩des byas te/ /dri shā5bar byed pa'i tshig tshogs kun/ /khong du chud nas smra bar bya/ /zur gsum pa dang 17 bsod rnams shar/ /ud bye pa ⑦tsa zhe la sdig can gnas/ /'dri byed rnyed pa 'byung zhes bstan/ /de las bzlog na rnyed pa med/ / tad kāl )dus spyor phur bu gnas/ /bzhi la 3dang bdun la zla ba ⑫gnas/ /bcu par khunyi ma snang gyur na/ /smras ma thag tu don rnams 'grub/ / ⑦dang po 'udang ni gnyis pa la — sna/ /bcu dang bcu gcig bsod nams yod/ /de ma thag tu don rnams ni/ /de ltar 'grub par bstan pa yin/ / tad kāl rku rte dus spyor g.yo ba la/ /sdig rkecan gza' dang lhan cig gnas/ /don rnams med cing rnam par pa 'joms/ /sngar nas med pa'i sdug bsngal spe5'byung / / tad kāl ༄ 〉dus spyor bdag 5yod snapa ⑦/ /de yi grogs po snang yang du ’bde/ /bzhi pa la ni snye 7yod na yang / /the tshom med par bde bar ston/ /bcu gcig pa 'u dang brgyad pa la/ /spyig can nye bar gnas pa dang / /bzhi pa la yang sdig can gnas/ /'dri byed sdug bsngal 'byung bar dran/ /dang po 6nyuganyis 174—1092

kyang / /gzhan la bshad bya mdzes dga' ma/ /gal hūṃte nyi ma sno yod pa nadzu// /rgyal po dang ni me dang khrag /nyi ma shar dang me tog gikru/ /dmar po'i rigs rnams rmi ba yin/ /zla ba bud med me tog dang ༄snye / /rin bo che dang sna tshogs rmiske/ /sa le sbram la sogs pa yi/ /dkar bo'i rigs rnams rmi ba yin/ /mig dmar byi ru khrag dang ni/ /nam mkha' la ni 'phur la sogs/ / tad kā hūṃ la yi dus sbyor la/ /mig dmar snang na rmi ba yin/ /gza' lhag dag la rmi lam ni/ /chos bshad pa dang nyan pa rmi/ /phur pas ri mo 'bri ba ⑦dang / /1ga dang rig pa sna tshogs dang / /rta dang byis pa rtse ba dang / /pu duti lha dang gnyen mthong rmi/ /pa sangs chu la rgal ky-i7ba dang / /gar dang rtse dang 'khrug ⑪pa rmi/ /khyim dang gza' ni so so ste/ /khyem bdag min pa'i gza' shar na/ /rmi lam 'dren ma ⑪ 'byung ba 'am/ /yang na rmi lam mi shes so/ /khyim bdag gza' yi dgrar gyur pa'i/ /gza' rnams shar na ngan pa rmi/ /nyi ma gnas pa nas bgrangs la/)pa'i shā)/ /bdun na hūṃzizla ba yod pa'amatshu5/ /zla pho9gnas bdun la 4)nyi ma yod/ /de hūṃ5 tshe 'dri na rmi lam yod/ /de las shā’gzhan pa 'dri ba la( 7/ /rmi lam med par kyeshes par bya/ /rmi lam rmi ba'i dus bstan 3 pa/ / tad kāl 'u cha shas sum cu yi rkezi/ /rang bzhin yin pas de la blta⑫/ /cha ⑫shas bcu shar ༷ kyesum cha ⑫na/ /bco 4 lnga shar na nam phyed dzu na/ /sum cu yod na tho rangs te/ /de la sogs pa'i bye brag rnams/ /mkhas pas ⑪zhib tu brtag par bya/ /'pho ba'i ༄shergyu skar rte tshes grozibasres la/ /spyod pa'i ༄ 9gza' yis legs par bsgyur/ /ming spyoyig dang po'i (rtegasal byed ni/ /rim pas bsres la gsum gyis bgo/ /de yi lhag (5mas dkon mod dang / /rin gyi ⑥114byed1097

bdun gyis bgo/ /lhag mas ①tshes gcig nas brtsams pa'i①/ /skar ma'i grangs ni ston par byed/ /de ltar skar ma'i rab phye ba①/ /skyes pa'i zla ba nyin zhag dran/ /'di la rang gi zla ba ni/ /sngon dhisong skar ma btsal ba yin/ /rang gi skar ma shes pa las/ /don kun shes par 'gyur bar dran/ /gang gis skar ma mi shes pa⑤/ /de yi rjongal ba don med dran/ /rang gi 'dod pa'i skar ma nasadzee/ /lha mo ⑧nan tan las shes bya/ /'dri byed srog gi ⑨las ⑩byed sar—/ /bzlog nas ⑩gnas na dgos don med/ /gal te las ni byed par gnas/ /bsam pa'i yid la 'dod pa 'grub/ /skyes pa sgo nang ⑫g.yas 'jog cing / /de bzhin bud med g.yon 'jog pa⑫/ /dge zhing ④shes par ston pa ste/ /⑫bzlog ⑩na 'dri ba'i ⑩don nyams 'gyur/ /g.yas kyi ⑫yan lag g.yo ba dang / /snying nyid ngan pa rnam par spang / /nye 'khor shis pa'i bya ba byed/ /bsam mi dgos pas don mi ⑪'grub/ /'dri byed mgrin pa 'gram pa dang / /rna ba sna mig brang dang ni/ / lce dang ⑫gsang ba snying dang ⑫so/ /skra dang dpral ba gsus pa dang / /nu ma dang ni dku ⑫rnams su/ /lag pa g.yas pas reg cing g.yo/ /gdong ni sngon du bltas ⑫pa'i tshe/ /dge ba'i las ④yin bzhin bzangs ⑫ma/ /g.yon pas ⑪reg cing g.yo ba ni/ /de las bzlog par ⑩shes par bya/ /'dri byed pho nya'i nye 'khor na/ /ba lang ra lug gsod pa dang / /'thab rtsod rdeg bcing rdung ⑫ba dang / /btson 'dzin srog ⑥'joms nor stor dang / /sdod stong skye bo yul dman ⑪ pa/ /gos hrul mdze can mdog mi sdug /skrag dang ⑪byed cing chad pas bcad/ /sems stor mya ngan byed pa mthong / /kha dog yid du mi 'ong ba/ /kha ni 'og bltas rlung tshub ⑫114—1101

chud par gyis/ /smin drug ①la sogs skar ma rnams②/ /phyogs ①su bdun bdun buganas pa las/ /mig dmar la sogs gza' ⑤rnams ni/ /rgyu skar re re'i bdag por dran/ /skar ma rdzu rang gi bdag por ⑦gnas/ /skyon med bde ster ④rang gi bu/ /byes bgrod ⑨sogs dang bya ba la/ /rang gi bdag pos bde bar byed/ /bdag ⑩po rang gi bu la ⑩gnas/ /thams cad shis byed lha chen ma⑫/ /byang la sogs pa ⑫phyogs bzhi ru/ /zla ba gnas ④pa'i skar ma rnams—/ / dbo dang khrums smad chu ⑫smad dang / /rgyal dang mchu dang ⑩sa yi bu—/ /mig dmar zhes bya thad tu snakar song / /chom rkun gyis 'tshe bza' btung med/ /sngar nas med pa'i nad 'byung zhing / /longs spyod zad 'gyur med do kyespyo/ /chu smad rkyukyegro bzhin ⑫me bzhi dang / /nag pa mon grer ⑥zla ba gnasarka/ /de yi thad kar gza' lhag shar/ /'chi sogs mi dge sna tshogs pa ⑫—/ /nor bu bu dang bu mo dang / /longs spyod rnams ni ma lus nyams/ /khrums stod snrubs dang tha skar mchu/ /sa ga rnams la zla ba gnas/ / tha skar phur bu'i 0gdong babatsugs spyon/ /rgyal po ⑪yul du mi bzhag cing / /bya ba kun la mi dge ste/ /gnyen rnams gsal bar 'chi bar 'gyur/ /spyon dang chu stod gre dang skag /nam gru rnams su zla ba yod/ /de yi thad kar pa sangs bltas ⑦—/ /bag ma blangs na khyo 'chi ste/ /pus mo la sogs na ba dang / /phyugs kun brlag par ⑫'gyur ba yin/ /smin drug lag dang chu stod dang / /byi bzhin bra nyer ⑫zla ba gnas/ / tha skar 8 7gal te spen pa 'ongs⑥/ /nad 'byung grogs rnams 'chi bar dran/ /rgyu skar bdag po'i nus pa ste/ /rang gi bdag po'i 'khor lo yinasgoshe/ /smin drug 6kyel sogs rim pa bzhin④/ /bzhi 114—1108

bzhir yongs su phye ba las/ /sde tshan bdun du 'gyur ba ste/ /bzhi la re khās ①bskor ba ②bdun/ /nyi ④zla pa sangs rjophur bu dang / /mig dmar gza' lhag rā hu spen/ /rim pa bzhin bstan mtha' ⑤ma'i char/ /rā hu spen pa gnyis te mebazhin/ /sde tshan ⑦phan tshun bsnol gnas ⑧las/ /mo de thad ka'i nus pa 'byung / /nyi ma mig dmar thad kar te⑨/ /mig dmar nyi mar tukyegadong btsugs so⑪/ /de bzhin zla ba ⑫gza' ⑫lhag ste/ /spen ④pa phur pa phan tshun bltas/ /pa sangs rā hu de bzhin du/ /thad kar bsnol spyobs stobs su 'gyur/ /grong dang grong khyer phyogs rnams su/ /phyugs dang rin chen ⑩lo tog sogs/ /thad ka'i skyon gyis brlag par ni/ /'gyur ro lha yi dbang phyug ma/ /gza' rnams thad kar gdong btsugs pas⑩/ /phan tshun chen po'i 'khor lor spyogrags⑪/ /smin drug la sogs pya rim pa bzhin/ /phyogs der bdun ni ⑥gnas pa las/ /rang gi phyogs su ⑫'gro bar chas/ /dge'o dpa' ⑫mo dbang phyug ma/ /shar phyogs shar ④bzhin spyobyang du ste⑪/ /byang yang ⑩byang ⑫bzhin shar du'ang bzang / /de bzhin ⑩lho dang nub phyogs kyang / /phan tshun mnyam par dge ba yin/ /me ⑫nas spyorlung du sa ⑫ri ⑫gha④/ /mtshams ⑫ la rgal na ⑫mi shis pas/ /don nyams sdug bsngal ngal dub dang / /rmongs shing 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /me dang rlung du mtshams ⑫bcas ⑫pas/ / sa ri ⑥gha yi 'khor lo yin/ /dbang ldan 0bra nye smin spyodrug dbus⑫/ /mer ni skag dang mchu zhes brjod/ /bden bral sa ga lha mtshams dbus/ /gro bzhin ⑫mon gre rlung de bzhin④/ /rang gi phyag rgya'i sbyor ba ste/ /lha mo de ltar phan tshun gnas/ /phyogs bzhi ⑫phan tshun mi mthun phyir/ / phan tshun ⑩rnam 114—1109

ge ma yig mchu rnams zin/ /g.yon du mon gre smin drug mdun/ /mon grer ①gal te sdig can gnas/ /g.yas su byi bzhin ⑤g.yon du ga /bum pa stong dga' kar ka ṭa/ / ḍa ka ①g.yas so sa ga mdun/ /mon grur bdag nyid chen po gnas/ /sa dang nya khyim o 'khrig pa/ /ha rgyal g.yon bzung ④g.yas su ri/ /gro bzhin du ni bus rir dran/ /gnod pa khrums ⑥ stod la gnas te/ / kha ga ④chu smad g.yas su 'dzom/ /g.yon du da yig lug glang ka /nab so'i mdun du nag pa bcom/ /khrums smad gal te sdig can ⑤'ongs/ /tsa li wa lag g.yon pas 'dzin/ /sha o dza dang khrums ⑨stod g.yas/ /mdun du me bzhi rnam par 'joms/ /nam gru'i g.yas su da yig dang / /bum pa chu srin bha yig snrubs/ /g.yon du la a rgyu skar mgo/ /mdun du dbo ⑩zhes bcom par dran/ /tha skar g.yon du u yig dang / /snar ma g.yas su tsa yig nya/ /a tha ⑪gzhu dang ya dang spyon/ /mdun du gre ni rnam par nyams/ /bra nye ⑫g.yon du rmin drug ste/ /g.yas su la yig lug stong pa/ /rgyal ba sdig pa na yig dang / /lha mtshams mdun du mchu zhes grags⑫/ /rang ④gnas ⑫dang por ⑩skyes ⑩pa ste/ /de bzhin bcu par ⑫las ⑪zhes brjod/ /de nas rkang ⑦ pa bcu drug pa ⑩/ /rnam par 'ges 3pa zhes byar dran/ /rkang pa'i grangs ni bco brgyad par/ / rgya can ⑫zhes ④byar yongs su grags/ /lha mo nyi shu rtsa ④gsum par/ /⑪bi nā shārka ⑦zhes bya'o 3/ /nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad ⑫pa la/ /yid can ⑪zhes byar kun du 0grags⑫/ /de ltar mche ba drug gnod pas/ /drug 'dzin zhes ⑫bya lha sras mo/ /rkang pa bcu dgu pa yi (zigrangs/ /a ⑫dha na zhes de bzhin brjod/ /⑫rigs ⑫dang ⑫yul ⑥dang rgya dbang ⑨bsgur gsum/ /114—1117

mkhyen pa ①la zhus pa/ /lus can skyes pa'i ⑤gnas skabs la/ /dge dang mi dge ji ltar gnas1/ /dus kyi 'khor lo ④ ji lta bu/ /gnas ⑤dang rjo'achi ba'i khyad par las/ /dge dang ⑦mi dge'i ṅku7rim pa bzhin/ /lha chen bdag la cis ma ⑨gsung / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i man ngag lha/ /dkar mo ⑩myur du nyan par gyis/ /lus can kun gyi srog shes pa/ /dus kyi 41/'khor lo zhes bya ba/ /mu ⑫khyud ⑫bzhi ④pa ⑩lte ba can/ /rtsibs ni bcu gnyis re mig ni/ /sum cu bdun ldan 'khor lo ste/ /rim pa gsum du bris lhophyonas ni/ /tshe dang srog rlung zhag grangs dang / /lo zla nyin zhag rim pas bri/ /nyi khyem 'pho ⑩ba zhes bya ba/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i lam las ⑫ni/ /rgyu ba'i mtshan nyid rig par bya/ /'di la spyodage dang mi du dge brtag /nag po'i ⑪ tshes gcig nas bzung ste/ /nyin zhag ⑫gsum du 'pho gcig la/ /zla ba'i ⑫bgrod pa 3rgyu ba ste/ /de nas ⑫nyin gsum nyi bgrod 'gyur / /de bzhin bco lnga'i bar du yang / /zhag ni gsum gsum shes par bya—/ /dkar po'i ⑫tshes gcig nas brtsams te ⑦/ /nyin zhag gsum du snga dro ni—/ /nyi ma'i bgrod pa ( sgorgyu ba ste/ /de bzhin tshes ni bco lnga'i bar/ /dus rngo yam̐spyor gcig la rgyu bar 'gyur/ /dus sbyor du re re rgyu ba las/ /phyin ⑪ci ⑫ log tu nges par rgyu⑫/ /rtsod pa la sogs nges 'gyur baspyo/ /nyin zhag lngar ni log par rgyu/ /rtsod pa (5la sogs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zla ⑪ba phyed kyis ⑪nad 'byung zhing / /zla ba gcig gis gnyen rnams 8brlag /zla phyed gsum gyis ⑥'chi bar 'gyur/ /de ltar shes bya mdzes ma kye/ /zhag gcig nas ni bzhi pa'i zhu bar/ /bcu nas bzhi yi bar gyi lo —7// /zhag lnga nas ni brtsams nas ni//114—1120

gyi cha yis bgo bar bya/ /de yi lhag mar gang gyur ①pa/ /gnyis ka mnyam zhun 'dum pa ste/ /mi mnyam stobs la bltas ①pas shes/ /ming gi yi ge ji snyed pa/ /gcig gis gcig ④la dbri bar bya/ /lhag ma gang yod rgyal ba rjoste/ /ma ldang dub ni 'pham par 'gyur/ /lhag med mnyam ④pas dzee'adum par byed/ /de ltar shes bya dka' bzlog ma/ /ming gi dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams⑨/ /so sor ⑩phye la legs par brtag⑪ /zung gis pham ⑫par shes ⑫ bya ste④/ /kha yar bas ni rgyal bar / ⑩ston/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed ji snyed pa/ /so sor mnyam ⑩na 'dum par ston/ /lha mo de ltar 'khor lo mchog /so sor shes par bya zhes grags/ /de nas shin tu gsang ba yi/ /rma brtag ⑩'khor lo bshad par bya/ /skyes bu'i gzugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /rgyu skar gnas pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /lus kyi cha shas gang du rma/ /byung spyozhing ji tsam ⑪'byung ba zhes / /nyi ma du gnas ⑫pa'i rgyu skar nas/ /bye brag phye la rim ⑫bzhin bri⑫/ /mgo bor ④gsum la kha la gsum/ /snying ga ⑫ lnga ste ⑫lag par brgyad/ /rkang pa dag rngu la brgyad yin ༷ 3te 'u / /de ltar gzugs la dgod stsopar bya/ /rang 0gi skar ma'i dus stso spyor lasastso/ /mthong bar ④sdog spyocan gang yod ⑪pa/ /rma ⑫byung che phye chung mthong dang ⑪stobs/ /bdun sbyi par the tshom med par 'gyur/ /⑪ zla 8rtab gnas pa'i spyocha —rteshas la/ /rma rnams 'byung bar shes par bya/ /rma rnams che chung lta shāb ni/ /dgu cha'i rte7dum 0bu ④blta bar bya/ /de yi grangs kyi ⑪sor gyis 'u bcal/ /sdig 0can gnas par rma 'byung bshad⑫/ /nyi ma spyomathong na rma log 'gyur/ /rā hu (stemathong na rma zer sgonyethebs/ /spen pa snyenyamathong na skyes bu yi⑪/ /rma la smyokhrag ni med par 'gyur/ /mig dmar mthong 114—1132

ltar stobs kyi bye brag 'dikṇi/ /tshangs pas rgyud du dzeebashad pa yin/ /g.yul gyi dus su 'khor lo 'di/ /stobs kyi cha yis rgyal pham ①ston/ /sde tshan ji ltar gnas pa dang / /stobs bskyed pa yi rim pa ni/ /dbang me gshin rje ④bden bral dang / /chu rlung sge7gnod sbyin dbang ldan dang / /go rims bzhin du gnas pa ste/ /'di rnams stobs la khyad par gnas/ /stobs chen rnam ⑥par rgyal 'gyur te/ /chung ba pham shwe/par 'gyur ba yin/ /rang la ④pha rol phyogs kyi stobs/ /srog chags rnams kyi lus kyis gsal/ /a sde 'di ltar bya khyung ste/ /ka yi ke/7sde tshan byi lar dran⑫/ /tsa yi sde tshan seng ger dran⑪/ /ṭa sde spyang khur ⑪shes par bya/ /ta 3rteyi sde tshan sbrul du gsal/ /sa ④sde byi lar yongs su grags/ /ya cheyi sde tshan glang po che/ /sha sde lug tu yongs ⑩su brjod / /de nas 'dab chags 'khor lo mchog /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis kyang hurte/ /dus kyi stobs kyis (5'dod don kun/ /the tshom med par 'grub 'gyur bshad/bye / /de ltar phyogs mtshams brgyad po la/ /shar nas brtsams te du 7 legs par gnas 1/ /shar phyogs bdag po nyi ma ste/ /mig dmar me yi phyogs na gnas/ /gshin rje phur bu lhas mchod ma/ /gza' lhag bden bral phyogs na gnas/ /pa sangs chu bdag phyogs zhes dran/ /rlung phyogs bdag po spen par grags/ /zla ba nor gyi bdag po'i phyogs/ /sgra gcan dbang 2ldan spyod yul lo/ /bya rgod khra dang gong ma sreg /de bzhin ṣpe tsho 2rtakhrung khrung dang / /rma bya 'ug pa srin bya ste/ /'dab chags brgyad du yongs su grags/ /'di ltar rim bzhin a sde dang / /ka sde tsa sde de bzhin te/ /ṭa sde ta ḍa zisde zhes bya baspyo/ / ba yi sde tshan bcas pa dang / /ya tshan sha tshan bri 114—1138

dang phyugs ①rnams zad/ /rā hu'i ①mgo la song ba na/ /khyim tshig ①nor nyams 'thab rtsod 'byung / /sgog mar song na chos rnyed cing / /nor rnyed don 'grub bdag nyid 'gyur/ /gnyen dang lhan cig 'grogs par byed/ /rā hu'i dngos grub 'byung bar byedakhyo/ /rgyab tu song na 'chi ba dang / /rang dang gnyen rnams bsus dupa rjon/ /de la sogs pa'i 'bras bu 'byung / /mgul pa ⑦dge bar grags pa yin/ /mjug ma'i skar ma la song na/ /lcags sgog 'ching dang 'gyel ba dang / /lhung dang pus mo snad ⑧pa dang / /gnas nas g.yo bar 'gyur ba dang⑨/ /klu gnod ⑩'jigs pa chen po 'byung / /snying nad 'byung ba gzhug mas phyed⑪/ /zla ba ⑩phur pa ⑫gza' lhag dang / /pa sangs snying bor chud ⑫gnas pa/ /rdzong la dpung gis bskor gyur kyang / /'jigs zon mi dgos gangs ri'i bdag /nyi ma mig dmar spen pa dang / /rā hu snying por chud pa na⑫/ /dgra yis len par 'gyur bas ⑩na/ /rdzong bdag sdod ⑫par byed dam ci/ /rigs ngan gza' rnams snying por sang spyo /phyi rol rnam par rgyal bar grags/ /rigs bzang ⑪gza' rnams snying por gnas—/ /rdzong bdag rgyal bar bdag gis dran/ /gal te 'dren bu mar gnas pa las/ /phan tshun 'khrug pa ⑥'dum pa yin/ /rdzong ni 'joms dang srung 0 ba las/ /'di yi cho ga bshad pa yin/ /rigs bzang rigs ngan yang dag shes/ /nag bu pa sa ga spyon dang ni/ /chu stod gro bzhin ④smin drug mgo/ /tha skar mchu rnams rigs bzang yin/ /bra nye snar ma nab ⑫so skag /sa ri lha mtshams chu smad dbo/ /chu ⑩stod nam gru me bzhi rnams/ /rigs ni ngan par ston ⑦pa yin/ /lag dang snrubs dang mon gre dang / /byi bzhin phy-irnams 114—1154

yi tshul de ni/ /shin tu yun ring dus su spyad①/ /gang dag rgas rab ②mi bsten pa/ /de dag gtsug lag mkhas mi 'gyur/ /gzu lums can gyi spyod pa rnams—/ /dgos pa myur du nyams par 'gyur/ /ha cang sog ①la zhen pa yi/ /bdog pa gzhan gyi don dudu 'gyur/ /sbrang mas 'bad de bsags pa yi/ /sbrang rtsi gzhan dag spyod par snang / /ngan pa rnams dang bshes 'dod pa/ /phung ⑤ba kho nar 'gyur bar duzad/ /chu bos drung nas zos pa yis⑦/ /ljon shing 'greng yang 'gyel dang 'dra/ /phan skyabs che la brten ⑧na ni/ /chung yang btsan po ⑨nyid du 'gyur/ /ri rab btsan ⑩la brten pa'i bya/ /gser kyi mdog tu 'gyur zhes grags—/ /khang bzangs ⑪zo mdog gya gyu ⑫med/ /klan ka mi tshol 'jar ⑫la phan/ /sgrub ④pa'i 'bras bu yod pa yi/ /grogs po rnams la lha yang dga'//mang po rnams ni 'jing dril nas/ /longs spyod phyir ni dpung 'chang ba/ /chags pa'i dbang gis phung ⑫'gyur te/ /nas dang bral ba'i srin bzhin no/ /don rnams kun la mi gsal ba'i/ /ngan pa rnams ni 'dzings bsdongs ⑫nas/ /go 'phang thob kyang rlag ⑩'gyur te/ /srin bu ra ba'i khar phyin bzhin/ /yul ngan bshes ni ngan pa dang / /chung ma ngan dang 'khor ngan dang / /rgyal po skye bo ngan spong ba/ /de dag rtag tu bde ba 'thob/ /skyes bu mkhas pa gcig rkya yang spyo/ /'dod pa'i don mchog grub ⑪par 'gyur/ /ri dwags rgyal po gcig pu yis/ /glang chen dregs khyu'i glad pa 'gems/ /mang po tshogs ⑥par gyur pa yi—/ /nang na 'dug na gzhan dag gis/ /de 'dir zad ces mi rtsi ba/ /skyes bu tha shal yin snyam byed/ /rang don bsgrub par 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu skyabs chen btsal ⑪bar bya/ /gang dag ⑫rgya mtsho cher phyin na/ /rang gi 114—1298

na572༄ga /lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ nī ti ②shāsta pradzñā daṇḍa nā ma/ bod skad du/lugs kyi bstan bcos shes rab sdong bu zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi srun skye bo gdul bar bya/ /yon tan can ni bkur bar bya//drang po'i spyod pas dkor mdzod dgang / /rang gi yul 'khor bskyang bar bya/ /bdag gi gsang dang gzhan gyi gsang / /rang gi bu gces bzhin bsrungs nas④/ /sa rnams la ni snyoms gyur pa'i/ /mi ni gces pa dhirab gces 'gyur/ /chung ma ngan dang mdza' bo ngan/ /rgyal po ngan dang nye du ngan/ /khyim mtshes ngan dang yul ngan rnams/ /thag ring du ni spang bar bya/ /grogs po nor dad che ba spang ⑤/ /chung ma log g.yem dad che spang dhi/ /bkur dka' so dzeemi mkhas pa yi/ /de lta bu yi sman pa spang ⑧/ /bye brag phyed pa'i blo ldan yang / /bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /'grub 'gyur kho nar ma zad kyi/ /ma 'grub ⑨na yang 114—1305

cad yongs su mgu 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i thabs ni gang yang yod ma yin/ /gzhan las tshol zhing zas zhim 'dod/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing khengs pa che/ /bstan bcos shes med rtsod par 'dod/ /khyod kyi ①de gsum bzhad gad rgyu/ /nags bsregs sdepa yi me la ni/ /rlung gis grogs su 'gyur ba yin/ /de nyid mar me 'jig byed pas/ /nyam chung ba la bshes yod min/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byas dang / /dman la 'dud pa ma byas shing / /dam pa'i lam ni ma spangs gang / /nyung ba de ni mang po yin/ /nad kyi 'jigs pa ma byung zhing / /dam pa dag dang 'grogs par brtson/ /dman pa'i tshig ni ma smras pa'i/ /nyin gcig lo brgya bas mchog yin/ /dman pas gang tshe nor ni cung zad rnyed//'gro ba thams cad brnyas pa'i nga rgyal ldan/ /dam pa nor gyi 'byor pa thob gyur kyang / /sā dhilu smin pa lta bur shin tu 'dud/ /rigs rus dma' ba'i ④sems can dag /nor ram rig pa rnyed gyur na/ /'gro ba kun la rtswa ⑤snyam sems| /pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no/ /nor ram rig par ldan gyur na//dman pa rnams ni dregs par 'gyur/ /go 'phang gnyis po de dag gis/ /mkhas pa shin tu dul bar 'gyur/ /bogs med tshong dang 'khor ldan dag la 'tshe—/ /slong zhing 'gying la nor med 'dod la dga'/ /bud med gzhon la tshig rtsub smra ba ste/ /skyes bu log par spyod pa de lnga'o/ /rma bya so ga'i tsha bas gdungs gyur kyang / /mkha' dkyil char gyi rgyun la re bla rjoyi/ /rdzing bu rnyog pa can kyi chu ngan la/ /dregs pas bstod pa'i mgrin pa ma gdud ⑦cig /ti ti ra ni zil pa yi/ /thigs pas srog ni 'dzin byed kyang / /bslang ⑧na gtugs pa'i 'jigs pa yis/ /brgya byin la yang mi slong ngo / /de nyid shes 114—1309

na slob dpon ci/ /nad sos sman pa ga la dgos/ /chu bo brgal na ①gru pas ci—/ /chags bral byad mas ci zhig bya/ /ngan pa ji srid nyam chung ba/ /de srid bar du rang bzhin bzang / /ston ka yi ni chu bo'i chu/ /skye bo kun gyis bgrod pa bla②/ /gang du bye bas mdzod pa byed/ /byi las mar ni bsrung ba dang / /khā ④yis phyag tshang byed pa yi/ /dngos de la ni smos ci dgos/ /gang na zhal ta byed pa mang / /thams cad mkhas par nga rgyal che/ /kun kyang gtso bo byed 'dod pa/ /de yi tshogs rnams 'jigs ④par 'gyur/ /nyin par 'khrig dang nyin nyal dang / /chang gsar ⑤zho ni gzhon nu dhi'athung / /sha skam bud med rgan nyal te/ /'di drug lus kyi stobs 'phrog pa'o/ /gang zhig khro na'ang 'jigs med la/ /dga' na'ang phan 'dogs mi nus pa/ /tshar gcod bsdu ba med 'gyur ba'i/ /de khros pas ni ci byar yod/ /nad dang phangs ⑦dus byung ba dang / /mu ge'i tshe dang dgras 'jigs dang / /rgyal po'i sgo dang gshin rje'i gnas/ /de rnams kun gyi gnyen por 'gyur/ /dgos pa'i don du 'jig rten sgrub/ /dam pa'i don du de dag min/ /be 'us 'o ma zad mthong nas/ /ba ni ring du spang ⑧ba bzhin/ /sdug pa dang bral rang mis brnyas pa dang / /bu lon mang zhing ngan pa dag la brten⑨/ /dbul por mthong nas mdza' bos spangs pa ste/ /me ma yin pas lus sreg de lnga'o/ /mi mthun chung ngu 'phel ba la/ /mi gang zhi bar mi byed pa/ /sbrang rtsi'i ⑩thigs pa 'dzag ⑪pa dang / /yul 'khor 'jig par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /gang zhig rigs ⑫ldan de bzhin brten ⑫pa dang / /dam pa phangs ⑫kyang yon tan gtong mi byed/ /nyi ma'i rang bzhin tsha bas gdungs kyang ni/ /kha ba grang ba'i rang 114—1310

bzhin gtong mi byed/ /sdig pa zad 'dod bde bar gshegs la dad/ /skal ba zad 'dod skye bo ngan dang bsten/ /rigs rgyud zad 'dod glan zhing lkugs ①pa skye/ /'bru rnams zad 'dod pho ba'i me drod skye/ /'dod pas long bas sdig mi mthong / /dmus long gis ni gzugs mi mthong / /dregs pa yis ni skyon mi mthong / /bdag ltas de nyid mi mthong ngo / /rgyal po yur chu 'khri sdeshing dang / /bud med dmus long lnga po ni/ /g.yon can blo yis ji ltar khrid/ /khrid rnams gzhan gyi dbang du 'gyur/ /bde ba'i rjes la sdug bsngal te/ /sdug bsngal rjes la bde ba yin/ /mi rnams kyi ni bde sdug dag /'khor lo bzhin du 'khor bar byed/ /ma mthong ba dag mdun du lhags/ /slar yang ma ④mthong ba ru song / /khyod kyi de ci khyod kyang ci/ /de la mya ngan su zhig byed/ /ji lta ji ltar shing dag ni/ /rgya mtsho che la mnyam ④'gro ba/ /dba' rlabs kyis ni so sor phye/ /de la mya ngan su zhig byed/ /blo gros che ldan khro bas shugs las rgyal/ /skye bo ngan pa khro bas mod la pham/ /pham pas pham par byas pa'i blo ngan dag /blo ldan dag dang lhan cig ci phyir 'gran⑤/ /pha bong 'bad pa chen po yis/ /ri yi rtse mor 'degs 0par nus/ /cung zad tsam gyis de skur ⑦ba/ /rang gi skyon yon de dang mtshungs / /mi gang bya ba ma yin pa'i/ /bya ba la ni sbyor byed pa/ /des ⑧ni nges par phung ⑨'gyur te/ /khyi'u ⑫'byen pa'i spre'u bzhin/ /rang gi phyogs ni yongs spangs nas/ /gzhan gyi phyogs la dga' ba gang / /de ni nges par brlag 'gyur te/ /rgyal po rab dmar ji bzhin no/ /mkha' la skar mkhan dag gis rtsis byas na/ /zla ba dang ni skar ma'i lam rnams shes/ /khyim na mi dang khyem thab log pa dag /114—1311

yid 'ong yin pa bde/ /'byor pa mnyam ①dga' yin mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'di/ /nad med chang 'thung ①khur par mtshungs/ /'gro ba'i dri ma chags pa 'dra ba med/ /gzhan la gnod pa phrag dog 'dra ba med/ /mdza' bo slong ①mo pa 'dra yod min te/ /gtong dang mnyam pa'i gnyen bshes gang yang med/ /shes rab dang mnyam mig med de/ /rmongs pa dang mnyam mun pa med/ /nad dang 'dra ba'i dgra med dedu/ /'chi ba dang mnyam 'jigs pa med/ /de bas shin tu mi bzad ⑤pa'i/ /'chi ba nges par 'byung 'gyur bas/ /'dod pa rnams la sems bzlog dul/ /dam pa'i chos la dga' bar gyis/ /grogs po 'di na ⑦nor de yod legs pas/ /yid bzhin nor khyed ⑧rdor 'gyur nor ma byed/ /spur long rgyan gyi dam par byed 'gyur ba//der ⑨ni 'di 'dra'i nor bu 'jig rten phung ⑩/ /gang zhig sa stengs ⑪'bru rnams dang / /gser dang phyugs dang nad med rnams/ /de dag kun rmis gcig mi ngoms/ /de ltar shes nas zhi bar gyis/ /'bad pas bsags pa'i nor la ni/ /yang dang yang du nyugs ⑫par byed/ /bkren pas bye ba ji bzhin du / /nor rnams sdug bsngal kho nar zad/ /'jig rten 'tsho ba brtan ⑫ma yin—/ /nor dang longs spyod brtan ma yin/ /bu dang chung ma brtan min gyi④/ /chos dang grags pa snyan pa brtanaske/ /rgyal po nor sogs ngoms pa med/ /mkhas pa legs bshad kyis ma ⑩ngoms/ /rgya mtsho chu yis ngoms pa med/ /'jig rten sdug la bltas mi ngoms/ /me la shing gis ngoms ⑩pa med/ /byis pa 'dod pas ⑫ngoms pa med/ /tshul khrims dag dang dul ba dang / /sems ni dul bar gyur pa dang / /gang zhig drang por zhugs pa dag /de la gnas 114—1315

rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi dag dang / /srang gi mtshan nyid dag dang mtshungs/ /cung zad tsam gyis mtho 'gyur zhing / /cung zad tsam gyis dma' bar 'gyur①/ /tsan dan gla rtsi ga bur gyis byugs kyang / /sgog skya'i rang bzhin dri nga mi 'dor ltar—/ /rigs pa'i gzhung lugs mang po rab bslabs kyang / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mtshan nyid 'dor mi srid/ /dam pa'i bu la gdong na padma med/ /smad 'tshong bu la glad nas rwa ma skyes/ /ji lta ji ltar log par byed gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar nal bu'i mtshan nyid yin/ /kha ma/sa smras pa'i tshig gzhan la/ /yid la sems pa'i bsam pa gzhan/ /kye ma yon po'i blo gros can/ /'di yi rang bzhin su yis sprul/ /'bad pas skyon ni len par byed/ /yon tan rtag tu spong bar byed/ /skyon len yon tan spong ba yi/ /skye bo ngan pa chu tshags 'dra//skye bo ngan pa ②sun phyung na/ /dam pa la yang yid mi rton/ /byes pa 'o mas kha tshig na/ /zho la'ang phu yis 'debs shing 'thung / /mtshan mo mtsho nang skar ma'i gzugs brnyan snang ba la/ /ngang pa padma'i rtsa bar 'khrul pas sun phyung ba//nyin mo pad rtsa mngon sum mthong yang za mi byed/ /brdzun smras sun phyung ①bden pa la yang dogs pa skye/ /bud med zas ni nyis 'gyur te/ /de yi g.yo sgyu bzhi 'gyur ro/ /ngo tsha dag ni drug 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags brgyad 'gyur zhes brjod do/ /sbyin pas ma yin rim gros min/ /mchod ༷pas ma yin bsnyen bkur min/ /brtan ⑤pas ma yin brtson pas min/ /kun du mi bzad bud med yin/ /mkha' lding dbang pos khyer ba'i tshe/ /pad dkar klu yis smras pa ni—/ /gsang tshig bud med la smra bdu/ /de yi srog ni de ⑦zad 'gyur/ /don dang chos ni rnam par nyams byed cing / /mtho ris dag dang thar pa'i 114—1322

dman pa mi mngon par/ /phyi ma'i dus na brgya 'gyur khyer①/ /rang nor spangs nas 'gro 'gyur bas/ /skyes bu sbyin pa gtong bar byed/ /shi na'ang nor ni mi 'dor bas/ /sbyin byed ser sna can 'drar shes/ /sbyin ②na dbul gyur dogs pa yis/ /bkren pa sbyin pa gtong mi byed/ /nges par 'jig snepa de nyid kyis/ /mkhas pas nor ni gtong bar byed/ /zas las zan gyi byed tsam yang / /slong ba rnams la cis mi ster/ /'dod dang rjes mthun 'byor pa yang / /gang gi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /las kyis 'byor pa med kyang gdung ba mi skyed rjokyi/ /'on kyang ci 'byor pa la sbyin pa gtang ⑤bya ste/ /lo ma me tog 'bras bu chu dang sman rnams ni/ /thams cad mtha' yas rjobasngo ba'i stobs kyis mtha' yas ⑦'gyur/ /sbyin dang spyod pas stong pa yi/ /nor des nor bdag yin na go/ /nor de nyid kyis bdag kyang ni/ /nor gyi bdag po cis ma yin/ /yab gcig ⑧'di ni las kyi sa/ /'di nas pha rol 'bras bu'i saske/ /'di ⑨ni gang zhig byas gyur pa/ /de nyid gzhan du nges par spyod/ /gzhan 'byor rigs dang gzugs dang nad med nyid/ /mthong nas 'dir ni ci phyir gdung bar byed/ /gal te 'di kun khyod 'dod bsod nams kyi/ /sa bon las ⑩ni 'bras 'byung ma thos ⑪sam/ /'byor pa yod kyang gtong med na/ /nye bar 'tsho bas ci byar yod/ /kim pa ka yi 'bras bu ni/ /chag ⑫kyang ltogs la ci byar yod/ /gang zhig gzhan la gnod pa med par sbyin gtong ba/ /'di yi longs spyod sna tshogs chu yis mi 'khyer zhing / /me yis mi tshugs rkun po rnams kyis 'phrog mi nus/ /de yi 'byor pa nam yang rab nyams mi 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig dmyal ba'i nad la ni/ /gso ba dag ni mi byed pa/ /sman med 114—1324

phyi dro'i bya ba snga ①dro bya/ /ji srid nad med lo tog skyes gyur pa/ /nad kyi ser ba chen pos ma brlag cing / /ji srid blo ni bya ba'i rjes 'jug ②pa/ /'di ni dam chos mnyan pa'i dus yin no/ /bong bu phyugs dzeel me tog phreng ba ci//dud 'gro phag la kha zas zhim po ci/ /long la snang dang 'on pa dag la glu/ /glen pa rnams la chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /ji srid 'dod chen ma gyur par④/ /de srid yon tan che nyid yin/ /'dod chen nyid la zhugs gyur na/ /yon tan btsun par ga la 'gyur/ /ji srid su la'ang mi slong ba/ /de srid dka' thub gzi brjid can/ /dpa' zhing shes ldan rigs mtho dag /skyes bu zhes kyang de srid brjod/ /dang po'i rtsom pa gang yin pa/ /'di ltar ngo mtshar che ba yin/ /zo chun bzo sbyar gyur pa ni/ /bud med kyi yang dbang du 'gyur/ /drang srong bu ni myur du shi yang rung / /rgyal po'i bu ni yun ring gson yang rung //rngon pa'i bu ni shi'am gson mi rung / /dam pa'i bu ni shi'am gson yang rung //de nas 'byung ba la gnas pa'i/ /mi yi blo ni 'phel bya'i phyir/ /gang gis bstan bcos shes gyur pa'i/ /legs par bshad pa bshad par bya/ /legs par bshad pa'i rang bzhin tshig /gang yang rung ba bsag par bya/ /tshig gi gnas skabs mchod sbyin la/ /nor med ⑤ci zhig ster bar byed/ /rig pa bslab rjodang dpa' bo dang / /gang yang gzugs bzang ldan bud med/ /gang dang gang du 'gro gyur pa⑦/ /de dang der ni dpal chen thob/ /rig par ldan dang rgyal po yi⑧/ /gang du'ang mnyam pa ma yin te/ /rgyal po rang gi yul na bkur/ /rigs ldan kun du bkur bar 'gyur/ /gzugs dang lang tsho phun tshogs shing / /rigs mtho rnams las skyes gyur kyang / /rgya skyegs 114—1326

gnyis phyugs/ /blun po yongs su spang bar bya/ /ma mthong tsher ma ji lta bar/ /tshig gi zug rngus gnod par byed/ /blun pos blun po mthong gyur na/ /tsan dan bas kyang bsel bar byed/ /gal te mkhas pa mthong gyur na/ /pha gsod pa ni lta bur sems/ /skye bo ngan la phan pa dag /byas kyang gang ①la'ang byas mi gzo/ /dam pa cung zad bkur na yang / /ji srid 'tsho bar rang dbang 'gyur/ /blun po chu yi ri mo ltar/ /gang zhig byas pa de myur 'jig /dam pa rdo yi ri mo ltar/ /shin tu chung ngu'ang brtan par gnas/ /skye bo ngan pa snyan smra yang / /'di la yid brtan rung ma yin/ /rma bya sgra snyan sgogs ②na yang / /zas su dug chen za ba yin/ /e ma skye bo ngan pa dang / /bad kan dag gi rang bzhin mtshungs/ /'jam po yis ni 'khrug 'gyur la/ /rtsub po yis ni zhi bar 'gyur/ /skye bo ngan dang gser dang rnga / /mi srun ①rta dang bud med dregasarjo/ /brdungs nas ⑤dul ba nyid 'gyur gyi/ /de dag legs byas snod ma yin/ /skye bo ngan dang lhan cig tu/ /dgrar gyur mdza' ba'ang mdzes ma yin/ /khyem dhini rtse bar byed pa 'am/ /lhag ⑦pa'ang mdzes par 'gyur ma yinaske/ /sbrul bas kyang ni mi srun sgegadug /sbrul gdug sman dang sngags kyis zhi/ /mi srun cis kyang zhi mi byed/ /mi srun pa yi nyes pa ni/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rjes 'jug ⑨la/ /gang zhig mi srun dang 'dres de/ /mi srun las kyang mi srun ⑩'gyur/ /pha yi spyod pa ma mthong yang / /bu mi/ rjes su 'jug byed de/ /ke ta ka yi shing las ni/ /skyu ru ra 'bras 'byung mi 'gyur/ /pha dang ma dang de bzhin spun/ /chung ma rjes mthun 'jug pa rnams/ /de yis sdig pa byas pa gang / /de ni mi des byas dang mtshungs/ /sa 'di rgya mtsho chen 114—1328
