ba'i tshul ni dka' zlog ①yin/ /bud med tshul ni dka' thub yin/ /de ltar ma yin rang bzhin ngan pa'i mi/ /byams la lan med gzhan bgyis ⑤phan byas brjed| /sdang bas gnod pa ji snyed byas gyur kyang / /brnyas ③thabs byas pa de yang chu bzhin 'thung / /tshe dang longs spyod gnyen bshes kun dar dkon④//de dag rgud pa shin tu rnyed par bee/ /de phyir sems ni ⑤dmas par gyur pa'i tshe//khā bzhin rjomi smra kha rog 'dug par bya⑦/ /gal te nor med bdag gi phyogs nyung la/ /mdza' bshes phyogs kyi stobs kyang chung gyur cing ⑧/ /dgra bo'i phyogs kyi stobs tshul ldan pa'i tshe/ /tshig ngan mi smra kha rog 'dug par bya/ /ya rabs tshul med khengs pas shin tu nga rgyal ⑨che/ /g.yo sgyu dad med khā ⑩bzhin shin tu mu cor smra/ /gzu lums phrag dog brkam dang khrel ⑩med ngo tsha bral/ /mi de bur gyur kyang ni gzhan bzhin ⑫spang bar bya/ /de lta bu yi dman zhing ngan pa de/ /mthon po'i sar mi drong zhing der mi bzhag /sa der bzhag kyang dregs dang khengs mi thub/ /dper na pags pa sngon po'i wa bzhin no⑫/ /skye bo rmongs pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /log pa'i chos la rab zhen pas⑫/ /'dod pa'i don des bslus 'gyur te/ /rus sbal so yis bya bslus bzhin/ /rab tu mi gzo'i spyoskye bo rnams/ /sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu dag la/ /dang blangs don du gnyer byed pa/ /gcan gzan ⑩gal sgor bcug ⑩pa bzhin/ /dregs pa log ⑫pa 'ga' zhig ni/ /rang gi skyon rnams ma bsams ⑪par/ /yon tan phra mos rab mgu ba⑫/ /khron pa'i sbal pa ji bzhin no/ /rmongs pa long ⑪ba 'ga' zhig ni/ /chos kyi de nyid ma rtogs par/ /log pa'i chos kyis rab mgu ba/ /blun po nor bu len pa bzhin/ /shin tu blun po la la dag /'chi 114—1337

ba'i rnam pa rab brjed nas/ /bya ba mang po rtsom byed de/ /bdud kyis bslus par rig par bya/ /'gro ba bzang po bzang mo la/ /gang zhig rab tu chags byed pa/ /srog chags me la mchong ba bzhin/ /'dod pas phung ①bar 'gyur ba ④yin/ /rta dang ma he glang po sogs/ /'ga' zhig de la chags byed pa—/ /'dod pa can gyi skyes bu yis/ /rmi lam nor rnyed bslus pa bzhin/ /sdig pa'i las la rab dga' zhing / /dge ba dran par mi byed la①/ /'jig rten dag la rab tu chags/ /dug dang 'dra ba'i skyes bu des/ /'dir yang sdug bsngal chen po can/ /phyi ma dhimanar med rab tu 'jigs/ /bar do'i srid par ⑤las rnams dran/ /gsal ba'i me long rab 'jigs pas/ /las kyi dge sdig rnam par 'phye/ /rang 'dod ⑦gnas su gnas dbang med/ /mi 'dod pa ru rnam par 'khrid⑦/ /las kyi rgyu 'bras mi slu sdeb/ /kho bos mthong gi stirnam pa 'am/ /gzhan yang rab tu grangs mang ltos/ /de phyir dam pa'i skye bo rnams⑫/ /rgyun du 'chi ba dran par bya/ /rang gis ci byas las rnams bgrang / /yud tsam pa yi tshe 'di la/ /thang cig 'dug pa'i blo can de/ /de ni shin tu 'khrul pa ste⑪/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi rdzu 'phrul bzhin/ /de phyir rtag pa'i sems mi bskyed/ /ngan song gsum po dran par bya/ /srog gcod la sogs lus kyi ni/ /nyes pa rnam par bsdam par bya/ /brdzun ⑫sogs ngag gi nyes pa dang ⑫/ / ma lus pa ni bsdam par bya/ /④de bzhin yid kyi nyes pa yang ⑫/ /ma lus rab tu bsdam par bya/ /de ni skyes bu dam pa'i tshul/ /rab tu tsha zhing grang ba yi⑩/ /dmyal ba nyi ma gcig ⑫bzhin dran/ /bkres skom dag gis rid pa yi/ /yi dwags dag ⑫kyang dran par bya/ /rmongs pa'i 114—1338

sdug bsngal rab mang ba'i/ /byol song blta ①zhing dran par bya/ /de rgyu rnam ⑤spang bde rgyu spyad/ /thob dka' 'dzam gling mi yi lus/ /de thob dus su ngan song rgyu/ /rab tu bsgrims te gcad ④par bya/ /'dir bdag mi yi lus thob nasaske/ /phyi mar dhismon lam 'debs byed pa/ /de ni blun po le lo can/ /ngan song gnas su rab 'gyod de/ /gro bzhin skyes kyis rdo ⑤'jog gi/ /yi dwags mthong ba ji bzhin no/ /'di yi tshe ni ma nges pas/ /di ring sang ngam zla ba 'am/ / lo yi durnam pas 'chi 'gyur te/ /de phyir dge la brtson par bya/ /dam pa'i chos la rab 'jug na/ /rigs dang bran ⑦mo lta bu dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po yang / /bran mo btsun par ⑧thub pas gsungs/ /dam pa'i chos la mi 'jug cing / /'jig rten khrel la mi srung ⑨ba/ /shin tu smad cing bshung ⑩'gyur te/ /bi ⑪ra li ba'i dka' thub bzhin/ /ri brag 'dom ⑫gang sogs yod zabs/ /de la'ang rab tu srung byed na/ /shin tu gting med gyur pa yi/ /g.yang sar ltung ⑫ba cis mi srung ⑫/ /yungs 'bru tsam gyi spyorma khung yang / /shin tu bsgrims te 'chos byed na/ /'tsho med tshal par gas ⑩pa yi—/ /rma de ci phyir 'chos mi byed/ /nyin par 'ga' ⑩zung tsam du yang / /zas skom gyis dbul mi bzod na/ /bar gyi bskal pa ⑫la sogs su/ /zas skom mi brgyong ⑪ci phyir bzod/ /rang lus dag la tsher ma yi/ /rtse mo'ang bzod par mi 'gyur na/ /gzhan gyi lus la mtshon dag gis/ /srog dang 'bral ba ⑥ci phyir bzod/ /rma 'bu spyodug srin ⑫shing srin dang / /sa bon myu gu sdong skyes me⑫/ /de bzhin ngan pa'i mi rnams ni/ /rang rten ④kho na phung ba bsgrub⑫/ /phyi ma shes pa mdzangs pa'i ⑪tshul/ /nyon mongs dgra thub dpa' 114—1339

bo'i tshul/ /chags pa med pa chos byed tshul/ /mkhas pa'i tshul ni rtogs pa yin| /rtogs pa'i tshul ni byed pa yin/ /skyo ba ①med pa sbyin pa'i tshul/ /tshul khrims tshul ni ma dpyas pa/ /bzod pa'i tshul ni chos nyid shes/ /brtson 'grus tshul ni 'chi ba dran/ /bsam gtan tshul ni g.yeng ①med yin/ /rnam par 'byed shes shes rab tshul①/ /sangs rgyas 'dod pa dad pa'i tshul/ /rtog pa chung ba rnal 'byor tshul/ /zang zing gnyen bral sgom mkhan tshul/ /phan sems che ba sgrin pa'i tshul/ /drang po'i tshul ni mi slu dhib/ /bag yod nyam nga med pa ni/ /de ni rgyal po'i tshul du bshad/ /de lta'i ⑤tshul dang ma ldan la0/ /dman zhing smad pa'i tshul byed pa/ /las kyi rgyu 'bras mi slu'i ⑦tshul//'og gi tshul ni 'di yin ⑧no/ /yon tan ldan la ser snas bcings/ /bslangs na khro ba dang bcas pa/ /sdug bsngal chen pos non 'gyur ⑨te/ /shu ma ra ⑩yi mi sdug bzhin/ /mnyam sogs dag la phrag ma dog /'dir yang sdug bsngal che 'gyur la/ /phyi mar rnam smin che 'gyur te/ /dper na gzhon nu wa dang 'dra/ /dregs med shin tu dul bar bya/ /kun la gsong por smra bar bya/ /khro med nga rgyal spang bar bya/ /kun la 'dzum zhing drang por smra⑩/ /don med ca co ⑫smra mi bya/ /'du ba mang po'i sar mi 'gro/ /chang sogs myos pa btung mi bya/ /ci 'dod sbyin pa gtang bar ⑫bya/ /bshes med me ⑫la byams par bya/ /dge ba'i chos la brtson par bya/ /khrims sogs blangs la bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar byas nas spyomang po'i mi/ /ngang gis bde ba thob ⑫par byed/ /da ni ⑩shin tu ngan pa'i mis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub tu nye/ /da ni ma spyobasngags ngan spyod dang / /log par lta ba ngan pa'i mi⑪ rmongs 114—1340

pa dag gis bcom ldan gyi/ /bstan pa'i ljon shing bcad kyis med/ /da ni snying rje med pa yis①/ /chos lugs bor zhing dzeerang bzo byed/ /brkam chags pha rol mi ①mthong bas/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnyal bugyis med/ /da ni gdul dka' ⑤ngo tsha med/ /sdig la dga' zhing tshul 'chos byed/ /sdig can rnams kyis thub pa yi/ /bstan pa'i zam pa bcag gis med/ /da ni mgo byegs nyams mi len/ /spyod 'chal smad pa lus la 'chos/ /ngan g.yo can gyis thub pa yisadhi/ /bstan pa'i tshong dus ⑦bcom gyis med/ /da ni khro dang nga rgyal dang / /rgyags chos byed cing rnyed la zhen/ /snyig pa sna tshogs byed pa'i mis/ /chos kyi gru bo ⑧bcag gis med/ /da ni thub pa'i bstan pa yang //cung zad tsam zhig lus par zad/ /thub pa'i bstan pa gang ⑨chen mtsho/ /ring por mi thogs skam par 'gyur/ /seng ge'i sgra yi bstan pa ni/ /dus kyi 'khor los rab bcom nas/ /myur ba nyid du 'jig par 'gyur/ /gang dag 'di 'dra'i dus bab tshe/ /bde 'dod rnams kyis phan pa'i don/ /de ni legs par brtag pa'i rigs/ /dus kyi 'khor lo ngan byed pa/ /ma rabs shes rab 'chal pa dang / /tshul can dag dang sten ⑩mi shes/ /nyes pa bsten zhing ⑪tshul khrims spang ⑫/ /dben pas 'jigs shing 'du 'dzi 'dod/ /mi mkhas bslab nyes slob dpon nor/ /gdug rtsub nga rgyal brnyas nga ⑫che/ /ngan pa'i mi la yid rton pas/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa ma rung ⑫byas/ /zhi zhing bde ba'i dus ni zad/ /gdug rtsub mi bzad ⑫dus ni byung / /shes rab can gyi ⑫mi rnams dang / /dbang gyur skye bo rnams ni zad/ /de lta'i ⑫dus rnams byung ba'i tshe/ /rang gi yul 'khor gnas spangs te/ /gzhan gyi spyongs su 114—1341

dman skyed ①de rigs te/ /phug la ①brten nas mun pa dang / /thang la zla zer 'bab par byed/ /ngan pa ji ltar 'phang mtho yang ④/ /rigs ldan rgud pas zil gyis gnon/ /rigs ldan nor bu nyams mdun dhidu/ /bcos ma'i nor bus gzi ma byin⑤/ /yon tan ldan pa'i grags pa dag /phyogs bcur grags pas sgra grags tshularjo/ /g.ya' dang ldan pa'i me long gis⑦/ /gzugs brnyan byung la dga' ba ⑧med/ /nyi ma rgya mtshor nub pa dang / /zla ba bri yang gzhan mi 'gyur/ /yon tan ldan pa rgud gyur kyang / /nam du'ang ⑨che ba nyid mi nyams/ /tshe dang lang tsho dag dang ni/ /me lce'i ⑩rtse dang chu rgyun gyi⑪| /'das pa phyir ni ldog pa ⑫med/ /mi srun ⑫go 'phang de bzhin no/ /mi rigs zhen pa'i mi srun ⑫dag /rigs pa'i gzhi la gnas pa— med/ /rul spyopa'i ro la za bas kyang / /tsan dan sdong po spong bar byed/ /ngan pa bdag ⑩bstod rang bzhin gyi⑫/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'dor mi srid/ /zla ba tshes na spyonges par ni/ /dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bor ⑪thogs/ /phal pa dag ni rlung bzhin du/ /gzhan gyi dri yi rjes su 'brang ⑥/ /skyes bu dam pa nyi zer bzhin/ /skyon gyis rtag tu gos pa med/ /khrims ldan gzhan la gnod spangs ⑫pa/ /rnam shes spangs kyang dga' bar byed/ /rgyud ⑫dang bral ba'i ⑫dbang po'i gzhu//sa dang nam mkha'i rgyan du 'gyur/ /mi srun ④gang zhig che bdag gang ⑫/ /rigs ldan des gang rgud ⑪pa gang / /'byor pa mi 'dra byed pa 'di/ /rang bzhin blun po ⑦cis mi gdung / /bdag nyid chen pos smad rigs dag⑫ /yongs bzung shin tu skyed ⑥kyang 'byung / /bzo bo mkhas pas 0shel sbram yang / /tshon gyis bsgyur na nor bur snang / /kha cig smra ba lhur len te/ /kha cig mi 114—1347

smra don yang sgrub①/ /'dam bu'i me tog 'bras bu med/ /star ka'i sde'abras bu me tog med/ /yon tan drang bas mi chog ste/ /skye bo'i gya gyu ①skyon min no/ /mda' drang bas ni rjogasod par byed/ /phub ni 'khyog ste ⑤lus kyang srung du/ /shin tu gtum yang drang ba ⑦bdam/ /ngan g.yo phub me rtswas g.yogs min/ /so ga'i ⑧sprin med nyi ma bas/ /sprin gyis ⑨mi gsal shin tu sreg⑩ /dpal 'go ⑪na ni blun po yang / /shes rig ⑫gsal ba'i skyes bur 'gyur/ /lang tshos ⑫rgyags pa'i 'dod ldan dag⑫/ /'jo ba sgeg pa ston par byed/ /zhi ba yi ni lus can las⑫/ /'jigs pa mi 'byung nges med de/ /mar me'i rtse mo dkar ba ⑩las/ /dud pa nag po cis mi 'byung ⑩/ / 'jigs 'byung gcig tu ma nges te/ /spyo'ajigs byed chen po zhig ⑪pa'i gzugs/ /zhi ba'i ched du cis mi 'gyur⑫/ /yon tan chu yis mi mdza' ba'i/ / 'gro ba'i me 'jil skyon phub ⑥min/ /snang ba kho nas mun pa ni/ / sel 'gyur min nam mun pas min/ /⑫blun pas don 'grub gang yin pa⑫/ /de ni ④bya rog ta lar mtshungs—/ /srin ⑫bus shing dag zos 0pa'i rjes/ /stes dbang yi ge snang ⑫ba bzhin/ /skye bo yon tan ldan pa dgaphy-i/ /mkho ba'i sgo nas phal cher nyams//ṣpe tso tshig gsal smra ba yang ⑫/ /gzeb kyi spyil bus srung bar 'gyur⑫/ /gdul bar bla ⑪ba'i dgra dag kyang / /sems can ches bsten ⑫gdul bar dka'—/ /chu thigs mtsho nang lhung ba ⑫dag /nyi mas skems par mi nus so/ /bdag nyid brtsams ⑪pa mthar phyin pa'ang ⑫/ /yang na ma brtsams ⑪rtsom mi byedaske/ /gang du thog bab 'joms byed cing ⑫/ /yang na 'bab par mi byed de⑫—/ /rtogs par bla yang ⑥blun pos ni/ /yon tan skyon dag ⑩'byed mi 114—1348

la min/ /mthu yis phongs ①pa'i phal pa dag /gzhan la rtsol zhing sde'agro ba'i tshe/ /rang gcod mi nus bdar dzeerdos kyang / /sta re rnon por bdar dubar byed/ /skye bo gcam pa ⑤pha rol gyi/ /thag ring skyon lta rang gi min/ /mig gis rang gi skyon mi mthong / /zla ba'i ra ri rtogs rjopar byed/ /skye ba med cing rin chen ④dang / /sel med brtan la dbye dga' ba'i⑧/ /nor bu 'bar 'dra'i dam (7pa dag /phran ⑩tshegs tsam gyis 'gyur ba med/ /gnyug ⑪thung rang bzhin yang ba dang / /mgu dka' khrel med khong rtsub pa'i/ /ngan pas mdza' bshes yid gcod byed⑫/ /mkha' la me ni rlung gis sbor/ /phan byed sa bon dam pa'i sar/ /btab 'khrungs ⑫mi srun tsha sgor ④min/ /til mar thigs pa chung ngus kyang ske/ /chu la snyoms kyi bye mas min/ /blo ldan dgra srog ⑩nyid 'joms kyi⑩/ /mi mkhas pa ni yan lag go⑫/ /seng ge khros nas ⑪mi gsod kyi/ / khyi khros ⑩nas ni rdo la snyegs⑥/ /'byor pa phan rtse ⑫gang dag gis/ /sems yang ba dag drod mi thub/ /ba rgyas sbrang bu 'dzin byed ⑫kyi//ma tang kā yis glang po ⑪min/ /mang pos reg par mi bzod pa'i/ /zer ⑫ldan bkra shis zla ba ⑪yang / /skyon gye rdul gcig bskyed pa ⑫na/ /yon tan brgya ldan mtshungs ⑫par byed/ / ngan pa 'tsho ba ⑫tshul 'chos pas/ /glags rnyed gzhan la 'tshe bar byed/ / lag 'gro zas su rlung za yang pha rol 'tshe ba mi gtong ngo / /mi srun mi yis ngan pa dag /skyon btags rab tu 'tshe rab byed/ /⑩pa yis mkha' la rgya btsugs nas/ /sbrang bu bzung zhing gsod par byed/ /yul gyi ⑪dug gis grong ⑫pa'i yid/ /rang bzhin ngan pa cis mi byed—/ /sha rul dri mi zhim pa dag /khyi ltogs kyis de ⑫cis mi len/ /skye 714—1350

skye ba dkon/ /'gro ba dpag tu med mod kyi/ /pha ma rnyed pa shin tu dkon/ /dam pa ring na gnas gyur kyang / /pho nya yon tan nyid byed de/ /ke ta ka yi dri yis ni/ /bung ba rang bzhin 'ong ba bzhin/ /rgyal po yon tan ldan pa gnyis—/ /mnyam zhing 'dra ba ①ma yin te/ /rgyal po rang gi yul na 'khur/ /yon tan ldan pa kun du 'khyar/ /dus ni ②yun thung rig pa'i rnam pa mang /gang zhig gces pa de ni bsten par gyis/ /yul ni shin tu dus ring gnas kyang nges pa kho nar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /'bral la khyad par gcig ①zhig yod na 'gro ba burang nyid spong mi byed/ /dbang med 'bral las yid la yongs su gdung ba mtha' yas skyed par byed/ /'di dag rang gis spangs ⑤na zhi ba'i bde ba mtha' yas 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dam pa min dang lhan cig gnas gyur kyang / /chu dang padma bzhin du 'dres ④mi 'gyur/ /dam pa thag ring dag na gnas gyur kyang / /zla ba ku mu da ltar dga' bar byed/ /'du 'dzi kun du spang bar bya/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs par brtson/ /nad kyis 'jig ④pa med pa ni/ /nyin gcig lo brgya bas kyang mchog /'dod pa kun du spang bar bya/ /gal te de spong ma nus na/ /thar pa dag la 'dod par gyis/ /de nyid de yi sman yin no/ /skar ma chen po mang du shar gyur cing / /sa yi rgyan gyur zla ba shar na yang / /gang tshe nyi ma nub na mtshan mor 'gyur⑧/ /nyi ma ma gtogs shar nub phyogs mi phyed—/ /gang zhig shar bar ⑨gyur na yang / /nyi ma med na gzi can med/ /nyi ma shar ba mchog yin gyi/ /gzhan dag shar ba ci zhig dgos/ /me tog gi ni mgo lcogs bzhin/ /dam pa'i 'gro ba gnyis yin te/ /'jig rten kun gyi spyi bkur ba'am⑩/ /nags nyid du ni dengs par bya/ /mi srun skye bo khungs ⑪114—1364

bzhin rab tu 'phel bar 'gyur/ /mi srun ①skye bo ma gus bran/ /ma dul ④rta dang chung ma ngan/ /brdungs na mnyen ①par 'gyur ba ste/ /'di dag legs bya'i snod ma yin/ /rgya mtshor duchar phab tshudon med do/ /'grangs la zas dubyin don med do/ /phyug la nor byin don med do⑦/ /dman la legs byas don med do/ /dam pa'i bu yi gdong la padma yod/ /smad 'tshong bu yi glang byanas dug lo skyes/ /ji lta ji ltar log par spyod par byed/ /de lta de ltar go 'phang 'da' bar 'gyur/ /sprin gyi grib ma skye bo ngan dang mdza'/ /rje bo ngan dang bdag po dman la brten/ /zil pa'i chu dang rtswa ⑨las 'bar ba'i me//drug po de ⑩dag chu yi chu bur mtshungs/ /sha skam dang ni bud med rgan/ /chang gsar zho ni 'chag ⑪ma thag /nyin phyed gnyid dang nam phyed zas/ /'di drug 'phral ⑫du srog 'phrog pa'o/ /mar gsar ⑫'bras chan 'o mar bcas/ /sha gsar bud med gzhon nu dang / /shing gi grib ma chu dron khrus/ /'di drug 'phral du stobs skyed do/ /sdug pa dang bral rang mis brnyas pa dang / /bu lon mang zhing ngan pa dag la brten/ /dbul por gyur nas mdza' bos spyoring du spangs/ /'di lnga me med par ni sreg ⑫pa'o/ /bogs med chong dang stobs ldan dag la 'tshe⑩/ /slong zhing 'gying la nor med 'dod la dga'/ /na chung sdug la tshig rtsub smra byed pa/ /'di lnga log par spyod pa'i skyes bu'o/ /gang zhig chos ni sbyin byed dang / /mi 'jigs sbyin dang kha zas sbyin/ /lus skyed pa dang gdams ngag sbyin/ /'di lnga phan 'dogs byed pa'o/ /rab tu byung nas slar log dang / /bud med khyo gsum mthong ba dang / /ce spyang rnyi ⑩las shor ba ste/ /'di gsum g.yon can shes par bya/ /sman pa ⑩kha zas ma zhu dang / /114—1369

chun bzor ni sbyar gyur na/ /bud med kyi yang dbang du 'gyur/ /dang po brtsams ①pa gang yin pa/ /de ni ngo mtshar che ba yin/ /gang zhig chen po'i spyir bkur ba/ /de nyid dman pas rtswa ④snyam sems/ /mkhas pas phyag byas mchod rten ni/ /khā yis stan ①du byed pa yin/ /ke ta ka yi 'bras bu ni/ /chu rnams dang bar byed mod kyi/ /de yi ming tsam brjod pa yis/ /chu rdul dang bar mi byed do/ /dam pa dang por khas 'che mi byed la/ /gal te dka' bas khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa ji lta bar/ /khas blangs de ni nges par sgrub par byed/ /dman pas gang tshe nor ni cung zad rnyed/ /'gro ba gzhan la brnyas pa'i nga rgyal ldan/ /dam pa nor gyi 'byor pa thob gyur kyang / /sā lu smin pa bzhin du shin tu 'dudarjo/ /shes rab dang 'dra'i mig med de/ /rmongs pa dang mnyam mun pa med/ /nad dang 'dra ba'i dgra med de//'chi bdag dang mnyam 'jigs pa med/ /de bas shin tu mi bzad pa'i/ /'chi ba nges par 'byung 'gyur gyi⑤/ /'dod pa rnams la sems zlog dul/ /dam pa'i chos la dga' bar gyis/ /yon tan can ⑦la rig pa yon tan 'gyur//yon tan med la de nyid skyon du 'gyur/ /chu bo'i chu ni shin tu dri med pa'ang / /rgya mtshor phyin na btung du mi rung 'gyur/ /bye brag phyed pa'i blo ldan yang / /bya ba gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /de la nyes dmigs mi 'byung ste/ /byung na'ang de yi ⑧slar spong byed/ /brtan zhing 'jam la tshig nyung gang yin pa/ /de la mi yis shin tu bag bya ste/ /nyi ma sprin stug ma ⑨nas byung ba yi/ /'od zer shin tu tsha bar 'gyur ba bzhin/ /na tshod gzhon yang nye bar zhi la dga'/ /mkhas par gyur kyang shes pa'i nga rgyal med/ /gzi brjid che yang bzod cing 114—1372

yid du 'ong ba gang zhe na/ /g.yo med kun du snying rjer ldan/ /sbyin par bya ba gang zhe na/ /byams pa'i sems dang yang dag ldan/ /sgog mar srog phyin gyur kyang ni/ /bdag dang mi 'bral gang zhe na/ /glen pa skyon ni ldan ①pa dang / /kun gnod byas pa mi gzo bluba'o/ /mchod par bya ba gang zhe na/ /legs pa rnams la 'dzud pa'o/ /tha shal du ni shes bya gang / /rtsom ①pa kun la mi brtan pa'o/ /'gro ba kun la ④thams cad las/ /nges par rgyal ba gang zhe na/ /skyes bu bden par smra ba dang / /bzod pa ⑤yang dag ldan pa'o/ /lhas kyang gus pas phyag bya dugang / /snying rje ④gtso bor byed pa'o/ /gang la skyo bar bya zhe na/ /mkhas pas 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon las/ /srog chags rnams kyi tshogs dag ni/ /gang gi dbang du 'gyur zhe na/ /gang zhig phan dang snyan smra dang / /dul bar spyod pa rnams kyis so/ /skyes bu legs par 'dod pa yis/ /gang la gnas par bya zhe na/ /mthong dang ma mthong bya ba'i ④phyir/ /bden pa'i lam la nges gnas bya/ /mya ngan 'gyur ba gang zhe na/ /'byor pa bzhin du ⑨zhen pa'o/ /glog ltar mi brtan gang zhe na/ /skyes bu dam pa phrad bsten pa'o—/ /bsngags par bya ba gang zhe na/ /gang zhig blo gros che ba dang / /shin tu nyam ⑪chung stobs med la/ /nus dang ldan zhing bzod byed pa'o/ /rigs kyi ri ltar mi g.yo gang / /rtsod dus skyes bu dam pa'o/ /'di na skyes bus ⑪rnyed dka' ba'i/ /bzang po bzhi ni gang zhe na/ /sbyin pa snyan smrar bcas pa dang / /shes pa khengs pa med ldan dang ()/ /bzod pa brtson 'grus bcas pa dang / /sems ni rnal 'byor ldan pa'o/ /dri med dris lan ⑫rin chen phreng ba ni④/ /gang gi mgul na legs par yod gyur ⑫na/ /de ni 114—1379

nyid gang la mi dga' ba/ /gzhan la kun du mi spyad do/ /rtsod pa ①smra ba phra ma ④dang / /blta min lta bar byed pa dang / /mdza' dang lhan cig khon ④gcugs dang / /dgra dang kun du mdza' ba spang bu/ /dam pa dag dang 'grogs pa dang / /mkhas dang lhan cig smra ba dang / /brkam chags med dang mdza' ba dag /byed na skyo bar mi 'gyur ro/ /bya dang byed pa la brten te/ /dus su dgra dang mdza' ba dang / /dus su mdza' dang 'thab pa yis/ /mkhas pas dus ni 'da' bar bya/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ⑤ni/ /thams cad rtogs pa nyid 'gyur ba'i/ /tsa na ka las ji skad dhibashad/ /rtsa ba'i don dzeeni rab bshad bya⑧/ /gzhan dang rtsod dang gzhan nor dang / /gzhan gyi bzhad ⑨gad gzhan bud ⑩med/ / gzhan gyi khyim du gnas pa dag /⑪nam yang bya ba ma yin no/ /phan byed gzhan yin na yang gnyen/ /gnyen yang phan med gzhan yin te/ /phan byed dgon pa'i sman dang ni/ /phan med lus skyes nad dang mtshungs/ /gang zhig phan la sbyor de gnyen/ /gang zhig gso ba de pha ⑫yin—/ /gang zhig bsgo ba nyan de bran/ /gang zhig skye ba de sa bon/ /gang zhig yid 'ong de chung ma/ /gang zhig bde byad de bu yin/ /gang zhig yid ches de mdza' bo⑫/ /gang du 'tsho ba de yul yin/ /khyim tshags mkhas gang de chung ma/ /gang zhig snyan smra de chung ma/ /khyem thob srog gcig ④de chung ma/ / khyem las mi 'phyo de chung maspyo/ /rtag tu khrus byed lus dris bsgos/ /cung zad za la nyung du smra/ / kun la rtag tu des pa ni/ /⑩lha mo de yin mi mo min⑩//rtag tu bkra shis dang ldan zhing / /rtag tu chos la dga' ba dang / / rtag tu khyo la spyogus byed cing / / rtag tu bzhin ni 'dzum pa dang / /⑪rtag tu ⑫snyan 114—1383

kyis—/ /rna ba la sogs ngoms mi 'gyur/ /①'tsho ba rang gi las dang chos kyis bsngags/ /rang rang gi ni chung ma la rtag dga'/ /dbang po dul zhing ②glo bur mgron la dga'/ /skyes bu dam pa'i khyem na thar pa yod/ /tsa na ka'i rgyal po'i ①lugs kyi bstan bcos las le'u gnyis pa'o// //gang zhig bstan bcos yongs spangs nas/ /mi brtan pa ni sgrub byed pa—/ /de yi brtan pa nyams 'gyur te/ /mi brtan rjonyams pa nyid du zad/ /zas kyi tshod las kha zas sbyin/ /bud med mchog la dga' nus shing / /'byor pa'i tshul las sbyin pa ste/ /dka' thub 'bras bu chung ma ⑤yin/ /rig byed 'bras bu sbyin sreg ste/ /thos pa'i 'bras bu tshul khrims dul/ /chung ma'i 'bras bu dga' dang bu/ /nor rmi du'abras bu spyad ⑦dang sbyin/ /bu mo rigs bzang shes rab ldan/ /gzugs ngan na yang blang bar bya/ /gzugs bzang ba la dul ba dag /'di ⑧'dra'i bud med ga la yod/ /dug las kyang ni bdud rtsi blang / /byis pa las kyang legs bshad ⑨pa/ /mi gtsang ⑩las gser bud med ni/ /rin chen rigs ngan las kyang blang / /rgyal po'i mdza' bo ⑪rtag pa min/ /sbrul la dug min ⑫gang yang med/ /gang du bud med skyes gyur pa'i/ /rigs la skyon med yod ma yin/ /bu mo rigs ni bzang la btang tsu)/ /bu ni rig (stepa la sbyar bya/ /dgra bo phongs pa nyid la sbyar// mdza' bo ⑫chos la sbyar bar bya/ /bran g.yog dang ni rgyan rnams ni/ /'tsham pa'i gnas su nges par gzhag /gtsug gi nor bu rkang par ni/ /gdags par rigs pa ma yin no/ /me tog dri dang kha dog ⑩ltar/ /dam pa'i tshul ni 114—1388

brtson—/ /rtag tu shis pa brjod la brtson/ /'di ni rgyal po'i mdun na 'don—/ /tshe yi rig byed la legs bslabs①/ /thams cad shes shing blta ④na sdug /ngang tshul bzang la bya ba mkhas/ /'di ni sman pa yin zhes bya①/ /blo ldan smra mkhas shes rab che/ /bden par smra zhing dbang po dul/ /bstan bcos thams cad legs mthong ba④/ /'di ni yi ge pa zhes bya/ /rigs dang ngang tshul yon tan ldan/ /bden dang chos la mchog tu gzhol/ /gzugs byad shin tu bzang ba ni⑤/ /rgyal po'i spyan mig ④yin par bshad/ /rang lugs ma 'chos durgyal la bsten⑧/ /rin chen thams cad yongs rtogs shes/ /sma ⑨ma bab cing rtsol ba can/ /dmag can ⑩yin par shes par bya/ /brda ⑪la legs par byang gyur cing ⑫/ /stobs ldan mthong na sdug pa dang / /bag yod nor ni che ba dag /sgo dpon chen por de bshad do/ /blo ldan shes rab che ba dang / /gzhan gyi bsam pa rtog mkhas shing / /brtan shā)la ji bzhin lan 'debs shing / /'di ni pho nyar shes par bya/ /g.yos kyi bstan bcos kun la mkhas/ /dge zhing snyan smra dbang po zhi/ /gtsang sbra che zhing yid brten rung / /'di spyoni phyag tshang yin par bshad/ /zhar ba zha bo ma ning dang / /sgur spyopo rgan po dbang po bsdams/ /'di dag btsun mo'i srung ⑩mar ni/ /rgyal pos nye bar sbyar bar bya/ /bran g.yog mchog dang tha ma dang / /bar ma mang po ⑫shes byas nas/ /de rnams las don gsum po la/ /ci rigs par ni sbyar bar bya/ /smra mang (nyekhengs dang le lo can/ /gdug 4)dang g.yon can phongs chos ldan/ /chog mi shes dang sme 3 sha za/ /bran g.yog rgyal pos spang bar bya/ /bdag po la 'khu spang bya zhing / /shin tu bkren pa'i mi 114—1393

srun yang ①/ /bkren pas bye brag mi shes pas/ /de bkren 'di gnod byed pa yin—/ /mi srun brkam ②chags phongs chos can/ /mu cor smra dang gus pa medaske/ /zhe 'gras pa dang sdig las can/ /rgyal pos yongs su spang bar bya/ / skyod dang smra ba ①lce gnyis dang / /gdug cing gcig tu mi srun dhidang / /rang bzhin ngan dang 'tshe bar dga'/ /gnod pa 'ba' zhig skyed byed yin/ /gal te rig pas brgyan gyur na'ang / /skye bo ngan pa spang bya ste/ /sbrul ni nor bus brgyan na 0yang / /'di na bu'ajigs pa mi skyed dam/ /gang zhig rtag tu brnags ⑦dka'i tshig ngan ni/ /smra zhing rgyu med par ni mi bzad khro/ /dug chen sbrul dang mtshungs par byed pa yi⑧/ /rang bzhin ngan la ⑨'jigs pa su mi skyed⑩/ /zab cing snyan dang ran ⑪par smra ba dang / /dbang dul ⑫bden la gzhol zhing rang dbang 'gyur⑫/ /dngos don legs shes yang dag don la mkhas—/ /bran g.yog phal cher rang dbang gyur pa yin/ /le lo med cing chog shes la/ /legs par gnyid log rab tu sad/ /bde sdug la mnyam brtan pa yi/ /bran g.yog 'jig rten na ④rnyed dka'/ /bzod med mgu bar dka' ⑫ba dang / /gtong dang bral zhing nor la dga' ba dang ⑩/ /smod ⑩byed stobs chung rab tu gdug⑫ /rten mi bdag pos spang bar bya/ /g.yo dang zol la dga' ba dang / /smra ⑪zhing skal bzang dang bral ba/ /med par 'jigs shing skrag gyur paspyo/ /rgyal pos 'di ni spang bar bya/ /zla ba drug gam lo gcig nas⑩/ /rgyal pos sdums ni bya ba yin/ /bdag nyid la ni dga' bsams la3/ /dgra dang nye bar 'thab par bya/ /glen pa'i 3las la sbyar ba ④ni/ /grags pa ngan ⑫dang don nyams dang / /dmyal bar ltung ba nyid dag ste//114—1394

pa'i zas bsten grogs bo mnyes par nyasnabya/ /me la mi 'gom ①g.yul la blta mi bya / /snyan ngan mnyan bya 1srog chags gnod mi bya/ /bya min mi bya khron pa bgom mi bya/ /rig pa blang zhing sbrul dang pa7rtse mi bya/ /ci nus sbyin zhing dman la bslang mi bya/ /bdag la mi bstod gzhan la smad mi bya/ /de nyid shes bya mtshan mo rgyu mi bya/ /zhags pa dang bral glang po'i gyerjes mi 'gro/ /lham med mi 'gro grogs med lam mi 'gro/ /sbyo byed blo ngan ring du spang bar bya /chung ma ma rungs spang zhing yid 'ong bsten/ /ma 'dris pa dang nam yang mthun mi 'jug /rgyal po'i bran mo 'dod spang ma'i ngag nyanaspyo/ /gang dang lhan cig zhe 'gras 77yong mi bya/ /be'u gzhon pa 87ring du spang bar bya/ /bud med rnams la nam yang yid mi brtan/ /chu bo rgal rmyedaka' rgya cher 'jug mi bya/ /chang 'thungs rkar ro shing mthor 'dzeg lho snami bya/ /don rnams bsgrub cing chos dang nor mi spang / /gang du bsrung ba med pa'i yul du yang ⑫/ /kun kyi gsang tshig nam yang mi smra ste/ / kun la yid brtan mi bya legs par brtag /⑫khar (rtarjer mi gtang skyes bu'i tsoṣpertsol la 'bad/ /gsang nyunyebor smra zhing 'byel med tshig mi brjodaspyo/ /glo bur lcag 15mdun dus su legs 'ongs brjod/ /mi dang lha dang bram ze rnams la mchod/ /bsod nams yul ni rtag tu bsten par bya/ /rtag tu khrus dang gos dkar gyon la 'grus⑪ / /ha cang bud med chags min — 7zhu nas za—1/ /shes ldan gang zhig de ltar byed pa ni/ /'tsho ba nad med tshe ring shes par bya/ /ma su rakṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las le'u dang po'o// //114byed1416

dag ma lus par/ /thams cad yongs su shes gyur pa/ / des ni blang dor dpyad pa yis/ /①'jig rten 'jig rten shes pa yin/ /gang dang gang la nor spyoldan pa'i/ /skyes bu las la chags 'gyur baspyo/ /gang dang gang la dga' ba'i tshig /de dang de yi yon tan brjod/ /yid mi ches la yid mi brtenakru —/ /yid ches lhag par yid brtan min/ /yid ches pa las 'jigs pa 'byung / /rtsa ba las kyang gcod par byed/ /'byung po kun la yid mi brtan/ /kun la yid ches bya ba'ang min/ /gang thugi rang bzhin sba bya zhing / /gzhan gyi skyerang bzhin shes par gyis/ /gzhan gyi bud med dug yin te/ /de bzhin chung ma gzhan 'gro dang / /gnyis po de la yid rton pa'i/ /mi rnams 'chi sgor bsnyen kyepa yin/ /bud med rgyal po sbrul rnams dang / /kha don dudag dang dgra rnams dang / /tshe dang longs spyod dag la ni/ /shes ldan rnams kyis yid brtan min/ /rig pa 'dod pas mkhas brten kyebya/ /shes par gyur pa ⑫gzhan sten ⑪byed/ /de bas las rnams thams cad niskye/ /lus pa med par bslab par bya/ /sdig pa can la yid mi brtan/ /blo ldan bdag ces zer yang yin⑫/ /gang phyir de la 6yid ches min/ /de yi 'tsho ba nyams par 'gyur/ /gshin rje gshed po /shā'achi ba dang / /sa 'og rgya mtsho ( snagling rnams dang / /spu yi ⑫so dug sbrul dag nyunani/ /mi bsten ⑫phyogs gcig bud med yin/ /dgra yi phyogs byed spang bar bya/ /bdag la dga' ba yongs su bsdu—/ /kun la blo ni yod pa ste/ /yun ring blo ni dka' ba yin nga / /mig 'byed mig 'dzums 6tsam yang rung / /dgra la mngon sum bya ba min/ / smod pa na yang tshu'on pa bzhin/ /dus bab ral gris bcad bzhin bya/ /114—1421

gang du chu yod ngang pa gnas/ /chu skams mtsho ni 'dor bar ①'gyur/ /chu yis gang na phyir — snaganas bzhin/ /ngang pa lta bu'i grogs mi brtan①/ /rgyal po smad 'tshong ma dang ni/ /de bzhin nye du dman ④ pa dang / /g.yog 'khor rnams la rtag tu yang / /ha cang gdung par mi bya'o/ /gang gi durgyu las mya ngan dang / /dar 6dang sdug bsngal nyid dang ni/ /lus kyi ⑦gnod byed rtsa ba de bye / /gcig gam cung zad tsam yang rung / /mkhas pas spang 67zhing dor bar bya/ /gser ni rnam bzhis brtag bya ste/ /bdar the) bcad bsreg dang brdung bar bya3yi/ /de bzhin rnam bzhis skyes bu brtag /thos dang tshul khrims rig la sogs8/ /thams cad shes shing rig par bya/ /kun la dogs bya dus shes kyis/ /'jig rten sems ni bsrung bya ste/ /tshig rnams kun rmis yid ches bya/ /bdag gi 11gsang tshig gzhan mi ma / / ma su rakṣas byas pa'i lugs kyi bstan bcos las ⑫le'u bzhi pa'o// //blon po 1miblo ni phun sum tshogs/ /bstan bcos kun la 'jigs med cing / /dbang 1rtemadzod stobs dang ldan pa ni/ /ma bsad der ni phyir gsod ⑫ 'gyur / /yid ches skyes bu 'chi 'gyur te/ /spyig ⑪ ma'i 'bras bu byung ba bzhin / /yid ches zhags pas gsod 'gyur te/ /nags na gnas pa'i ri dwags bzhin/ /mig rtsa dmar zhing tshig 'jam smra/ /dga' bas sems can kun dang mthun/ /don rnams kun la gya gyur ⑦ smra/ /gzhan tshig dag mel 'jig rten smod/ /de ni g.yon can spyod lam ste/ /de snyid ⑫nyes pa chen po yis / /sdig pa nyi che'i tshogs bsags ( 3nas/ /grong gi tshogs de bzlog bya 114—1422

ltar dbang po la sogs pa'i/ /me ni lha rnams kun gyi kha/ /de bzhin rgyal po'i blon po yang / /yul 'khor rgyu dang mi rgyu'i kha/ /brtan zhing zab mo'i blo dang ldan⑨/ /mdangs ldan chos dang bstan bcos tso7/rig /dul zhing bden par smra ba dang / /rgyal po'i 'khor la phan par sems/ /rigs btsun rgyud ni mnyen pa dang / /bla ma la ni gus nyan dang / /skye dgu ①rjes brtser ldan pa yi/ /rgyud ④byung de ni rgyal sras yin/ /rgyal po snying rje ⑤phan sems ldan—/ /bla ma'i skyon ni sbed pa dang / /g.yul 'jug slar yang mi ldog cing / /bde dang sdug bsngal mnyam par shesatro/ /rigs dang tshul khrims phun sum tshogs—/ /chos lugs 'chad pa mkhas pa ste/ /de bzhin dul ⑦dang dad pa dang / /grims pa rgyal por rab grags so/ /tshig gsal blo ni phun sum tshogs//lugs kyi bstan bcos dag la mkhas/ / ngang 'jam dpyod dupar byed pa ste/ /rgyal po'i blon po de 'dras bya/ /yid gzhungs tsu 7 tshig gsal shes rab ldan/ /gzhan sems nye bar mtshon nus dang / /brtan zhing ji skad bsgo bzhin smra/ /rgyal po'i pho nya de 'dras byas/ /rig ⑩byed yan lag de nyid shes/ /bzlas brjod sbyin sreg mchog tu ⑪brtson/ /rtag tu shis pa rjod ⑫byed pa/ /shes rab ldan de mdun na 'don/ /sgra rig rtsis kyang shes pa ste/ /yi ge byang zhing lag pa myur/ /yid gzhungs tshig ni gsal ba dang / /grags dang sbyin ldan yi ge pa/ /yi ge byang zhing sgra la mkhas/ /sgra yi mtshan nyid rtogs byed cing ⑫/ /dri za bzhin du dbyangs mkhas te/ /de 'dra'i klog mkhan bsko ④bar bya/ /brtan zhing dbang por 7 rjes su 'os/ /shes rab che zhing legs nyes rtogs/ /gtsang zhing rgyal po'i sku phyed brtenal/ /de 'dra skochad pa gcod byed ⑫yin/ /114—1427

can kyang ni ①de bzhin no/ /sen mo khrag mdog mchog gi ②dbang phyug ste/ /snum pa legs pa zangs mdog rgyal por 'gyur/ / rgya mtshos bstan pa las mtshan gnyis pa'o// //1mthe bong nas bzung mthil kyi sha rgyud ni/ /snyoms pa ④mdog bzang ring ba bde bar 'tsho/ /thung ngu mdog ngan mtho dman ldan pa ni⑤/ /bsam ngan kun la gnod cing bde ba med/ /rkang pa pag ⑥gi lta bu yod pa ladhi/ /rtag tu gzhan gyis 'ching bar 'gyur ba yin/ /mnyam snyems pas ni khyabade ba thob par byed/ /bol tshigs ma he lta bu phag bzhin no⑨/ /bol tshigs rdo rje lta bu rtag tu sdug /bol tshigs rta yi lta bu () dbang phyug thobatuspre/ / rgya mtshos bstan pa las mtshan gsum pa'o// //⑫byin pa ri dwags lta bus spe5 rgyal por 'gyur/ /ce spyang lta bu'i byin pas sdug bsngal 'thob/ /byin pa sbom pos ④mchog gi dbang phyug thob⑫/ /byin pa sgom po ring po gang gis kyang ⑩/ /rtag tu 'gro ba 'ba' zhig 'thob ⑩par byed—/ /byin pa phag pa lta bus ⑩longs spyod med/ /byin pa pho rog lta bus ⑪sdug bsngal thobarjo/ /byin pa dom mam spre'u lta bus ⑥'ching / /seng ge stag gi byin pa 'dra ba las/ /pha rol grags pa ⑤ nor rnams mang por rngo steldan/ /ba spu re re skyes pa rgyal por 'gyur/ /gcig gnyis skyes pa nor gyi bdag ④por 'gyur/ /gsum bzhi yan chad gang yang spyornyed pa med/ / rgya mtshos bstan pa las ⑪mtshan bzhi pa'o// //114—1435

shing skom/ /tshe ring lo brgya 'tsho yang sdug cing gson/ /rgya mtshos bstan 1pa las mtshan brgyad pa'o// //nu ma mtho ba snum zhing snyoms pa las/ /bde zhing bzang po'i mtshan gyes brgyan pa yin/ /brang zheng sgoms pa zab pa bde bar 'tsho tshe ring lo brgya 'tsho zhing longs spyod cheglu/ /sha rgyas che zhing kyezlum pa rgyal por 'gyur/ /gdong pa sha med mi de sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /dbang phyug stag shedang seng ge 'dra bas thobakhu/ /sde yi bdag dang dpon po thob thupar 'gyur/ /seng ge'i rgyab can 'dud cing tshukun gyis mchod/ /rta yi rgyab can sprid sdug phyed sgomar spyod/ /shin tu rgyab gzhung ring ba gnyen dang bcas/ /rtag tu bde bar skyong zhing rang don med/ /rgya mtshos bstan rngupa las mtshan dgu pa'o// //snying gar spu dang bcas pa bde bar 'tsho/ /spu dang bral yang lkubade bar 'tsho bar byed/ /spu snyoms cung zad skyes pa mkhas par 'gyur/ /spu gcig skyes pa phyug por 'gyur bar bshad/ /gnyis dang gsum du skyes pa ngan par bshad/ /ser skya sngo nag sprin gyi mdog can dang / /ldong ros zla ba'i kha dog padma dang / /'dra ba de la nyulngargyal po'i mtshan mar khu'adod/ /ser skya nyi ma 'char ba'i ⑫kha dog can/ /sa skyong rgyal po byed par 'gyur ba yin/ /rgya mtshos bstan rngu pa las mtshan bcu pa'o// //glang chen lta bur lus po byin du rgyas/ /bde bar son ⑫pa bzang po'i 114—1439

chos dang tshul khrims 'dzin par byed pa yin/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan 'khor lo zla ba dang / / de 'dra gang yod 1snas yi bdag por bshad/ /gyen du ri mo gcig pa 'bangs kyi sribadag /zla phyed 'dra bas dbang phyug thob par byed/ /gyen thur 'phred la ri mo mang po can/ /sdug bsngal 'dzin pa'i ༷ ༄skyes bu'i mtshan ma yin(pya/ /ri mo ring po slob dpon byed par 'gyur/ /mgo bo gdugs 'dra mi yi bdag ⑤por 'gyur/ /dpral ba tog por mthon tsanas rno ba la/ /ltogs shing rtag tu nor med dbul por 'gyur/ /mgo bo glang chen lta bu ④rgyal po 'dra⑧/ /dbang phyug du ma'i bdag po byed par 'gyur/ /mgo bo grum pa lta bu skyes pa ⑨dang / /rdul dang skra dang ldan pa'ang de bzhin no/ /rdul can chen po mthug por skyes pas rmye/snyug /srab mthug stoms pa 11skyes pa bde bar 'tsho/ / legs pa rtsa ba snyoms pa 15 ring thung med/ /de 'dra mi yi /sadabang phyug thob par byed/ /rgya mtshos bstan pa las mtshan bco lnga 7skyes pa'i mtshan bstan pa rdzogs so// //bud med mtshan rnams bstan kyis mnyan pa/snyepar gyis/ /padma lta bur dmar ba snum po ⑩dang / /rkang pa chung ba'i bud med bde bar 'tsho⑩ /'khor lo gdugs dang padma rgyal mtshan dang / /ral gri 'dra ba'i ri mo gang yod pa/ /rgyal po'i btsun mor 'gyur bar rgya mtshos bshad/ //5rkang pa'i sor mo'i 'og tu gyen thur la/ /ri mo yod na dpon po'i chung mar 'gyur/ /rkang pa srab mo che na g.yog tu kṛbye 'gyur/ /rkang pa skams pa ltogs par 'gyur ba yin—/ /'gro na bya bran lta bu'ang de bzhin du 7/ /de la rang gi rigs dang 114—1445

ste ba zab pa skyes pas phongs 1pa med/ /padma ge sar lta bu'i lte ba can/ /bde bar 'tsho zhing bzang po'i mtshan du bshad/ /lte ba mtho ba rgyas pa rdul dang spu / /med pa sdug bsngal mang po 'dzin par 'gyur1 / /sha skams ring po rdul dang spu yis gang / /legs pa med pa 1gang zhig 'jigs par skyes④ / /glang chen 'gros dang ba lang ngang pa dang / /rma bya ṣpe lha'i 'gros can bzang po'i mtshan/ /'gro zhing smra dang 3ce spyang ska/da can ni/ /bde spong sdug bsngal chen 67po 'dzin par byed/ /rkub tshos rtsa yis gang dang mdud ⑦pa can/ /bud med khyo dang bral bar chags zhi pa yin/ /tshul khrims gnyis pa de ni smad 'tshong 'gyur/ /gsus pa chung na bud med smad 'tshong 'gyur/ /gsus pa sha khyeyis gang ba rtsa te dang bral/ /rtag tu ltogs shing nor med sdug bsngal 'gyur⑪/ /gsus pa gtsang zhing snum pa legs pa ste⑫/ /nu ma g.yas pa rgyas pa bu dang bcas//g.yon pa mtho na bu mo 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'khyog ⑫ cing yo ba bu dang bral bar 'gyur / /⑩skams dang rtsa ba yo bar 'gyur rtsab la/ /rtse mo skams pa sdug pa'i mtshan ma ste/ /de yi khyo 'chi bu dang bral ba yin/ /nu ma rgyas pa sha yis gang ba yi/ / rab tu dal rgyas pa ni ⑫mdangs dang ldan/ /de la bu dang nor dang bu mo 'byung / /rgya mtshos bstan pa las mtshan bzhi ⑩pa'o// // sked pa sgur rtse5ba gzhu 'dra g.yog mor 'gyur/ /rked pa gyong po khyo po 'chi bar 'gyur/ /sha skams rtsa yis gang ba srug par 'gyur/ /rked ⑪pa sru can shu ba 'dra bas gang / /de la sdug bsngal chen po thob par 'gyur/ /bya 114—1448

yan lag bcu yi cha dbye dang / /sdug dang mi sdug shes bya dang / /tshad shes bya dang zas spyor ba/ /mdzes dang mtshan gyi le'u dang / /de bzhin kha dog shes bya dang / /zhur mdangs 7dang ni thig le brtag /sha ra'i mdog ni bzang ngan dang / /'dren ma rgyal po'i bzhon pa dang / /mig brtag pa dang so brtag pa/ /gtsug dang na tshod shes bya dang / /tshe shes pa dang bcas pa dang / /dri dang skad gsang 3)brtag pa dang / /'gros dang lus 'phel cho ga dang / /rgyug pa brtag dang gra ma can/ /nyes pa che dang snying stobs brtag /gzi mdangs brtag dang rigs brtag dang / /ston ka pa dang nyo 'tshong 1bcas//de ltar gnas ni dang po yi/ /le'u'i rim pa gnas pa yin // //④ dri 57ba chen po nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgo nga las byung dang / /rmen bu'i le'u gsum pa ste/ /nad shes bya ba rnam gsum dang / /yid bde yid mi bde shes dang / /rlung 'khyel 'khrul pa shes bya dang / /rlung 'khyil gtugs pa shes kyebya dang / /de bzhin lto ba rgyas pa dang / /rtsub par 'khyel ba'i le'u dang / /de bzhin gcin 'gags gso ba dang / /ri dwags ltar 'khyil ma 'dres 'khyel/ /rlung gi rmu ⑦rdzing gso ba dang / /de bzhin khrag gi gcin nad dang / /ko ra du shas gnod gyur dang / /snum 'khyil ba dang rnam 'khyil ba/ /khrag 'khrugs nad ni gso ba dang / /khrag 'khrugs nad gzhi bzhi las gyur/ /khrag 'khrugs rjes la gso ba dang / /'jeng dang rkang nad gso ba dang / / skye 'bru snadabugs mi bde gso dang / /dbugs mi bde ba lud pa can/ /sna rnag dang ni mngon par tsha/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan rims/ /'dus pa las gyur rims gso dang / /dus ni go bzlog las byung dang / /snad pa las gyur 114—1498

rims dang ni/ /yid kyi rims ni gso ba dang / /de bzhin 'khru ba mang po dang / /sman khu'i ①gong bu'i sbyor ba dang / /sbeg pa brtag pa'i le'u dang / /de bzhin rnga ④ma'i nad gso dang / /gzhang byung ba yi gso ba dang / /khrag dang mkhris pa gso ba dang / /so lhag byung ba gso ba dang / /'ug pa'i rkang 'dra'i le'u dang / /gdug pas zin pa'i mtshan nyid gso/ /smad pa'i mtshan nyid can le'u/ /dug gi shugs ni shes bya dang / /de bzhin dug gis zin gso ba/ /dug mdas 1phog pa zhes bya ba/ /gnyis pa'i gnas su bsdus pa yinaske/ /mngal chags zhes pa'i le'u dang / /de bzhin lus kyi rnam dbye dang / /lus bskyed pa dang rtsa yi tshogs/ /yul dang tsha sogs bstan pa dang / /'phel dang 'bri ba shes bya dang / /ro drug gi ni bdag nyid dang / /nang gi bdag nyid can byung dang / /bya dang bya min brtag pa dang / /'dir ni zas skom cho ga dang / /de bzhin ljang pa'i ro yi tshogs/ /gso ba'i yan lag dbang byas dang / /long dang lkugs sogs bstan pa dang / /de bzhin skrangs pa 9gso ba dang / /gzhan yang rma gnyis le'u dang / /zug rngu khong brlag skyegadon pa dang / /zug rngu dbyung ba'i le'u dang / /spubs kyi rma ni gso ba dang / /de bzhin chag ⑥grugs gso ba dang / /chu bur gso ba nyid dang ni/ /rgod ma'i mtshan nyid brtag pa dang / /rlung nyen mngal gyi nyes pa dang / /mngal du shi ba'i nad gso dang / /ba la'i til mar dang bcas pa /le'u'i rim pa 'chad rnams kyis/ /gnaṭa/ ni gsum pa yin par bshad/ /gso ba'i gnas kyi le'u ni/ /sems khong chud par byed pa dang / /ni ra ka yi nad gso dang / /rgan stind bye ba med pa nyid/ /a ba tang khyeka'i gso ba dang //114—1499

lnga gnyis dang bcu bzhi gnyis/ /tshes brgyad dang bcas (1sa 'gul dang / /bu btsas shing drung nyid dang ni/ /mi gtsang bas ni khyab gnas dang / /bdag nyid mi gtsang ba nyid dang / /nad kyis sems ni rmongs pa dang / /rlung ni chen po rgyu ba dang / /de bzhin 'brug sgra sgogs pa'i tshe/ /'di bslab pa ni spang byas la/ /bu yis bstan bcos gzung ①bar bya/ /bstan bcos gzung ba ①byas nas ni/ /bstan bcos don ni gzung ④bar gyis/ /bstan bcos don ni gzung ⑤byas nas/ /de 'og las la goms par gyis/ /bstan bcos shes pa 'ba' zhig la/ /las kyi bya ba tsam co mthong ba/ /gso ba'i las la 'jug par ni/ /de dag gnyi ⑦ga don med 'gyur/ /gso ba'i las la 'jug pa na⑧/ /khyod kyis rta ni rtag tu skyongs/ /mi bzad ge nad kyis nyen na yang / /khyod kyis spang bar mi bya'o/ /rta gang gsor ni mi rung ba/ /de yang rigs pas gso bar bya/ /ma gsos na ni nges par 'chi/ /gsos kyang nges pa med gyur pa'i/ /nad kyis gdungs par gyur pa gang / /nad ni gzhan la 'go bar 'gyur/ /bstan bcos las de spang bar bshad/ /spang tshul de yang nga las ⑩nyon/ /de ni rta bres las ring bar/ /srung 7ma dang bcas gzhag par bya/ /na ba'i rta ni gang yang rung ⑫/ /gtan spang ba ni rigs ma yin/ / nad dang sbegs spyodang rgas pa'i rta/ /gtan spang ④bram ze gso tshudang mtshungs//rta ni mtshan nyid ngan gyur pa/ /nyo ba'i dus su blang mi bya/ /gang zhig rang gi khyim du skyes/ /bram ze gzhan yul pa la sbyin/ /ltas ngan byung bar gyur na ni//'di nyid sbyin pa gtang ⑩bar bya/ /mi 'tshe ba ni tshe skyi ⑫mchog /sems can la brtag spyobartse bya zhing ⑫ / /de bas ci tsam gso nus pa/ /de tsam zhig 114—1505

rta las mchog gyur yod ma yin/ /rta yi mchod sbyin dag la ni/ /skye dgu'i bdag gis longs spyod cig /de bas mchod sbyin thams cad la/ /de ni spyad ①bya nyid yin no/ /de phyir shin tu gtsang bas na/ /kun la rjes su gnang ba ②yin/ /de phyir tshangs pa ma gtogs pa/ /thams cad kyi ni zas ma yin / /rta yi mchod sbyin las lhag pa'i/ /dag byed mi la yod min pas/ /rta ma gtogs par sa gsum na/ /bkra shis mchog gzhan yod ma yin/ /rnag thu can myur 'gro lam las rgyal/ /'gros legs 'phrog byed las rdzogs ④dang / /mgyogs dang mgyogs 'gro myur 'gros can/ /dpal mo'i bur snyeyang bshad pa yin—/ /'jig rten na ni sna che bas/ /de ni sna can zhes byar bshad/ /rtag tu 'gro bas mgyogs 'gro yin/ /lam du rgyal bas lam las rgyal/ /'gros legs ldan pas 'gros can yin/ /dbang med khyer ⑥bas 'phrog byed de/ /las rnams sdogs par byed nus pas/ /las rdzogs zhes ni tshangs pas bshad//mgyogs pa dang ni mgyogs 'gro dang / /de bzhin myur 'gro can zhes pa/ /de ni mgyogs pa kho nar bshad/ /'di dag nges tshig tshul yin no/ /rta ni dpal mo'i bu yin pas/ /dpal mo'i bu zhes bshad pa yin/ /mtshan dang rigs ni bzang ba dang / /dpa' bos bzhon zhing byang ba yi⑦/ /rta ni stong gis sa bzhi nudag /ma lus pa las rgyal bar nus/ /mtshon 67thogs pa yis mi thub pa'i/ /gnas der stobs che ba yi rtas0 / /'phral du rgyal bar nus pa tsho7yin / /de phyir khyed kyis de la ni/ /shin tu gus shing brtse bar bya/ /rgyal po sman pa'i chos don dang ⑩/ /phun tshogs pa yang nyu1gzhan las min/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las nges pa'i tshig gi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //114—1507

sha li ①ho tra blo gros che/ /rta yi gnas na 'dug pa la/ /legs thos thos pa phun tshogs pas/ /slar yang pha la dris gyur pa/ /rta ni ci ltar byung bar gyur/ /mchod sbyin 'tsham pa ci ltar 'gyur⑤// /de ni dang por rgyal po dag /gang gi bzhon pa nyid du 'gyur3/ /de yi rigs bzhi ci lta bu/ /de lta bur ni ci ltar 'gyur ④/ /ci yi phyir ni de 'drar 'gyur⑤/ /de dag shes par 'tshal lags so/ /de yi tshig ni thos pa dang / /sha li ho tras smras gyur pa/ /'di na rgyal po'i chos kyi mchog /sa rnams yongs su skyong ba yin / /de yang dpung gis byed par nus/ /dpung gi khyemachog ni rta rnams yin / /de phyir rang don la mkhas pa'i/ /rgyal po'i chos don 'dod don du//yang spuye rnam pa thams cad du/ /'bad de rta rnams bsrung bar bya/ /chos dang grags 'dod sman pa ni/ /bstan bcos mkhas gyur pas kyang bsten/ /de bas de rnams lha dang ni/ /mi ni ji ltar byung ba bshad/ /rigs dang nye ba'i rigs dang tshe/ /na tshod shis dang mi shis dang / /gtsug dang gdong dang thig le dang / /'tsher dang 'gros kyi rim pa dang / /mtshan ngan gnyen po mchan khung dang / /'byung dang bzhon pa'i bya ba dang / /nad rnged nad ni rgyas pa dang / /rna kyeb rnams kyi sman dang ni/ /de bzhin sman ni byung ba yi/ /go rims ci 9bzhin nyid dang ni/ /spu mdog mdog 'dres khyad par dang / /spu mdog dag dang mig dag dang / /rang bzhin snying stobs dag dang ni/ /ston ka skyes pa'i mtshan nyid de/ /'di dag thams cad mdor bsdus nas/ /khyed la legs par bshad par bya/ /lha rnams kyis ni 114—1508

gyur pa/ /brang na gnas pa rgyal rigs te/ /g.yul ngor sra bar shes par bya/ /lte ba brla yi rje'u rigs te/ /rkang pa ①'dzag pa dmangs rigs yin/ /der ni g.yon ngos rgod ma ste②/ /g.yas ngos kyis ni rta phor bshad/ /'di rnams phan tshun 'dus pa ni/ /rigs bzhi dag tu bshad pa yin/ /de ltar rta rnams yang dag byung 1/ /yid ltar mgyogs zhing ④mdog ldan te⑤/ /mdog gcig rjomadog ni 'dres pa dang / /sna tshogs mdangs kyis phye ba dang / /thig le can dang kha dog mnga'⑦/ /mtshan ma can dang zhur ba dang / /rkang dkar rdog ma mun dza 'u 'dra/ /rgyal mtshan dkyil 'khor 'dra ba dang / /rnga rngog mdog ni mang ba dang / /khra bo thig le phra ba dang / /'dams rngumadog se ba nyid dang ni/ /dkar la rngog ma gnag pa ste/ /phal cher kha dog sna tshogs shing / /ba spu snum zhing bzang ba dang / /tshad dang ldan zhing mig bzang la/ /ro stod mtho bar gyur pa dang / /dbus phra gsus ṅku khyim chung ba dang / /mchu legs brang zheng yangs pa dang / /rngog ma rked ⑪ pa rmig pa bzang / /pags srab spu mtshams phra ba dang / /yid du 'ong zhing phum phum bzang / /snying stobs ldan zhing rkang mdog mthun/ /lus las skyes pa'i gshog pa bzhi⑫/ /nam mkha' 'gebs pa lta bu dang / /yan lag dang ni nying lag rnams/ /lha yi char ldan gzi brjid che/ /dpal ldan gyur ⑫pa dpal mo'i bu/ /tshangs pa'i mchi ma las byung mgyogs/ /me yis gdungs pa las gyur pa'i/ /lte ba las ni byung ba'i rdul/ /thal bar 'dzag ④gyur de las ni/ /bong bu dang ni bong mor gyur/ /rna ba ring zhing mjug mar ldan/ /gzhung thig phra zhing rmig pa sra/ /skad gdangs rtsub cing khur sran che/ /gang zhig rtsub pa bong bu yin/ /114—1515

tshe thung nyid/ /bkra shis bkra mi shis gzugs bzang / /mdog ma 'dres dang mdog 'dres dang / /sna tshogs dbye ba ①ji ltar 'gyur/ /mtshan dang rlig pa lce dang ni/ /spu dang rngog ma dag dang rkan/ /so dang rmig pa mig mi snyug /kha dog mi sdug ji ltar 'gyur/ /sgur dang ma ning yan lag nyams/ /gzugs dang mjug ma yo ba dang / /beems po 'dra dang lkugs phu7dang 'on/ / rna yon kha skeni che ba dang / /mi ④sdug pa yi nad bu can/ /gzhan gyi dbyibs 'dra 'khu ⑤ba med/ /si si can nam khyi rngo chu)can/ /mngal du gnas tshe ji ltar 'gyur / /de ltar blo ldan gyis dris tshe/ /sha li ho tras smras gyur pa/ /ji ltar las dang nyon mongs las/ /sems can rnams ni 'byung 'gyur ba/ /yid blo dbang po zhes bya ba/ /rnam shes dang ni 'dus gyur nas/ /mngal du chags par gyur pa na/ /las kyi tshul la gnas pa yin/ /sems can 'byung bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /khong khrag rlung la brten pa yin/ /gang tshe rta pho rgod ma ni/ /zla mtshan ldan la 'jug gyur pa/ /de tshe 'bar bar gyur pa yis/ /rnam shes mngal du gnas pa yin/ /des ni khu ba khrag blangs nas/ /mngal gyi gnas su 'dren par 'gyur/ /ji ltar padma'i sdong bu'i rtsar/ /skyes bus chu ni blugs pa ltar/ /de bzhin mngal gyi gnas su ni/ /khu ba rlung gis 'dren par byed/ /de ni rtsol ba thams cad kyis/ /khrag gis lus ni 'phel bar byed/ /ji ltar me grogs du ba ni/ /shing las byung bas kyegyen du 'dren/ /de ni bar snang la gnas nas/ /gzugs can du ni gnas par byed/ /de bzhin mngal na gnas pa'i rlung / /khu ba khrag tu byung ba rnams/ /de ni mngal chags gyur pa na/ /rnam shes dang ni bcas pa las/ /sems med gyur pa'i dngos po yang / /114—1525

skye / /zla ba lnga par rkub dang ni/ /long ka dag kyang skye 'gyur zhing / /snying dang glo ba mtsher kṇipa dang / /mchin pa mkhal ma gzhang dang ni/ / rgyu ma gnye rngu/ma sogs pa 'byung / /zla ba drug par yan lag kun/ /rgyas shing rtsa phran rtsa chen dang / /rus pa kun dang tshigs ①rnams 'byung / /zla ba bdun /④pa'i tshe na ni/ /ma yi nu ma g.yos 'gyur zhing / /dbang po drug ni tshang ba dang / /dbugs ni dman pa nyid kyis rta/ /dbang po'i don dang bya ba la/ /nus pa chung ba nyid du 'gyur/ /de phyir zla ba bdun pa na/ /rgod ma dbugs rngub bder mi nus/ /de tshe yan lag rgyas shing brtan/ /rtsa sogs bdun brgya gsal bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin zla ba brgyad pa la/ /mngal du lus de cher spyo 'phel zhing / /lus rgyas ro drug tshor ba dang / /stobs dang ldan zhing dbang po gsal/ /dbang pos don ni gsal byed cing / /ma yang bde bar dbugs mi rngub/ /tshags tshigs mnyen ⑥zhing brtan 'gyur zhing / /rgod ma'i lto ba ci zhig na/ /zla ba dgu par rgod ma ni/ /mtshan dang de bzhin nu ma skrangs/ /'byung ba gsal ba nyid 'gyur zhing / /yan lag nying lag rdzogs par 'gyur/ /zla ba dgu'am kluni bcu pa'am/ /zla ba bcu gcig pa dag la/ /nye bar btsas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /rgod ma nad dang bcas par ni/ /bu btsas pa khyeni 'gyur ba yin/ /bu yi ste ba dang 'byel pa'i/ /mngal na rtsa sbubs yod pas na / /de las dwangs ma rgyu ma yi ⑨/ / mngal ni 'phel bar gyur pa yin/ /⑫mngal na gnas pa ⑪ rtag par ni/ /mgo bo gyen du bltas nas gnas/ /mngal na gnas pa'i gcin rtug ni/ /skye ba'i dus na 'byung 'gyur la/ /zla ba bcu par de 'phel te/ /de ⑩ni sha ma la gnod byed/ /de ra/5ni gcin rtug 114—1528

la ①gnas pas/ /yid mi bde phyir sgyur zhubar byed/ /mgo ni thur du sgyur kyibyed cing / /go bzlog par ni gnas pas na/ /rgyu ma dkrugs (chopar gyur pa'i phyir / /ma yi nad ni mi bzad skyeda'u/ /de ltar thur 67 du bsgyur bas na/ /de bas rgod ma'i kha zas ni/ /rjes su mthun pa nyid du bya/ /rgyu des zla ba bcu na ni/ /legs par btsas pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de ni 'byung bar byed pas na/ /dang po mgo bo 'byung 'gyur te/ /de nas lus bee rim gyis 'byung //de ltar na ni btsas par bshad/ /de yi rjes la sha ma ni/ /mngal nas 'byung bar 'gyur ba yin/ /pho la sogs pa mngal du ni/ /chags par byed pa'i rgyu nyon cig /khu ba mang zhing khrag nyung ba/ /rlung gis 'dres par byas kyenas ni—/ /der ni rnam shes zhugs gyur na/ /rte'u pho ru skye bar 'gyur/ /de lta bu yi tshul gyis ni/ /khu ba nyung zhing khrag mang na/ /de las rte'u mor skye bar 'gyur/ /gang gis ma ning skye 'gyur nyon/ /rtsa chodang chu ni zad 'gyur zhing / /kha rlung gis nyen gyur pa yi/ /phyin ci log gi dus su ni/ /pha ma dag kyang nyam chung zhing / /dbang po'i stobs kyang zad gyur pa/ /de gnyis phrad par gyur pa ni/ /khu ba khrag kyang cha mnyam na/ /ma ning du ni skye bar 'gyur—/ /nyes pa de dag gnyis 9dang ni/ /pha ma nad gzhir bcas gyur na/ /zla mtshan nyes pa cher ldan las/ /rta ni g.yang gsham kyedag tu 'gyur/ /sngar bshad pa yi rgyu yod cing / /mngal du chags par gyur pa na/ /mngal gyi gnas ni nad gzhir bcas/ /rlung ni shas cher gyur pa na/ /de la rte'u pho mo 'byung / /khu ba ⑪nyes par ldan 'gyur ⑩na/ /gseb kyis ⑪bu ni skyed mi byed//khu ba stong par gyur pa na/ /rlung gis gnyis su phye ba las/ /khrag dang 'dres 114—1529

dang / /rgyab sgur rlig pa che ba dang / /rlig pa rab chung lhag pa dang / /mtshan ni ring dang thung dang gug /yan lag rengs dang yo ba dang / /ma ning yan lag ma tshang dang / /gzugs mi sdug dang yan lag nyams/ /yan lag phra dang lhag ma rnams/ /de ni rlung gi gnod las gyur/ /de ltar ji skad bshad pa dang / /de las lhag pa'i smad bya ba/ /snang na rta de rlung gi ni/ /nad kyis nyen par shes par bya/ /rta ni gseb dang phrad gyur tshe/ /yid la gang zhig 'dod gyur pa/ /de yi bu ni de 'dra bar/ /skye bar 'gyur ba kho na yin / /de bzhin spyod lam dag dang tshang / /mdog dang gzi mdangs 'gros dang ni/ /pha dang ma ni ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra khyephal cher 'gyur ba yin/ /kha zas ngan du 'khru ba dang / /snad dang 'jigs dang ngal ba las/ /sbrum ma'i nad ni 'khrugs gyur pas/ /mngal 'jig par ni 'gyur ba yin/ /gang tshe rlung ni mngal gnas pa'i/ /rngog ma'i gnas su phyin gyur na/ /rngog ma rtsub dang mi snyoms pa'am/ /rngog ma srab par 'gyur ba yin/ /pags pa spu dang rnga ma yi/ /skyon gang yod de rlung las gyur/ /bad kan mkhris pa las rnguganas pa'i/ /so yi rtsa bar gnas gyur la/ /bad kan mkhris pa shas che las/ /so mi sdug par 'gyur ba yin/ /'dzag tshe khu ba skyon med cing / /zla mtshan yon tan ldan pa dang / /goms shing 'dod pa dang phrad cing / /yid la 'dod pa ma bkag dang / /bkra shis shis pa brjod byas dang / /dge spyong bram ze mchod pa las/ /tshe ring par ni 'gyur ba yin/ /gzhan du de ni tshe thung 'gyur/ /gseb sbyar tshe na skar ma tshes/ /byed pa la sogs bzang po dang / /yid 'ong snyegazhan yang mang po yis/ /bkra shis dang ni mchod byas te/ /114—1531

yin zhes bya/ /rta yi skye gnas 'di nyid yin/ /mdor na skyon dang yon tan dag/'dres dang lhag pa yin zhes bya/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i nyuganas las rta'i skye gnas kyi le'u ste bdun pa'o// //rta yi rang bzhin de nyid shes/ /dul la brtson zhing dbang po thul/ /sha li ho tra blo chen la/ / mdza' bo 3 las rgyal gyis dris pa/ /gzi brjid chen po rta rnams kyi/ /rigs bzhi ji ltar shes par bgyi/ /mtshan nyid spyod lam gang dag gis/ /de las bzlog par shes par bgyis // /de skad dris te krudrang srong che/ /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /rta yi rigs bzhi shes dga' bsa'u/ /de ni nga yis go bar bya/ /rigs bzhi (97rnam par dbye ba ni/ /skye gnas dang ni gzugs byad dang / /tshul spyod dang ni dul ba dang / /skad gdangs dbyibs dang kha dog / zudang / /dri nyid las ni nyer shes bya/ /gang zhig de las go bzlog snyiste/ /de yi khyad par smra ba spu ni/ /nyon la rnam par dpyad par gyis/ /gzugs bzang dpal dang ldan pa dang / /spyod pa dul zhing bsngags par 'os/ /blo ldan ngang tshul bzang ba dang / /'dul sbyong mkhan gyis byas pa nyan/ /rjes su mthun zhing nus pa ldan/ /gtsang zhing gtsang sbra dag la brten/ /bkres dang skom la sran che zhing / /khro ba chung zhing blan 6par sla—/ /gzi brjid dang ldan grags dang ldan/ /las rnams kun gyi rjes su 'jug /btung dang kha zas bza' bya yi/ /lhag ma dang ni mi gtsang dang / /rta sbangs dang ni de bzhin gcin/ /'di ni /khyaring du spong byed cing / /gtsang zhing gtsang mar spyod pa dang / /nyal yang gnyid ni med pa dang / /sbrang rtsi 114—1537

'bras yos khur ba mar/ /'o thug sreg rdzas la dga' zhing / /dri dang sna ma'i phreng ba dang / /khrus dang bkra shis la dga' zhing / /'tsher zhing de dag snom pa dang / /mi dag lta na sdug pa dang / /'jigs med mkhas hu3la sran che dang //snyan par 'tsher zhing sgra skad che/ /ser dang dkar dang dmar ba dang / /phal cher sbrang rtsi ltar ser dang / /'gros che sran ni ldu che ba dang / /brtan zhing snyan pa snyerjes su 'tsher/ /mdog sdum pags pa srab pa dang / /bram ze kun la dga' ba dang / /gnyid log tshe ni 'bras yos dang / /mar dang u shir dri 'byung la/ /lha dang dri za'i snying stobs can/ /dge zhing rtag tu des pa ste/ /de lta'i tshul spyod ldan pa'i rta/ /bram ze'i rigs su shes par bya/ /rgyal rigs khro ba'i tshul can te/ /tshangs pa'i mdog ldan shes par bya rang bzhin rno zhing dpa' ba dang / /sgra skad btang nas 'tsher ba dang / /dpung pa glo jezhing snying stobs che/ /rang bzhin gtsang zhing spyod pa yang / /gces par bsdus dang ldan pa dang / /yan lag 'byes shing pags khyapa srab/ /spyod pa gtsang zhing dul ba dang / /'jigs pa rnams la mi skrag pa/ /chu dang me dang 'brug sgra dang / /sgra cher grags 'udang khrung dang khur/ /tsha dang rtsub pa'i reg pa dang / /sa rtsub shing gi tshang tshing dang / /ring du 'gro dang lam dog par—/ /gang zhig 'jigs pa med pa dang / /glang po'i tshogs ni chen po dang //dril bu rol mo'i sgra rnams dang / /ca co 'don pa'i sgra rnams dang / /rta gzhan 'tsher bar gyur pa dang / /dung dang rnga chen sgra dang ni/ /rol mo'i sgra dang rdza rnga'i sgra/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan gyis/ /skrag par mi 'gyur rta mchog yin/ /rnga rngog legs par brkyang nas ni/ /dga' ba'i yid kyis 714—1538

'tsher ba dang / /rkang gnyis legs par 'jug rngubazhin du/ /sa steng tso7 na ni 'tsher ba dang / /rdul dang gcin dang rta sbangs ni/ /yan lag brkyang ste 'dor ba dang / /mthar ni shugs kyis 'dor ba dang / /rta gzhan la ni bsdigs pa dang / /g.yul ngor rta dang glang bo dang / /shing rta dpung bu chung 'joms dang / /rjes su skad 'don sgra 'jam pas/ /phyogs kun khyab par 'tsher ba dang / /rta gzhan dag ni thuphyin nas ni/ /de ni 'gro bar bzod mi byed / /mtshon gyis bsnun kyang nad chung zhing / /mtshon cha mthong na 'jigs mi 'gyur/ /spyod pa myur zhing dpa' ba dang / /'thab tshe myur du pha rol gnon/ /nor bu lta bur mig ser zhing / /mdog bzang kha dog ngan pa med / /blo ldan de bzhin mgyogs pa dang / /sgrin zhing ma zhum stobs che la/ /rtag tu las kun nus pa dang / /bag yod rtag tu nyon mongs med/ /bsod nams byed pa'i me tog mar/ /'bras bu 4ldan pa'i dri yod la/ /lha dang dri za'i snying stobs can/ /de mtshungs spyod yul spyod par ldan/ /dge zhing spyod pa nges pa'i rta/ /rgyal rigs su ni shes par bya/ /rje'u rigs btung ba la dga' brtanarngu/ /zhi zhing blo che le lo can/ /mi 'khrugs ༅dga' bar 'gyur ba med/ /dul ba'i spyod pa yang dag ldan/ /khro ba med cing nga rgyal med/ /dul zhing ngang tshul snyems pa dang / /nad dang tsha dang bkres pa bzod/ /khal bkal lam du 'gro tshe brtan/ /de ni mgyogs bul ran ma tsu7yin/ /nyams dang lus stobs bar ma ste/ /mig ni de bzhin sngo dang ser/ /gnag dang drur pe7ba'i mdog 'dra dang / /sngo bsangs ⑨spu mdog dkar ba dang / /sbyig ⑪ma ta la'i mdog 'dra dang / /phal cher ngang pa'i mdog 'dra zhing / /114—1539

'phel bar 'gyur ba yin/ /yon tan phyin ci log ldan pa/ /bdag po'i don rnams nyams byed yin/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las yan lag thams cad kyi mtshan nyid kyi le'u ste dgu pa'o// //dka' thub bsam gtan chen po yis/ /gzi byin gsal gyur drang srong la//blo dang ldan pa legs thos kyis/ /sngar bshad pa ni dris gyur pa/ /khyod kyis phyogs bstan gsungs mod kyi/ /bshad pa dag ni ma gsungs pas/ /bstan pa rnams kyi ①bshad pa ni/ /legs ldan gsung bar 2mdzad pa'i rigs/ /bstan pa bshad pa dang bcas pa/ /bu yis bsgul bas smras pa ni/ /mid pa srol gong dang 'byel bas/ /ro 'dzin lcer ni shes par bya/ /de yi steng ni rkan yin te/ /ma rkan lce 'og yin par bshad/ /'gram so 'gram pa las skyes pa/ /ldang ba'i so ni yin par bshad/ /de las gzhan pa mdun gyi so/ /bcu gnyis mtshan mar ldan pa yin/ /de rnams kyi — ni dbus gnas pa/ /steng 'og bzhi ni mche ba yin/ /steng 'og gi ni so 'gebs byapa/ /gnyis po mchu ni yin par bshad/ /mchu mtha' yi ni ngos gnyis na/ /'gram pa'i dbus chud kha 'gram yin/ /ya mchu'i steng na sgos dāyod de/ /de yi steng gi mchu lhag ⑪ yin/ /ma mchu'i 'og ma ko sko ste/ /de ltag 'gram pa yin par bshad—/ /sna gong mig kluganyis bar mtshams gdong / /gdong gi yan lag sna khung muganyis/ /gdong gi ngos gnyis mkhur metshos yin/ /de bar dma' ba mchi ma'i stan/ /de dag rnams kyi gong na mig /mig 'bras 'gegs 1hūṃpa mig mchu yin/ /mig mtha'i dkar po mig sprin yin⑫/ /de dbus zlum nag 1 14—1549

mthong mig yin/ /mthong mig nag po zlum po'i dbus/ / phra zhing ①dang ba mig rgyal bong kye/ /mig ltag gnyis ni mig gi sgyu/ /de steng thusmin ma gnyis yin no/ /mig gi rgyab ni mig zur te/ /nang gi mtshams ni mig phugs yin/ /smin ma gnyis re dpral ba ste/ /dpral ba'i steng gi dpral mtshams yin/ /de steng khuspyi bo yin par bshad/ /rna ba'ang gnyis bar glad pa ste/ /mig zur mig 57'gram bar mur gong 6 / /mur gong rngurna ba'i bar mur 'gram/ /mkhyar tshos gnyis kyi rgyab za yung sgo / /de gnyis phyi rol 'gram glad yin/ /'gram pa srol gong gnyis kyi bar/ /sgog ma zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /rna ba gnyis kyi steng dang rgyab/ /rna ltag dang ni rna mchan yin/ /mgo dang phrag so'i bar ske mgrin / /ske mgrin phrag so'i ltag ske /rtsa/ /de steng rngog g.yab yin par bshadaske/ /rngog mtha' rna ba'i bar phum phum/ /rngog g.yab mtha' ni ze'u ltag ste//de yi rgyab ni dang ru yin/ /dang ru'i 'og ni nam tsong ⑫ zhes/ /rta rnams la ni bshad pa yin/ /ze'u ltag hu1ni 'og ma nyid/ /ze'u yin par shes par bya/ /ze'u'i rjes thogs kho na la/ /sga 'og yin par shes par bya/ /de phan cad ni sgal shā2tshigs dang / /rgyab nyid yin par shes par bya/ /ze'u'i so shā1 gnyis phrag so ste/ /phrag so'i rtsa ba dpung mgo yin/ /sgog ma dang ni srol gong bar//mid pa'o de 'og srol mdud yin/ /mid 'og lag bar brang yin te thu/ /de rjes lag 'og bar snying ga /de 'og dpung sna dpung pa yin/ /dpung pa'i nang ni mchan khyang phan/ /rgyab kyi cha ni dpung rgyab yin/ /de 'og pus mo gnyis kyi ltag /pus gong dang ni lag ngar gnyis/ /pus mo'i 'og tu shā5chig grang ste/ /de 'og chig grang phra mo yin/ /chig grang sbom phra'i bar na ni/ /114—1550

dang bsre mi bya/ /kañdzi dang ni sha khu 'am/ /'o ma'am yang na hwags ①dang ni/ /'di dag mnye ba sbyin bya zhing / /yang na til mar sbyar ba'ang rung / /zhag dang til mar mar sbyar ba/ /gsum po sbyar ba zhes bya ba'ang bsku/ /de la sha khu mchog yin te/ /de dang nye bar bya ba yi ⑤/ /nas dang ma sha gro dang ni/ /drug cu pa yi sbyor ba gang / /de ni 'o ma'am sbrang rtsi 'am/ /mar dang sbyar bas mnye bar bya/ /'di dag dang ni mnye ba'i tshe/ /de ru lan tshwa gzhug mi bya/ /rlung dang bad kan gyis nyen dang / /rta yi ④sgrum mang 'thungs rjopa dang / /me drod chung dang mi snyams dang / /sbegs rjol lan tshwar bcas pa gtang bu/ /mnye ba'i sbyor ba bya ba dang / /chang dang chang snying zho ga chus/ /lto ba'i ma zhu rnam sbyang zhing / /kha chu'i ⑦rgyun ni 'dzag par bya/ /khong pa'i srin bu yod pa la/ /ba gcin dang sbyar sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig rgan dang lud pa can/ /de la kha zas skam mi sbyin/ /de lta bu la snum dang ni/ /bcas pa'i zas kyi sbyor ba byarka/ /rta la zas ni sbyin pa ni/ /mgo bo gyen du legs bstan nas/ /zas ni kham re bcad nas ni/ /myur min 'gor ba med par sbyin/ /nas thug mar dang ldan pa 'am/ /yang na chag tshe ⑧mar gyis sbangs/ /rta rnams rtas ⑨byed dam pa yin/ /mkhris pa can la mchog tu phan/ /chag tshe nas thug snum med pa| /lan tshwa dang ni ldan pa ru/ /bca' bee btab par gyur pa ni/ /bad kan can la sbyin par bya/ /rgyam tsha ⑩dang ni bcas pa dang / /ma sha ri la mar bcug pa⑪/ /rlung nad ⑫can la phan mod kyi/ /de las mkhris pa skye ba bsrung / /sha rnams sna tshogs dag dang ni/ /bad kan can la chang blud cing //mkhris pa can la 'o ma blud/ /rlung nad can la sha khu sbyin/ /mkhris pa can la 114—1565

gnag pa dang / /bzhi pa ser po zhes bshad do/ /'di rnams lus kyi phyogs gnas dang / /phan tshun 'dres par gyur pa dang / /rdzas dang rdzas min 'dres pa las/ /rgyas par mdog ni du ma yin/ /dkar la sogs pa de dag rnams/ /ma lus shes bya mnyan par gyis/ /pags pa dkar zhing ba spu dkararka/ /de bzhin rnga ma rngog ma dkar/ /'di ni dkar po zhes bshad do/ /rta de srid sgrub yin par 'dod/ /pags pa dmar zhing ba spu dmar/ /rnga ma rngog ma dag kyang dmar/ /khrag dang nyi ma 'char ka 'dra/ /rta ni dmar po zhes bya'o/ /pags pa spu dang rngog ma gnag① /bung ba 'dra ba gang yin pa//stag ②zil nag po'i mdangs 'dra'i rta/ /de yi thams cad nag por bshad/ /pags pa rnga rngog spu rnams ni/ /gang zhig gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /dar ni ser po'i mdangs ldan pa/ /rta de ser po yin zhes bya/ /de ltar kha dog rnam pa bzhi/ /so sor yang ①dag bshad pa yin/ /de rnams mdog ni 'dres gyur pa/ /bshad pa nga las rtogs par gyis/ /pags pa dmar zhing mig skyon med / /kha dang rkan dang pho mtshan dmar/ /ma du ka yi me tog 'dra/ /'di ni la las kar kar bshad/ /pho mtshan rmang bukha rlig pa dang / /rlig ⑤pa de bzhin rkub dang ni/ /mchu ltag mchu dang kha dang ni/ /pags pa padma'i mdog 'dra gang / /mig dang phum phum rngog ma'i bar/ /ba spu dkar bar gyur pa ni/ /rta ni kar 0ka kha cig 'dod/ /bkra shis dge ba ⑦dam pa yin/ /pags pa dmar zhing ba spu dmar/ /rnga ma rngog ma dmar ba ni/ /nyi ma skyon bral mdog 'dra ba/ /de yang kar kar shes par bya/ /btso ma'i gser gyi mdog 'dra ba'i/ /spu ni gang la yod gyur pa/ /pags pa padma'i dbus 'dra 114—1573

bshad—/ /gang zhig me tog mkha' lding 'dra/ /rnga ma rngog ma nag po ni/ /yod pa'i rta de stang zil gyi/ /spyi bo can zhes bya ba yin/ /rngog ma 'jam zhing dkar ba ni/ /rngog ma muñdza can zhes bya/ /shin tu dkar la rngog ma gnag /rngog ma mig sman mdog 'drar bshad/ /gang zhig rngog ma'i mdog sna tshogs/ /'dres pa'i rngog ma zhes byar bshad/ /rnga ma'i kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /rnga ma 'dres pa zhes byar bshad/ /de dang 'dra ba gzhan dag kyang / /dkar po'i mdog 'dres pa zhes bya/ /gso ma'i me tog mdog 'dra dang / / lham bu ①chu gsher 'dra ba dang / /a mra'i lo ma'i mdog 'dra dang / /rta gang ki ①shu dang 'dra dang / /chu shing me tog 'dra ba dang / /kar kan ru yi mdog 'dra dang / /me tog band+ra dzi ①ba'i mdog /lcang ma ④a shwa ka'i mdog dang / /gang yang byu ru'i mdog 'dra dang / /mig dang rnga rngog nag pa dang / /mtshan dang pags pa de bzhin gnag /de ni sru gnag ⑤zhes byar bshad/ /de dag dmar po dang 'dres mdog /nag po dang 'dres mdog nyon cig /khu byug dang ni char sprin 'dra/ /drur tsoba'am ma he'i mdog 'dra ba/ /a mra ba yi ⑦mdog 'dra ba/ /gang yang lung tang ⑧rlon 'dra dang / /sā ⑨la ta la'i mdog 'dra dang / /utpal ⑩sngon po lta bu dang / /gang gzhan ⑪tshul ni 'di 'dra ba/ /rta ni nag po dang 'dres mdog /gang yang sā lu'i gra ⑫ma 'dra/ /ṣpe tsho'i ⑫sgro gshog 'dra ba dang / /mar gyi snying po'i mdog 'dra dang / /padma'i sa bon mdog 'dra dang / /padma'i ge sar lta bu dang / /de bzhin me yi rtse 'dra dang / /gang zhig gzha' ⑫dang 'dra ba dang / /gang yang ba bla ⑫'dra ba dang / /sbu ⑩ti ka yi ser po 'dra/ /shri sha'i me tog 'dra ba dang / /gang 114—1575

yang khre 'bras mdog 'dra dang / /gang yang spyang khu'i mdog can dang / /kha dog ser po ji snyed dang / /gzhan yang ser po dang 'dres dang / /de 'dra de ①las gzhan pa dag /rta ni ser po dang 'dres mdog /de ltar rnam pa bzhi po ni—/ /mdog 'dres pa zhes bya bar bshad/ /gzhan yang kha dog dbye ba dang / /kha dog sna tshogs mnyan par gyis/ /phug ron gyi ni ske 'dra zhing / /pags pa spu yi mdog dmar ba/ /phug ron ske 'dra phug ron ske/ /dmar dang nag po cung zad 'dres/ /pags pa rnga ma rngog ma gnag /mig dang gsang ba rmig pa'ang gnag /mkhal ma'i mdog 'dra nag 'tsher ④ba/ /'di nyid gnag pa'i shas che ba/ /nag 'tsher ①ba ni yin zhes bya/ /gal te mar ④nag tsham mnyam 'dres/ /rgun 'bru ltar 'tsher yin par bshad/ /rgun dhi'abru ltar 'tsher rjode nyid la/ /cung zad ser skyas 'dres pa ni/ /kha dog gnyis ni bsdus pa las/ /gang zhig shas che de la gdags⑦/ /nag po dkar po dang ⑧'dres shing / /pags pa nag por 'dug pa ni/ /spu 'dres drang srong pa zhes bshadaske/ /gsal ba ri dwags mdog can yin/ /de nyid dkar po ⑨ma gyur na/ /dkar po'i drang srong pa zhes bshad/ /dkar po'i gzhi la gnag dang 'dres/ /khor leng mang du snang ⑩ba dang / /yan lag gnag cing mjug ma dkar/ /de ni skya ba'i drang srong pa/ /dkar dang dmar dang nag por 'dres/ /pags pa nag po yod gyur cig⑪ /mig dang pho mtshan rmig pa gnag /'dren ma'i drang srong pa zhes bya/ /dmar dang ser dang nag po yis/ /dkar la 'dres gyur gso dar mdog /dmar ser dkar po mdog 'dres rta/ /ser skya'i ba 'dra ser skya yin/ /nag po dmar pos khyab gyur cing / /dmar po dang 114—1576

gzhan yang bzang / /rta yi kha dog thams cad las/ /kha dog dkar po mi 'gyur yin/ /brtan zhing mi zad ①nyid kyis ni/ /dkar po nyid ni khyad par 'phags—/ /de ltar rta yi kha dog ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bstan pa yin/ /kha dog dbye ba ma lus par/ /smra bar nus pa ma yin no/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las kha dog shes par bya ba'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //sha li ho tra thub mchog la/ /legs thos kyis ni yang ⑤dris pa/ /zhur dang de bzhin rgyal ①mtshan dag /ji ltar gnas pa bka' stsol cig /de ltar dris tshe legs thos labu/ /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /mchu sgos ltag nas dpral mtshams bar/ /dkar ba'am shin tu dkar gang yin/ / der ni zhu ⑤bor shes bya ste/ /'di yis rjo'abras bu rnam bzhi yin/ /gnas dang dbyibs dang kha dog dang / /rang bzhin las shis mi shis 'gyur/ /khur ba de yi 'bras bu ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /mchu ltag dpral ba sna gdong dang / /⑦gzhan yang mchu ltag gdong pa dang / /mchu ltag phum phum mthar thug de⑧/ /rta yi gdong pa kun dkar ba/ /rigs kyi dbang phyug 'phel byed yin/ /mgo bo rna bar bcas dkar ba/ /bdag po bde ba kun skyed do⑨/ /gnas gnyis na ni gnas pa'i 'bras/ /⑩me long lcags kyu bum pa dang / /gdugs dang rnga yab 'dra ba dang / /dpal shing rim gyis 'phel 'dra dang / /bum pa g.yung drung dbyebs 'dra ba'i/ /zhur ni gang gi rta la yod—/ / bu tsha bran dang mdza' bo 'phel/ /⑪rgyal pos legs par bkur gyur ⑫la—/ /rta yang bde bar 'tsho bar 'gyur/ / zhur ni byang chub shing lo 'dra/ /114—1578

de yis skal ①ba bzang 'gyur zhing / /bu ni mang po yod par 'gyur/ /zur bzhi ②yod na rgyal pos ni/ /yul khams rnyed par ston pa yin/ /ral gri 'khor lo rdo rje gzhu/ /gshol dang gtun shing dbyeg pa dang / /rgyal mtshan ba dan gdugs ①'dra ba/ / zhur la dbyibs yod rgyal rjopo yis/ /zhon na g.yul las rgyal byed yin/ /rta de bzhon nas rgyal po yis/ /dgra rnams thul bar 'gyur ba yin/ /chung ma bu dang tsha bo dang / /nor yang shin tu mang bar 'gyur / /dgang gzar blugs gzar mchod sdong ⑤me/ /kha khyer gyi ni dbyibs 'dra ba'i/ / zhur yod bdag pos 'bras chen thob/ /dumachod sbyin mang du byed pa dang / /sbyin pa mang du 'gyed par 'gyur/ /gang gi zhur ni bum pa 'dra/ /me tog mgo spyogs dbyibs 'dra ba⑦/ /rta bdag gter ni brgya byen thob/ /⑧me tog padma'i dbyibs 'dra ba'i⑨/ /mig mangs ris kyi dbyibs yod pa/ / gang gi rta la yod gyur pa/ /⑩bdag po bkur ste nor mang dge/ /shing rta'i dbyibs 'dra'i zhur yod pa'i/ /rta ni nor rnams 'phel byed yin/ /steng cha kha zheng che ba'i zhur/ /nor dang 'bru dang phrad byed do/ /de yi bdag pos dpal thob cing / /bu dang tsha bo rnam par 'phel/ /de yi khyim du dpal rtag gnas/ /rgyal srid kyang ni thob ⑪par 'gyur/ /rta de ci 'dod ma smras par/ /bde bar 'chi ba nyid du 'gyur/ /⑫mi shis pa yi mtshan rtags ni⑫/ /rta'i zhur kha dog 'dres pa dang / /g.yon ngogs 'gram glang bar du chags⑫/ /g.yon pa'i mig dkyus dpral ba'i ngos dang bcas/ /khyad par skyes pa'i rta de ni⑫/ /dpral chags zhes te ⑩ngang tshul ngan/ /rgyun du dngang ⑩zhing 'thab rtsod dga' bar 'gyur/ /mur 'gram dag tu chags 114—1579

ni sgod par byed/ /lus kyi stod smad du byung na/ /bdag po phrog ①par ston pa yin/ /mchan khung dku yi gnas su byung / /ltogs 'gyur ma mchur byung na 'chi/ /ya mchur byung na mi 'chi la/ /mig tu byung na gos zas thob ze ba ltag dang ze'u dang / /dpyi ⑤mgul brla ni phra mo dang / /rje ngar dang ni de mtshams su/ /byung na 'dir ni smad ①par bshad/ /ske rtsar byung na nor thob cing / /rngog ltag gis ni rgyal srid skyedarjo/ /rgyu mtshams thig le nor rnyed la/ /snying gar byung na gcong ⑤can 'gyur/ /rtsib logs g.yas byung bud med rnyed/ /mjug dor dubyung na nor zad 'gyur/ /rgyur ⑦byung na ni skal ba bzang / /rgyab tu byung na gnas rnams 'phel/ /ltor byung rtogs ⑧pa'i 'jigs pa ste/ / rmig par byung na skal bzang rnyedasti/ /⑩lte ba'i rtsa las dmag dpon 'gyur/ /ong dor byung na chung ma 'phyo/ /rkub dang rnga ma'i rtsa bar byung / /nor rnams thams cad brlag par 'gyur/ /pus mor byung na 'chi ba skyed/ /sgog ma tshe'u pus ⑪lam 'gro ston/ / rmang kha'i thig les bu skye ston/ /spyi la ⑫bud med nyes pa skyed⑫/ /tshe'u tsher byung na gnod pa skyed/ /gang zhig brtan ⑫pa'i gnas su byung / /'dod pa thams cad skyed byed do/ /yan lag la byung don kun 'grub / /mdza' bo ()'phel zhing dpal skyed la/ /rigs dang grags pa 'phel bar byed/ /mdog dang rjes mthun mdog byung shis/ /mdog gzhan shis pa ma yin no/ /ser po byung na g.yul du 'jug /dkar po la yang de dang 'dra/ /nag po 'thab mo skyed par byed/ /nag po byung na g.yul du 'chi/ /sdug dang mi sdug pa dag gis/ /bdag po la ni 'jigs chen 'byung / /thig le'i steng du thig le byung / /de yang rjes mthun mdog tu min/ /des ni rgyal 174—1583

'dra'i mdog la/ /ṣpe tsho'i ①mdog 'dra'i 'khor ling can/ /drag po'i rta de rnyed na ni/ /'dod pa thams cad thob ②par 'gyur/ /de lta ④bu yi rgyal ba'i rta/ /rgyal po yi rjoni rtag tu bya/ /de yi gnas ni rta gzhan dag /gang dang yang ni gcig ⑤mi bya/ /ngo mtshar mdog dang ldan pa'i rta/ /dmod pas sa steng dhiskyes pa yin/ /dri za'i bur ni shes gyis la/ /rab tu 'bad de bsnyen bkur ⑦bya/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las rgyal po'i bzhon pa'i rta'i mtshan nyid brtag pa'i le'u ste sgenyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /rta yi mig gi mtshan nyid do/ /gang zhig bai ḍūrya 'dra'i mdog /de bzhin shel gyi mdog 'dra dang / /phug ron gyi ni mig 'dra dang / /ka la piṅka'i mig 'dra dang / /glang chen rma bya rnga mo dang / /sreg pa'i mig dang 'dra ba dang / /gser byi mdog dang 'dra ba nyid/ /de yi mig ni shis pa yin—/ /skyon med pa yi mig la ni/ /rdzi ma phra mos khyab pa dang / /mig 'bras legs shing ma snad la/ /thur du bltas par ma gyur pa/ /mdog ni bzang po dang ldan zhing / /mig gi mdangs dang ldan pa'i rta/ /de ni g.yul las rgyal byed pa'i//rgyal ba yi ni bzhon ⑨par 'gyur/ /yangs shing snum la mnyam pa dang / /me tog ma cha ka 'dra dang / /tha ma ring mo yod gyur cing / /dbus na yongs su mdzes pa dag /rta de ma li ka'i mig can/ /mig zur cung zad gnag pa yin/ /de yis mdza' bo kyi'aphel 'gyur zhing / /rta dang mdzod kyang rgyas par 'gyur/ /dkar ba'am mdog rjes dkar gyur la/ /mig la skyon med mthong mig nagadzee ma mig dkyus ⑪nag gyur pa/ /gang la yod pa der ⑫nor skyed/ /mig ni shel 714byed1596

med nges 'byung ba/ /gzhan dag de ltar min ①par bshad/ /brtan dang mi brtan gang yin kyang / /'bras bu rnam pa gnyis su bshad/ /gnas ni dgu bcu rtsa drug yin/ /dbyebs ni rgyal ②po nyid yin no/ /'dres dang kha 'bus 'khyel ba dang / /rkang pa brgya dang lhag ④pa dang / /shing lham dang 'dra shing lham phyed/ /nya phyis 'dra ste rnam pa brgyad/ /smad pa'am bsngags bupa'i gnas dag gam/ /gnas su bstan dang ma bstan ⑤gang / /gtsug 'khyel pa yi dbyibs byung na/ /de ni rjes mthun 'bras bu skyedabu/ /'khyel ba chu skor lta bu yin/ /nya phyis nya phyis dbyibs ltar 'ong / /dbyibs gcig gnyis sam mang por ni/ /du ma gang tshe 'dus gyur pa'i/ /gtsug 'khyel de ni 'dres pa 'amarka/ /'dus pa zhes ni bya bar bshad/ /spu ni 'gro tshe me tog dag /kha 'bus ltar snang kha 'bus yin/ /bzlog pa ltar snang lhag ⑦pa yin/ /zlum po'am yang na zur bzhi ni/ /shing lham dbyibs 'dra shing lham can/ /brang ba'am yang na rting pa'i gnas/ /byed 'dra shing lham phyed pa yin/ /me tog mgo spyogs dbyebs 'dra ba/ /de ni rkang brgyad ⑧par shes bya/ /dbyibs las mi mthun gyur pa ni/ /gzhan dag kyang ni snang mod kyi/ /de ni spu yi 'gyur ba yin/ /gnas las shis dang mi shis 'gyur/ /gtsug kyang gnas dang dbyebs dang ni/ /mi shis mtshan nyid shes par bya/ / cha dang 'phos ⑨dang 'thor ba dang / /gtsug ni 'phred du 'byung ba dang / /lhag pa'am chad par gyur pa 'am/ /gang yang gnas las 'pho 'gyur ba'am/ /dbyebs ngan mdog ni mi snyug pa/ /brtan po rnams ni mi snang ba'am/ /smad pa'i gnas su g.yas 'khyel dang / /bsngags pa'i gnas su g.yon 'khyel ba/ /mtshan 114—1601

rnamasaske/ /na tshod shes la mtshar skyes nas/ /pha la de rnams kyis dris pa/ /rta yi na tshod ji ltar shes/ /'di yi tshe ni ji ltar bshad/ /so rnams su ni mtshan ma dang / /pags pa spu ni ji ltar 'gyur/ /na tshod gnas su phyin ma phyin—/ /ci ltar shes par gyur pa ①lags/ /gang gis na tshod shes 'gyur ba'i—/ /mtshan ma ji ltar shes par gyis/ /de skad dris tshe drang srong mchog /de nyid shes par ②slar smras pa①/ /rta yi na tshod shes pa ni/ /mtshan ma las kyis rjoganyer rnyed 'gyur/ /la la gzhon pa'ang rgas 'dra dang / /rgas pa'ang gzhon pa'i tshul du snang / /de bas rta las kha cig ni/ /shin tu rmongs par byed pa yin/ /dus ni brtag cing bsam mi khyab/ /'jig rten thams cad ma lus khyab/ /nyin mtshan dang ni zla ba dang / /lo dang dus drug bcas par ni//dus kyi mtshan nyid ldan pa rung ⑤/ /dus 'di shes par bya ba yin/ /gang gi so sogs la rim bzhin/ /dus ni dus kyi grangs su 'gro/ /dus las mtshan ma gsal gyur la/ /mtshan ma las kyang dus shes bya/ /rta ni skyes nas du lon pa//mtshan ma las ni shes par bya/ /mkhas pas mtshan ma bstan nas ni/ /legs par shes nas bstan rjopar bya/ /legs par brtag par gyur pa yis /gzung ba de ni de bzhin yin/ /myur bar bltas ⑦pas ma shes pa/ /de ni log par 'dzin par 'gyur/ /legs bltas ⑤ma rmongs par gyur pa/ /mtshan ma dus ni ston pa yin/ /de las 'bad cing mkhas pa dang / /bstan bcos don mthong yang dag shes/ /mtshan ma shin tu nges brtags ⑨la/ /dogs pa med par bstan par bya/ /mdun so steng dang 'og dag la/ /skyes pa drug drug yin zhes ⑩bya/ /de nas rta yi mche ba ni/ /steng 'og gnyis la bzhi yod de⑪/ /114—1609

par ①ni tha mar 'gro/ /sbrang mdog lo ni bco brgyad na/ /mdun so bar ma 1bcu dgu na/ /nyi shu tshe na tha ma ru/ /de ni gnas par 'gyur ba yin/ /dung 'dra nyi shu rtsa gcig na/ /mdun sor nyi shu gnyis na dbus/ /nyi shu gsum na tha ma ru/ /de ni gnas par rab tu bshad/ /gtun 'dra nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ /mdun sor rtsa lnga'i tshe na dbus/ /tha ma dag dang ldan par ni/ /lo ni nyi shu drug na 'byung / /nyi shu rtsa bdun la mdun so/ /rtsa brgyad pa la bar na ste/ /nyi shu dgu la tha ma dag /yongs su 'gul bar 'gyur ba yin/ /lo sum cu na mdun so ste/ /sum cu gcig na bar ma yin/ /sum cu gnyis na tha ma ni/ /'byung ba 'di sneni the tshom med/ /de nas gnas kyi dbye ba yis/ /mtshan ma rnams ni shes par gyis/ /snying po ducha yi phyi rol gnas/ /so yi rtse mor mngon gnas yin/ /gnag dang ser dang dkar po las/ /dkar po yin na mthil dbus skye/ /rta yi so rtsar chags pa ni/ /nye ba'i lus zhes bya ba yin—/ /mching rjobu sbrang bu du mdog 'dra/ /thel gyis dbus la brten pa yi/ /nang gi snying po'i cha nas ni/ /so rtse'i bar du brten rjopa yin/ /gtun 'dra so rten dag las ni/ /brtsams te skye ba yin par bshad/ /de ni 'jong dang zur bzhi dang / /shin tu zlum pa'i khyad par gyi④/ /rma 'dra dang ni bcas mtshan ma/ /dbyibs ni rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /sbrang bu'i mdog can gru bzhir 'gyur/ /mching bu nyid ni 'jong par gnas/ /dung dang gtun 'dra nyid dag ni/ /shin tu zlum por gnas pa yin/ /rta rnams kyi ni so la mtshon//ngo bo nyid kyi sgechags pa yin/ /dper na shing las skyes lo ma/ /gzhon cha dmar por gnas pa yin/ /rgyas pa'i tshe na sngon por 'gyur/ /de yi rjes la 114—1614

ser po ste/ /skams shing mi sdug gyur pa na/ /smin cing lhung bar gyur pa yin//de bzhin rta yi so dag gi/ /tshon ni rim gyis yal ba yin/ /de las gzhan yang mtshan ma ni/ /so so zhing gi ①rab sbyar bya/ /la la lung tang mdog can la// gzhi gcig ①'dzam bu'i 'bras bu ①mdog /kha cig lcags ni bcag pa 'dra//la la dngul rdo 'dra ba ni/ /nag po drug nas dgu yi bar/ /ri mo so la gnas pa yin/ /de tshe nyams dga' stobs ldan zhing / /sha ni rgyas par gyur pa dang / /rnga ma dang ni rngog ma snum/ /sru mdog shin tu gsal ba dang / /ma zhum mtsher ༷zhing 'gros bzang dang / /mjong na dga' ba nyid du ni/ /shugs dang spro bar ldan pa dang / / grim zhing lang tsho ⑤dag la gnas/ /padma'i ge sar 'dra ba 'am/ /gser ram sbrang rtsi'i mdog 'dra na/ /ba ser ba lang sbrang bu yi/ /mdog 'dra de yi dbus na ni/ /grog rjoma'i dbyibs 'dra chags pa dang / /'dam bu'i shun pa'i mdog 'dra ba'am/ /cung zad sngo zhing ser ba ⑦ni/ /ring por so yi ngos la chags/ /ser po mdun so la sogs par/ /de ltar dgu pa yan chad nas⑧/ /ser po'i mtshan ma ldan pa'i rta/ /sha yis rgyas shing stobs dang ldan/ /mdangs ldan de bzhin kha dog bzang / /brtan zhing dga' bar byed pa yin/ /'bras ni grus pa lta bu dang / /de bzhin mu tig mdog can la/ /thil dang dbus ni mnyam zhing zlum/ /de bzhin zho yi mdog can du/ /dkar po rnam pa tha dad par/ /bcu gnyis sogs par mdun sor gnas/ /dkar po'i mtshan mar ldan pa la/ /phyi rol mtshan ma 'di 'byung ste/ /pags pa sha ni lhod pa dang / /stobs ni yongs su bri ba dang //kha dog dag kyang nyams pa dang / /dpral ba ⑨ser bar 'gyur ba dang / /114—1615
