lus kyi stobs dang mgyogs pa dang / /spro ba dag ni 'bri bar 'gyur/ /brang gi stobs ni zad pa'i phyir/ /phrag sor gnyer ma 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kha cig yungs kar dkar 'dra dang / /la la sbrang rtsi 'dra ba dang / /kha cig mching bu nag po 'dra/ /dmar ①zhing zlum pa'i thig le chags/ /mching bu mdun so la sogs par/ /bco lnga yan chad 'byung ba yin/ /mig dang phrag so 'phral ba dang / /rgyu dang mchan khung dag dang ni/ /rnga rtsa'i gnas ni gang yin par/ /spu dkar gnyer ma 'byung bar 'gyur/ /rta yi spyod pa 'khrig pa dang / /'dre ba dag kyang spong byed cing / /'gros dang skad kyang chung ba dang / /nyam nga'am lam du bub par ni/ /lo ni bcu bdun pa dag la/ /phyi rol mtshan ma 'di dag 'byung / /ser dang nag dang dmar ba 'am/ /sbrang bu'i dbyibs 'drar sbrang bu'i mdog /bco brgyad nas ni nyi shu'i bar/ /rta la 'di 'dra 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de la gnyer ma spu dkar ni/ /sbar yang 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang / /rta yi spyod pa 'khrig pa dang / /'dra chaba'ang rnam par 'dor bar 'gyur/ /dung ni dung gi mdog 'dra bar/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis shes bya ste/ /zlum dang zla ba phyed 'dra bar/ /so yo so ④la 'phred du chags/ /rta de nyi shu rtsa gcig nas/ /rtsa gsum pa yi bar yin no/ /de ni lpags mthug rjomadog 'gyur zhing / /mnyam po nyam chung reg na rtsub/ /gnyer ma dang ni spu dkar skye/ /rna ba dang ni mjug ma lhod/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum pa yi rta/ /'di 'drar 'gyur bar rjoshes par gyis/ /so yi dbus su bug gang rjobyung / /de ni gtun ⑦'drar shes par bya/ /mdun so la sogs nyi shu ni/ /rtsa bzhi yan chad 'byung shes bya/ /'di yi tshigs rus gang yin dang / /tshe'u sru pus mo mi 114—1616

sdug cing / /sgog mkhar gug par 'gyur ba dang / /zhum zhing le los 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gnyid che bar ni 'gyur ba dang / /rtsa yang 'dor bar 'gyur ba yin/ /rta ni nyi shu drug lon pa/ /'di 'dra bar ni shes par bya/ so mdog mi sdug ①gyur nas ni/ /de yi rjes la 'gul bar 'gyur/ /spu ni shor sdebar 'gyur ba dang / /'byi zhing 'gros ni zhen pa dang / /mig gyur mig ni 'dres ④pa dang / /mchi mar bcas shing dman par lta/ /mtshan ma 'di yis rta dag ni/ /nyi shu dgu par shes par ④bya/ /sha yi ⑤gnas nas rim bzhin du/ /so rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / /'brel pa chad cing gyes pa dang / /rta rgas mig ni zhum pa dang / /mdangs bral sems khong chud pa dang / /nyal bar dga' zhing sems zhum dang / /kha yi dbugs ni dri mi zhim/ /rta yi kha nas kha chu 'dzag /mig la rgyun du 'dzag pa dang / /zos pa dka' bas 'ju bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe sum cu gnyis lon pa'i/ /rta ni las la sbyor mi nus/ /ji ltar glang pos brgya nyi shu thub/ /rnga mo bong bu nyi shu lnga/ /ba lang 'di dag nyi shu ni/ /rtsa bzhis lhag pa nyid yin la/ /ra lug lo ni bcu gnyis te/ /dre'u dulo ni nyi shu yin//mi dang glang po mnyam pa ltar/ /de bzhin rta'i lo sum cu gnyis/ /tshe yi mthar thug gyur pa yi⑦/ /rtswa yi me ltar 'chi bar 'gyur/ /na tshod lo yi dbye ba ni⑧/ /ji bzhin rab tu bstan pa yin/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las na tshod brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas sha li ho tra'i bu/ /mdza' las rgyal gyis yang dris pa/ /rta yi 114—1617

phyin nas srog dang 'bral ba yin/ /tshad dang stobs dang snying stobs dang / /gzi mdangs brtan pa rgya chen ldan/ /rlig pa 'byar bar gyur pa gang / /gnas skabs dgu nas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rta gang rtag tu dga' zhing spro/ /lta stangs sdug cing brkam ①chags chung / /stobs ldan snying stobs phun sum tshogs/ /rlig 'bras zlum zhing mi 'phyang rta/ /de ni gnas skabs bcu pa ru/ /phyin nas srog 'dor 'gyur ba yin/ /snying stobs kha dog mdangs mtshan nyid/ /ldan zhing 'gros bzang skad gsang snyan/ /phun tshogs stobs ldan dregs par ldan / /rus pa che zhing tshigs sbom la/ /mdog bzang sha mtshams ②kun tshogs pa/ /tshe yi mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i ①gnas las tshe shes par bya ba'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //sha li ho tra dbang po thul/ /mchog dang mchog min de nyid shes/ /bu yi thu bo dumadza' las rgyal/ /nye bar ⑤song ste yang dudris pa/ /dri ni yid 'ong dge ba dang / /de bzhin dri gang mi dge ba/ /de rnams kyis ⑦ni 'bras bu dag /cir 'gyur ba ni bshad du gsol/ /bu yis de skad dris pa dang / /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /'di dag thams cad rab bshad kyis/ /thos nas zung sgel bcang bar gyis/ /'o thug sbyin sreg du ba dang / /de bzhin utpal dmar po dang / /tsandan a kar 'dra ba dang / /byi'u rug pa ardza ka /sbrang rtsi chang dang 'dra ba dang / /de bzhin chang gi dri 'dra dang / /sa la gsar du char bab dri/ /de bzhin sna ma spang spos dang / /utpal padma'i ge sar dang / /ha ri be ta padma'i rtsa/ /a phra bi ba ka pita tha/ /pa na sa 'bras 114—1619

smin 'dra ①dang / /nim ②pa ardzu ka dam dang ①/ /pa ra dul dang a sho ka /dug mo nyungs dang pan da na/ /spu ⑤na ga yi dri 'dra dang / /tsam pa ka dang ra ma la'i/ /lo ma rgya spos dri 'dra dang / /dpyid ka'i nags kyi tshogs 'dra dang / /glang po'i rdul rjogyi dri 'dra dang / /gang zhig dri ni zhim gyur pa'i/ /me tog 'bras bu ldan pa dag /de rnams dri ni mtshungs pa yi⑦/ /rta mchog de ni bkra shis so/ /rtag tu rab tu dga' ba dang / /kun gyi yid du 'ong ba dang / /don kun yang dag sgrub byed cing / /skal ldan rigs ni 'phel byed yin//ci tsam yid 'ong dri yod pa/ /de tsam yid 'ong don sgrub byed/ /tshe ring ⑧nad ni med pa dang / /nor dang dga' dang bde ba skyed/ /g.yul las rtag tu rgyal byed cing / /grags dang bu dang tsha bo skyed/ /de ltar dge ba'i dri dag ni—/ /bshad nas cig shos mnyan par gyis/ / rta ni rngul ⑨bar gyur pa dang //mang ku na yi dri 'dra dang / /bshang dang gci ba'i dri bcas dang / /de bzhin sgog pa'i dri bcas dang / /bye la rnga mo phag dang ni/ /'ug pa'i dri dang 'dra ba dang / /gang zhig khye rlig dri 'dra ba/ /dge ba'i dri la brten ⑩ma yin/ /nyes pa 'di dag ldan pa yi/ /rta de shis pa ma yin no/ /rgyal po'i don mi 'grub pa dang / /de bzhin bkra mi shis pa yin/ /ring du 'tsho bar mi 'gyur zhing / /las rnams kun la ⑪smad pa yin/ /de ltar shis dang mi shis pa'i/ /dri rnams rab tu bshad pa yin/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i ⑫gnas las dri brtag pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //sha li ho tras bu la ni/ /rta yi skad gsang ⑫mtshan nyid bshad/ /srog 114—1620

ces bya ba'i rlung shugs kyis/ /lte ba'i rtsa nas byung gyur te/ /lus la gdos par gyur nas ni/ /khar phyin 'tsher ba zhes bshad do/ /shin tu 'jam zhing gting ①ring la/ /klong che ②'dril zhing rgyun mi 'chad/ /'tsher bar byed pa'i rgyal byed rta/ /rgyal pos yang dag rgyal ba thob/ /rtsub cing nyam chung klod chung chad/ /ngar ngar po dang 'dzer bar ni/ /mgo bor phyin te 'tsher ba yi/ /rta ni bsngags sdepa ma yin no/ /dung dang rnga chen seng ge stag /shing rta'i rjogling bu khyu mkhyog ⑤sgra/ /ngar ngur glang po ku ra ra/ /'brug dang rdza rnga'i sgra 'dra zhing / /chu bo 'dra ba'i sgrar ldan pa'i/ /de ni rtag tu 'phel byed ster/ /spyang khu bya rgod rnga mo dang / /byi la ce spyang sdod chag sgra/ /khye dang dhispre'u 'ug pa dang / /shing dang rdo dang 'dre ba dang / /ser ba yi ni sgra 'dra ba/ /rta yi tha ma sdig ldan yin/ /skad zad pa yi rta rnyed na/ /myur du nyams pa thob par 'gyur—/ /thur ⑦du kha bltas 'tsher ba'i rta/ /de ni bdag po'i phongs pa ⑧skyed—/ /g.yon logs bltas ⑨te 'tsher ba dag /rigs rgyud nyon mongs byed pa yin/ /bkra mi shis pa'i rdzas dag ni/ /mthong nas mang du 'tsher byed pa/ /rta de mi shis bskyed pa ste/ /bdag po'i sdug bsngal byed par bshad//bong bu yi ltar ⑩gang yin pa/ /de ni bkra mi shis par bshad/ /bkra shis pa yi rdzas mthong na/ /gang zhig 'tsher bar byed pa'i rta/ /bdag po rnam par 'phel byed cing / /nor dang 'bru ni rgyas par bshad/ /g.yas logs su ni bltas pa 'am⑪/ /reg cing 'tsher byed gang yin pa/ /rta de zhon na rgyal po ni/ /sa rnams las ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /mang po 'tsher bar byed pa na/ /de yi 'tsher ba gsal gyur gang / /rta de rjes sgogs ⑫zhes bya ste/ /bdag po'i don 114—1621

kun sgrub byed yin/ /gcig pu 'tsher bar byed ①pa yang / /mang po ④lta bur mngon gyur pa/ /rta de gting ring 'tsher zhes bya/ /bdag po'i rnam rgyal 'phel byed yin/ /gang zhig 'tsher ba thos nas ni/ /rta gzhan 'tsher bar byed pa dag /des ni rgyal po'i rta brgya snestong / /'dod rjopar byed pa nyid yin no/ /gzhan yang 'tsher ba thos nas ni/ /rta gang phyis ⑤nas 'tsher byed pa/ /rta de zhon par gyur nas ni/ / mdza' bo rjo'aphel bar byed pa yin/ /rgan dang byes pa nad pa dang / /gcong ⑦can ngal dang skom pa dang / /bkres tshe 'tsher bar gyur pa yi/ /rta skad brtag par mi bya'o/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las skad gsang brtag skepa'i le'u ste sum cu pa'o// //rta yi tshe yi de nyid shes/ /rig byed yan lag mthar phyin la/ /'gros kyi bya ba shes pa la/ /ze tshom skyes pa gar dgar srid⑨/ /legs ldan sa yi bdag po rnams/ /g.yul du shugs mgyogs rta la ni/ / dga' zhing ⑩brtan pas rtsom byed la/ /rta la gces par 'dzin pa yi/ / mchong ba ⑪dga' ba skye 'gyur la/ /mgyogs pas shin tu yid rton 'gyur/ /rta ni 'di ltar mi mchong ba//mgyogs shugs med na dga' ⑫mi 'gyur/ /'gros 'debs myur bar 'gro ba la/ /zhon na dga' ba skyed par byed/ /sa thag ring du 'gro ba na/ /'gros bde ba ni bsngags ⑫pa yin/ /rgyal po dang ni rgyal bu dang / /bud med skyid de ba yin pas/ /bzhon pas bskyod pa'i nad rnams ni/ /de 'dras 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'gros kyi tshul ni sna tshogs las/ /shis dang mi shis 'bras bu 'byung / /legs ldan 'gros kyi tshul dag ni/ /rta la gang yod bdag la 114—1622

gsungs—/ /garga'i tshig de'i rjes la ni/ /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /mdor na ṣpe'u le sreg pa dang / /rma bya dang ni mtshungs par 'gro/ /ji ltar ṣpe'u le'i rkang pa ni/ /myur du 'dor bar byed pa ni/ /bar mtshams ①med pa lta bur mngon/ /rang gi spyi bo cung zad 'gul/ /mgo mgrin seng ge ltar 'degs shing ②/ /rgyab dang lus ni brtan par gnas/ /mjug tshos ④rgal tshigs mi 'gul zhing / /rnga ma'ang 'gul bar mi byed gang / /de ni ṣpe'u le'i 'gros can du/ /blo dang ldan pas shes par bya/ /'khrul pa med cing g.yo ba med / /lam du ma yengs byed pa dang / /zhon pa'i mi ni brtan dhibazang ngam//gru la gnas pa snyam sems ⑤zhing / /gang gi shugs ni 'dor ba na/ /zhon pa spu rtse tsam mi 'gul/ /lam ring du rjoni song gyur kyang / /chad par 'gyur ba med pa dang / /lam gyis ⑦ngoms pa med ltar 'gro/ /dbyibs ni legs par gyur pa'i rta/ /me mdag la ni reg pa ltar/ /lam du myur du 'gro ba dang / /seng ge lta bur lus 'degs shing ④/ /mchu yis nam tshong brko ⑨ba 'dra/ /sa la rtog byed de ⑩bzhin du/ /lus ni 'degs pa ltar byed dang / /zhon pa po ni dga' ⑪skyed pa/ /gang ⑫ma sreg gi 'gros bsten yin/ /gang zhig mgo drang la 'khums dang / /mgo dang ske mgrin rab tu rkyong ⑫/ /bdag po'i sems dang rjes mthun par/ /lam du mnyam par lta ④ba dang / /rtag par lam du mi bub ⑫cing / /chu ⑩yi nang du mi nub la/ /brtan zhing ma 'chol 'gro ba'i rta/ /rma bya'i 'gros la brten pa yin/ /gsum po 'di dag 'gros kyi ni/ /gtso bo yin pas shis pa 'thob/ /de las gzhan pa'i 'gros gang yin//phal cher smad par bya ba nyid/ /'gros kyi mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs/ /rta 114—1623

legs ldan rgyug pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /mnyan pa ru ni 'tshal lags so/ /'dir ni skyon gang yon tan gang / /'di rnams rnam pa du ru grags/ /mtshan nyid gang dag yin pa dag /'di dag thams cad shes par 'tshal/ /de skad smras tshe drang srong mchog /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /khyed kyi ①yid la gang gnas pa/ /de ni bshad kyis mnyan par gyis/ /rgyug pa med par rta rnams ni/ /rtsig pa shing 'dra bems ④po yin/ /rgyal po'i ste tshoms ④gsum po ni/ /sgrub la de ni gtso bo yin/ /de bas rgyug pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bzhi bcu dag tu shes par bya/ /dang por gtang ba'i don du ni/ /nyes pa nyi shu lnga shes bya/ /yang dag gzhag par bya ba yi/ /yon tan bco lnga nyid du bshad/ /de lta bu yi dhirgyug pa ni/ /zlum po dag tu nye bar sbyar/ /rang bzhin legs par shes bya ste/ /gzhan du de ni don med 'gyur/ / brdeg na lan ⑤byed dang po ste/ /rdeg dubyed gzhan la dogs pa ⑦dang / /ske ba gcu dang rnga ma bskyod⑧| /mi snyug lta zhing 'bru tshugs lta⑨/ /mgo mdud rna ba mi mnyam ⑩dang / /sdigs ⑪dang rdeg par gyur na yang / /mgo ni mi brtan gyur pa dang // 'du shes ⑫mi gsal de las gzhan/ /dbyig pa la sngangs rko ⑫byed dang / /so ni sgra dang bcas par ⑫'cha'/ /gom pa dud ⑫dang 'khyor ba dang / /bcing dang khro ba de las gzhan/ /gzhan yang bcings pas rmongs pa dang / / ske skyod brtan ⑩par mi gnas dang / /dogs bcas yan lag 'khyor ba dang / /yan lag rengs dang yan lag chung ⑩/ /lus ni brtan par mi gnas dang / /de bzhin gom pa mi brtan dang / /dbyibs mi mnyam dang dbyibs mi sdug /'di dag rta ni ngan par bshad/ /'di dag rnams kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /bshad 114—1627

pa nga las bzung bar gyis/ /gang zhig rdeg na slar rdeg pa/ /rdeg ①na lan byed yin shes bya/ /gang zhig rdeg par byed pa la/ /dogs 'dod 'dog ④pa can zhes bya/ /ske ba rang dgar 'jog pa ni/ /ske gcu ①rta yi tha ma yin/ /rnga ma brkyang rjodang sprug byed cing / /yang yang bskyod pa ⑤rnga sprugs yin/ /rtag tu rdeg par 'dod pa ni/ /mi sdug rta zhes de bshad do/ /gang zhig basbabs ④kyang cung zad tsam/ /mi stong sems kyis stong par 'dug /de ni blta dzeebar sdug pa ste/ /des na 'bru ⑧tshugs lta zhes bshad/ /gang zhig rtag tu sa la blta/ /mgo dud pa ni yin zhes bya/ / brdegs sam gzhus ⑨par gyur pa na/ /khros pas rna ba 'chol bar 'jog /de ni rna ba mi mnyam yin/ /rang bzhin gyes yong ma gtogs so/ /gang zhig spyi bo rtag tu bskyod⑩/ /de na ⑪mgo mi brtan zhes bya/ /gang zhig rta ⑩ni mi dran pa/ /de ni 'du shes ⑫mi gsal yin/ /lcag ④la sogs pa gcig gis kyang / /gnod med dbyeg pa la'ang sngangs 4steyin/ /lag pa gnyis kyis sa rko spyob/ /de ni rko byed zhes spyobashad do/ /khro bas so ni 'cha' byed pa/ /so sgra 'cha' zhes bya bar bshad/ /rta gang 'dul bar byed pa yi/ /rjes su cung zad mi 'jug cing / /gom pa la lar sdud pa dang / /la lar yang ni 'khyor byed pa/ /mi mnyam pa yi 'gros can te/ /gom pa sdud cing 'khyor ba yin/ /ro stod ro smad gdong pa 'am/ /yid na lus kyi bar dag tu/ /gang zhig bcings na myur du 'khrug /bcings na khro ba'i rta ru 'dod/ /gang zhig thag pas bcings na ni/ /bcings pas blo gros rmongs gyur yin/ /ro smad kyi ni lus byed 'gul/ /bskyod pas rked pa skyod ⑫byed yin/ /'dis ⑪ni bdag la rdeg snyom ste/ /114—1628

yang skyur byed yin/ /'gre ba lta bur byed pa dang / /khal ni legs par bkal gyur kyang / /sa gzhir skyur bar byed pa dang / /'dul sbyong mkhan la gnod bya'i phyir/ /mgal me bskor ①ba lta bur 'khor/ /rgyab ni glang po ltar bsgyur zhing / /yang dang yang du sprugs sdepa dang / /so dang lag yab dag gis 'debs/ /shing yang ltung bar byed pa dang / /g.yang du yang ①yang skyur byed dedu/ /bgrod bya las ni gzhan du rgyug /dogs pa med par ldog pa dang / /lan 'gas gzhan du'ang 'gro bar byed/ /ra dang ri dwags ltar mchong zhing / /bar bar du ni 'dul byed skyur/ /chu ngogs shing dang khron pa dang / /grogs ⑤srol du yang rgyug cing 'byeradu/ /rta khyu'i nang na mi 'dug cing / /dpung gzhan gyi ni nang du'ang 'gro/ /rab tu 'bad pas kha bsgyur ⑦yang / /zlog par nus pa ma yin la/ /rta byes las ni mi 'byung zhing / /byung dang 'jug tu mi 'dod la/ /srog 'phrog las ni gang dang gang / /yid du mi 'ong las gang yin/ /de dag lhag par byed 'gyur zhing / /brdungs kyang phan pa med pa ni/ /de ni gra ma can zhes bya/ /de yi mtshan nyid 'di nyon cig/ khyar tshad khur ⑧ni yo ba dang / /kha dang pho mtshan yo ba dang / /rta gang 'phral ba mgos ⑨'dra dang / /rlig pa shin tu 'phyang ba dang / /ri mo chen po yod pa dang / /ya mchu nag cing rkan yang nag /gang zhig mchu ltag zhom ⑩pa dang / /ser skya dmar ser mdog can dang / /gang gi mche ba mi mnyam zhing / /gdong la gnyer ma yod pa dang / /mig nag ser ba nyid dang ni/ /mig sbom khra yi mig 'dra dang / /bya rgod mig 'dra mkhyar tshos ⑪chung / /gang gi ya mchu thung ba dang / /mgo bo rna ba rab tu che/ /'gram pa yang ni zhum pa 114—1632

dang / /sbal pa ①byi la'i mig 'dra zhing / /ri bong mdog 'dra mdangs rtsub dang / /rlig ①pa gcig ni dkar ba 'am/ /yang na rlig ①pa gsum dkar la//bshang ba'i mdog 'dra du ba'i mdog /phrag so la ni gnyer ma chags/ /'di dag dang ni gzhan mang ngo rjo/ /mtshan ldan gra ma can du 'dod/ /de bas 'di dang rigs can rta/ /gnas dang slob sbyong bya ba dang / /de bzhin rgyug pa'i bya ba rnams/ /rte'u nas brtsam pa ⑤so sor bya/ /bya ba'i khyad par gzhan yang ni/ /rim pa bzhin du bshad par bya/ /rlung med gnas na rjorab dben pa/ /spyod yul bde bar gzhag par bya/ /de rjes reg na bzod gyur ⑦la—/ /de nas bya ba gzhan dag bya/ / bdag po ⑧zas dang skom bcas dang //sman rnams cho ga ci bzhin bya/ / gandha bha dra pu shel tsesti/ /ka ra bī ⑩ra'i me tog ni/ /'o mar bcas dang ka lang tha/ /bskol ⑫ba der ni til thal ba/ /ko ke lakṣa swardzi ka'i/ /thal ba dang ni bcas par ⑫gzhug /bskol ⑫ba dar ba dang bcas par/ /nyi ma bdun gyi bar du gzhag /'di ni 'di la zhag bdun par/ /cho ga bzhin du btung ba sbyin/ /de ltar btung bas dbang gyur na—/ /rta ni reg pa la sogs bzod/ /bdag ④gcin dang ni rgod ma'i gcin/ /yungs kar de bzhin rna spabs dang / /pi pi ling rtsa nag tshur bcas/ /ha re nu ka tsha ba gsum/ /tsandan ⑫dang ni ldan pa ru/ /btags te dben par spang ⑩bar bya/ /'di yis zla tshigs dag tu ni/ /rta la mig sman bsku bar bya/ /de ⑩ni rang bzhin gyis gso dka'/ /gra ma can ni zhi bar bya/ /dom dang gzig ⑫sder khyi'i rus pa/ /ba lang 'gram pa yungs kar dang / /rma bya'i mkhris pa ldan par ⑩ni/ /gdug ⑩pa gra ma can sel yin/ /rta byes su ni rtag pa ru/ /114—1633

gdug ①pa 'di ni gdul bar bya/ /tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la/ /khyad par du ni bdug pas bdug /des na reg dang sgra dang ni/ /gzugs ni bde bar brten bzod 'gyur/ /gang dang gang ni byed du bcug /de de rjes su mthun par byed/ /rkan dang kha 'gram dpral ba dang / /ma rkan smin ma'i 'og dang ni/ /rta yi mig la'ang pi pi ling / /rtsa ba tsha ba gsum kyis bskusde/ /'di yi lus ni thams cad kyang / /ba yi phyi bas yang yang bsku/ /'di yi yan lag nang grol ①ni/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni kha ras bsku/ /e la u shrir pra durtsi pog /ru rta tsandan a ka ru/ /nā ⑤ga ge sar til mar bcas/ /bdug pas rta la rab tu bdug /rta ni nyag par dugyur pa na/ /bdug pas yang yang bdug ⑦na ni/ /sgra dang reg dang gzugs dag ni/ /nges par bzod par 'gyur ba yin / /ji srid nges par zhi gyur par/ /cho ga 'di ni sbyar bar bya/ /de tshe 'khrugs ⑧par mi byed cing / /rta rdzi la ni gnod mi byed/ /gang stin gnas la mi sdang zhing / /khro ba med par rtswa rnams za/ /rna ba 'jums par mi byed cing / /'dul sbyong mkhan la mngon par dga'/ /lam du zhugs par chas pa na/ /'dor ⑩zhing 'jigs par mi 'gyur la/ /khrid ⑪na sems ni dul 'gyur ⑫zhing / /tshig gis bsdigs na'ang 'jigs par 'gyur/ /ci dga' bar ni khyer na yang / /log par byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /dngos po gzhan la brdegs ⑫na yang / /de ni 'jigs pa skye mi ⑫'gyur/ /de ltar gra ma med pa'i rta/ /bzod pa can du bshad pa yin/ /dmod pa gdon gyi nyes pa dang / /rta yi rlung nad nyes pa dang / /yul gyi nyes pa btang snyoms gzhag/mi srun ⑫'grogs pa dag las kyang / /rta ni sems shes mi 'gyur las/ /gra 114—1634

ma can du 'gyur ba yin/ /de bas nyes pa 'di rnams la/ /zhi ba'i thabs 'di yin par 'dod/ /gang la cho ga 'di dag ni/ /byas kyang gra ma ma zhi na/ /de tshe 'brog stong dag tu yang ①/ /de la ltos sdepar mi bya'o/ /gang tshe mi 'am rta gzhan gyi/ /phyi nas snyeg par byed par 'gyur/ /de'i ①tshe rlig pa chung ④ba yis/ /'di yi sems 'khrugs zhi bar byed⑤/ /gra ma can ni legs dul yang / /g.yul du gzhug par mi bya ste/ /gal te 'di yis rjorang bzhin nyid/ /las kyi dbang gis gsal byed srid/ /gang zhig gra ma can zhi nas/ /la lar mi srun byed gyur na/ /dang po de ni byed tshul gyis/ /nye bar legs par sbyar bar bya/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las gra ma can brtag pa'i le'u ste ⑦sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //bu sngon nga ni rta byes su/ /gnyid log pa na rta der btab/ /nga ni khro ba ches khyab pas/ /de la dmod pa btab par gyur/ /bkra mi shis dang rnam kun du/ /spang bar bya ba ⑧nyid gyur cing / /bdag po chung mar bcas pa'i yang / /rigs ni rlag ⑨pa nyid gyur cig /nga yi dmod pa'i dbang gis ni⑫//nyes pa che dang ldan par ni⑪/ /rta rnams 'gyur ba nyid yin la/ /'di yi ming ni shes par gyis/ /shis pa gzhan dang ldan gyur kyang / /rta yi tha chad de spang bya/ /so yis ⑫kha khengs kha dog nag /de bzhin so ni mi mnyam lhag /yo zhing 'gul la chag ⑫pa dang / /so gyes pa dang mi tshang dang / /nya phyis 'dra dang zur gsum dang / /skyes tshe so yod nyin mo skyes/ /ze'u lta ④pus mo ze'u dang / /snying ga na ni gtsug yod dang / /yan lag ma tshang rmig cher skyes/ /114—1635

thams cad zad par byed pa yin/ /chu zheng tshad kyi grangs las ni/ /lhag par gang zhig gnas gyur pa'i/ /yan lag yod pa'i rta yis ni/ /nor ni lhag par nyams byed yin/ /lo lnga'i bar du rlig pa med/ /rgod ma la yang mi 'jug pa/ /dbang 'phel gang yin rta des ①ni/ /rigs ni rlag ①par byed par bshad/ /gang gi rmig pa mdog mi mthun/ /thig le yis ni khra bor gyur/ /de ni rmig pa thig le can/ /bdag po'i rigs ni rlag snebyed yin/ /pags pa bsregs pa'i dri 'dra ba/ /me yis tshig par byed pa yin/ /rta mi gnag la rkan nag dupa/ /myur du mtshon gyis gsod par byed/ /gang gi rkan la gnyer ma ni/ /gsum mam bzhi dag yod gyur pa/ /de ni rkan nag nyes pa yis/ /dgos pa med pa'i rtar 'gyur ro/ /mdog nag dud pa'i mdog can dang / /dngul rdo bcag ⑤pa'i mdog ltar 'tsher/ /rta de'i rkan kun nag na yang / /mdog dang mthun pas nyes pa med/ /kha dog brgyad po rnams kyi ni/ /cung zad dmar zhing gnyer ma gsal/ /dkar dang dar bumadog skya ba dang / /seng ge ngur pa'i mdog rjes 'dra/ /dmar dang ser dang sngo bsangs ⑦kyi/ /rkan gnag pa ni bsngags ⑧ma yin/ /ri mo shin tu dma' ba yis/ /rmig pa gnyis su snang gyur te/ /ba lang mig pa 'dra ba ⑨ni/ /gang gi rmig pa snang gyur pa/ /bdag po'i lus dang yid kyi ni/ /mi bzad ⑪sdug bsngal gnyis bskyed ⑪nas/ /ring por ⑫mi thogs dus kyis ni/ /de dang lhan cig 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rngog ma'i mthar ni rten pa'i rwa⑫/ /mthe bo'i tshigs ⑫dang 'dra ba 'am/ /rgya shugs ⑫sgyu ru ra 'dra ba'am/ /a mra'i ⑩rus pa 'dra ba ni/ /gang gi rta la snang gyur ram/ /rwa ⑩yi rtse na rwa 'dra gnas/ /sha 'tsher spyogazhang 114—1637

rnamasarka/ /'di dag thams cad rlag ①par ni/ /rta de la ni zhon pas 'gyur/ /rta gang rmig par bcas par skye/ /mtshe mar ②byung bar gyur pa dag /gang dag tu ni byung gyur pa/ /rigs de yongs su brdug ①pa yin/ /sems med bcing dang gsod pa dang / /blun pas ngar dusems med par 'gyur/ /'jigs pa chen po nye bar ni/ /byed pas ring du spang bar bya/ /gang zhig gshin po la bsngos dang / /rta gang gshin pos khyer ba yi/ /rta de yi dwags kyis khyer yin/ /rtag tu nyes pa thams cad rnam/ /dbang po 'phel ba dang 'dra zhing / /za ma'i gzugs can ma ning yin/ /rgyab tu zhon pa rjoganod byed pa / /yi dwags kyis khyer bzhin du yang ⑦/ /gnyis sam mang po mtshe ⑧mar skyes—/ /bu dang bcas pa yongs su spang / /so yi le'ur ⑨so'i nyes pa/ /mig le'ur mig gi ⑩nyes pa dang / /gtsug gi 'bras bu dag las ni/ /gtsug ngan 'bras bu bcas zhes bya/ /dpral bar chags pa zhur dang 'dra/ /'dres pa'i le'u gang bshad pa/ /nu ma can dang rlig pa nag /mgo nag la sogs par bshad pa⑪/ /'di yi 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /'di ru rgyas pas ⑫ma bshad do/ /der ni spang bya gang yin pa/ /'dir yang 'bras bu de dang 'dra/ /de nyid tshe yi gnas skabs la/ /bab la nyes pa'i 'bras byin ⑫bshad/ /nyes chen shin tu nyes che ba/ /rtag tu 'bras bu 'byen byed yin/ /shin tu bzang ba'i mtshan nyid kun/ /ldan na nyes pa chen po'ang bcang / /shin tu nyes chen ldan pa ni/ /nam yang bcang bar mi bya'o/ /gal te yon tan gzhan ldan yang / /shin tu nyes cher ldan pa'i rta/ /khyim du skad cig tsam gyis ni④/ /mkhas pas gzhag par mi bya'o/ /reg pa yis kyang rta de ni/ /phung khrol dang 114—1639

zhing gdug pa dang / /chang dang sbyar chang sha la dga'/ /gdong ni mi sdug par snang ba/ /srin po'i snying stobs la brten yin/ /mi brtan rtsub cing dri ma can/ /rtag tu mi gtsang la spyod cing / /zhum zhing khang stong dag la dga'//sha za'i snying stobs la brten yin/ /blun zhing lam log 'gro la dga'/ /rgod ma yi ni phyi bzhin rgyug /rtag tu rtswa za la dga' ba/ /dud 'gro'i snying stobs dag dang mtshungs/ /rlung dang grang lhags tshad pa bzod/ /bdag po la dga' skad snyan cing / /sems khong ①chud cing le lo can/ /mi rgyu'i snying stobs la brten yin/ /rke mgrin btud cing 'jigs pa can/ /rtag tu gnas 'di stong par dga'/ /mi gtsang la dga'i ngang tshul can/ /srin bu'i snying stobs la brten yin/ /shugs chen rgyun du ltos pa dang / /yongs su 'khor ba'i ngang tshul can/ /rgod ②ma la ni rab dga' ba'i/ /rta ni 'dab chags snying stobs can/ /dpa' zhing 'jigs pa nyid du ni/ /dus dang dus su gnas 'gyur zhing / /rgod ma la ni rab dga' ba/ /'chi ba yis ④ni shin tu 'jigs/ / brdegs pa rjon ni rab tu 'khrug /rtse ⑤dang khyem du gnas la dga'/ /byas pa tshor ni stobs dang ldan/ /mi yi snying stobs can de yin/ /lha dang drang srong gnod sbyin klu/ /dri za dang ni snying stobs dag /mnyam par gyur pa'i rta gang yin/ /las rnams kun la rab tu bsngags/ /mi dang yi dwags lha ma yin/ /bya dang mtshungs pa bar ma yin/ /de las gzhan pa'i snying stobs can/ /rta ni tha ma yin par bshad/ /kun du snying stobs gtso bo ste/ /snying stobs la ni thams cad gnas/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gnas las snying stobs brtag pa'i le'u ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //114—1641

bzang po yang / /spyod pa ngan pa snang ba dang / / mtshan nyid dhimi shes ldan gyur kyang / /kha cig rang bzhin bzang po mchis/ /der ni rgyu dag gang lags pa/ /yang dag par ni gsungs zhes dris/ /ston ka btsas pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag par ni bka' stsol cig /de gnyis kyis de dris pa na/ /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /lung la goms byas shes rab ni/ /nam yang slu bar byed pa min⑦/ /lus dang mdog dang stobs ldan pa/ /tshul ngan ring du gyur pa yin/ /la la lus ni gtsang gyur kyang / /snying stobs mi nyams gyur pa yis / /phyin ci log gi snying stobs can/ /lus ni gtugs ①par ston par bshad—/ /de ni shes rab dman dupa yi/ /skye bo phal cher ⑤rmongs par 'gyur//skye ba nyid dang gces pa dang / /shis dang mi shis mi rtogs 'gyur/ /de bas dbyibs legs snying stobs ldanarjo/ /ngang tshul bzang ba'i dam pa ni/ /snying stobs ngang tshul lus byad ni/ /sun 'byen byed de spang bar ⑦bya/ /de ni nga yis bshad bya yis/ /khyad par mnyan pa nyid du gyis/ /dbyebs legs pa dang dpa' ba dang / /gzi mdangs stobs dang ma yengs dang / /'phel ka che zhing sems bzang la/ /dar la bab cing mdangs bzang la/ /dbang po brtan zhing dga' ba dang / /snying stobs mgyogs byad ⑧ldan pa yi/ /de 'dra ba yi rta dag ni/ /yul dang dus las ⑨dga' gyur par/ /rtswa dang chu mang dus su ni/ /pha dang ma ni 'dus gyur pa'ang / /de tshe skyes gyur rte'u ni/ /yon tan kun dang ldan pa yi/ /rta ni de dag nyid kyis na/ /yon tan de nyid skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod bcas pa dang 'dod bral ba'am/ /don du gnyer dang don mi gnyer/ /gzhon dang shin tu rgan pa dang / /rte'u dang rta rgan 114—1647

nyid kyis ni/ /lus dang snying stobs ngang tshul rnams/ /bzang ngan 'dres pa nyid du 'gyur/ /khro dang 'khrug par gyur pa dang / /'jigs dang skrag par byed pa dang / /gcong can dang ni nyam chung dang / /ngal dang sems ni dub pa dang / /skye bar byed pa'i rta gang yin/ /las la mkho bar ①mi 'gyur ro/ /de ni mdangs stobs dman 'gyur zhing / /las rnams kun la nus pa chung / /rtag tu na zhing rgyun du sbeg④ /gang zhig rnyog can 'gyur ba'i ①rta/ /pha dang ma yi rgud pa yis/ /stobs chung gzi mdangs zhan par 'gyur/ /de ltar skye bar gyur pa'i rta/ /las rnams 'grub par mi byed do/ /dgun rjomatha' tshad pa'i thog ma ru/ /dpyid dus srog chags rnams la phan/ /thun mong dus su gyur pa'i tshe/ /lus gzungs snyoms par gyur pa'i rta/ /rgod ma lo bzhi lon pa dang / /rta pho lo brgyad lon pa dang / /'dus gyur pa las gyur pa'i rta//rtag tu las rnams kun la bsngags/ /de ni yon tan kun ldan zhing / /nyes pa kun dang bral ba yin/ /lus kyi phyi nang dag gi ni/ /yon tan ldan zhing kun sbyor nus/ /mdza' las rgyal gyis yang smras pa/ /tha mal pa dang nad bcas gnas/ /ston ka pa ⑤ni gang dag lags/ /gsor rung gsor mi rung ba dag /gang lags the tshom skyes lags kyirjo/ /drang srong chen po de dzeegasungs shig /mdza' las rgyal gyis de skad dris⑧/ /legs ldan gyis ⑨ni beer smras pa/ /'bras bu bzang dang ngan pa yi/ /phun tshogs ston ka'i tshe na gnasarka/ / 'bru yi ⑩phun tshogs mthun pas na/ /rta la'ang ston ka pa zhes bshad—/ /rang bzhin de 'drar gyur pa yi/ /ston ka rnam pa bzhi ru mthong / /rang bzhin la gnas de bzhin sbom/ /phra dang dmar ba'i ston ka pa'o/ /114—1648

rang bzhin la gnas mchog yin te/ /phra dang sbom dang gzhan /1pa yin/ /rte'u ston ka dmar po ni/ /spang bar bya bar gyur pa yin/ /phra dang sgom pa phrad pa las/ /sbom pa'am yang na phra bar 'gyur/ /phal cher gang gi mtshan nyid gang / /de las lhag par mi 'gyur ro/ /skye gnas snying stobs lus kyi ni / /mtshan nyid dang ni rtags dag las/ /'di rnams kyi ni las dag kyang / /thams cad rim bzhin bshad par bya/ /rgod ma'i sems stobs nye ba dang / /lam du zhugs par gyur pa yis/ /khur dang gom pa dag gis ni—/ /de ni tsha bas gdungs gyur cing / /bkres dang skom pas nyen snyepas na/ /mngal nas khrag ni 'dzag par 'gyura'/ /zla ba drug ni 'das pepa na/ /sha ni khrag tu 'gyur ba yin/ /mngal de'i tshil ni gang yin pa'ang / /phra mo tsam zhig yod mi 1'gyur/ /rus phra besha ni srab pa ru/ /skye ba ston ka pedamar po yin/ /'di ni longs spyod mi rung zhing / /las rnams nus pa'ang ma yin no/ /mngal ni chags par gyur pa'i rta/ /zas kyi bya bas 'phel mi 'gyur/ /rtsub cing rdo ba za ba dang / /de bzhin lam du zhugs pa dang / /khur gyis dub par byas pa dang / /bcings dang rta pho dang sbyar dang / /der ni mngal chags gyur pa yis8/ /khrag zad log par 'gyur ba yin/ /ji ltar char med sman rnams ni/ /skye bar 'gyur ba ma yin la/ / 'bad med sheme tog 'bras bu sogs/ /'phel bar 'gyur ba'ang ma yin no/ /de bzhin log par gsos pa yis/ /rta yi mngal ni skams par 'gyur/ /de ni sbeg cing nyam chung ba'i/ /rte'u dus ni 'da' bar rkabyed—/ /dus ma 'das pa'ang nyam chung zhum/ /yan lag ma tshang skye bar 7/4 /64 9

nyid thams cad bsngags pa dang / /'dzin dang 'jog par byed pa la①/ /rtag tu mnyam pa med par dpa'/ /ston ka dag dang gezhes 'di bshad/ /rta ni bzang po yin par bstanasne/ /rkang pa brtan duzhing 'gros che la/ /lus kyi 'phel ka che zhing legs/ /rtag tu khal gyi sbyor ba dang / /las rnams la ni nges sbyor nus/ /de ni slob dpon dam pa yis/ /rag ⑤pa'i rang bzhin ston kar rjobashad/ /de ni bkra shis rta yin te/ /rgyal po'i bzhon par de nyid bshad / /de ni g.yul ngor rab tu bsngags/ /rtag tu rgod ma'i gseb tu bzang / /de ni byang zhing dpa' ba dang / /mchod sbyin la yang rta de bzang / /rtag tu tshangs pa smra ba yi⑦/ /rta mchog ces ni de bshad do/ /de ni rtag tu bzhon par bzang / /skye dgu skyed pa yin par bshad/ /'di yi las rnams bshad pa ste/ /gzhan yang mngal can zhes bya'o/ /rta yi mchog tu gyur pa 'di//las la sgyid lug 'gyur ma yin/ /ston ka ba ni bzhi po 'di/ /mtshan nyid grangs ni dus ⑧ma yin/ /sbom dang rang bzhin la gnas dang / /dmar dang de bzhin phra ba ste/ /rnam pa bzhi po gso ba dang / / bcas par de bzhin bshad pa yin/ /⑨gzhan yang pags pa la sogs pa'i/ /rang bzhin gang yin bshad par bya/ /pags srab mdangs snum phun sum tshogs⑫/ /ba spu snum zhing gnyer ma snyoms/ /gsang ba'i phyogs ni mdzes pa dang / /gtsug ni bzang por gang gyur dang / /blo ldang ⑪byang zhing mgyogs pa dang / / rmang kha mnyan zhing ⑫tshor ba can/ /shin tu 'byar bar gang gyur pa/ /pags ⑫pa bzang por de bshad do/ /yan lag tshad dang ldan pa dang / /lus kun lag ④par snyoms pa dang / /dmar zhing dmar ba'i mdog rjas thinyecan/ /mig 114—1653

ni phan pa yin/ /chang ni kha ra sbrang rtsi dang / /sbyar ba btung bar blud gyur na//khong pa'i me drod skyed byed cing / /kha yi ljan ldin sbyong bar byed/ /bu ram yang ni khyad par du/ /ro tsa byed cing rlung mkhris skyed/ /kha zhing bska ba'i ro ldan pa/ /zhu rjes tsha bar gyur pa yin/ /zhu rjes tsha zhing rtsub pas na/ /bad kan sbyong bar byed pa yin/ /de bzhin tsha zhing rtsub pa ①na/ /mkhris pa rlung ni 'khrugs ②par byed/ /kha rab sel zhing rtsub pas na/ /drod po min pas rlung skyed byed/ /nim pa seng phrom ④thra yang ku/ /gla ④sgang pi pi ling btab ⑤dang / /sbrang rtsi dang ni sbyar ba yi/ /btung ba dpyid kyi dus su bsngags/ /shing mngar seng phrom dupi pi ling / /thra yang ku dang bca' lga ⑦btab/ /bu ram dang sbyar btung ba blud/ /sos ka'i tshe na bsngags pa yin/ /thang shing dang ni bca' lda ⑧dang / /lan tshwa dang ni til mar dang / /pi pi leng phye btab pa yi/ /rjes su btung ba dbyar tshe bsngags/ /shu ti bca' lga ⑨pi pi ling / /tsi tra ka dang na le sham/ /kha ra rgun ⑩'bru dang sbyar ba'i/ /rjes su btung ba ston tshe bsngags/ /'tsho byed sde tshan ⑪pi pi ling / /shing mngar dang ni ma nu dang / / seng phrom ⑫rgyam tsha dang sbyar ba'i/ /btung ba dgun gyi dus su bsngags/ /zi ra dang ni byi dang ga /tsha ba gsum dang tsi tra ka /bye myang tsha dang sbrang rtsi btab/ /btung ba dgun gyi dus su bsngags/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan rnams/ /rnam pa du mar 'khrugs gyur pa'i/ /gso ba nye bar bstan pa la/ /rjes su btung ba blud par bya/ /nyi ma shar ma thag tu ni//dang po gdong ni bkrus nas kyang / /khong pa dag gyur rta rnams la/ /rjes su btung ba blud par bya/ /chu ni grang mo dag gis kyang / /gdong du nye bar 114—1661

ston ni rgun ①chang sbyin par bya/ /zla phyed dus dang sman sbyar ②ba/ /gang zhig blud bya de bshad bya/ /snga dro khong pa sbyangs pa la/ /chang gi dwangs ma phul gang dang / /de bzhin til mar phul phyed dang / /kha ra dkar po srang bcu dang / /tsha ba gsum ni srang gcig dang / /lan tshwa yang ni srang gcig dag /rta ni chen po la sbyin bya/ /de yis de la thob par 'gyur/ /bar ma la ni brgyad cha dag /de la rnam par dbye bar bya/ /pi pi ling dang na le sham/ /pa ra chu dag pu tse shel/ /bca' lga ①dang ni shing kun dag /srang gcig dag dhini yin par bshad/ /sngar bshad pa yi tshad las ni/ /phul gang nyid ni 'di la sbyin—/ /lan tshwa kha ra til mar ni/ /sngar bshad pa yi phyed du 'dod/ /chang blud rjes la 'o ma ni/ /'bad de yongs su spang bar sdebya/ /de bzhin 'o ma blud rjes la/ /chang sbyin par yang mi bya'o/ /chang 'thungs rjes la skom blud pa'am/ /zas kyi rjes la blud pa'ang rung / /zas ni dus rnams kun du sbyin//skom ni phyi dro blud par bya/ /skom blud rjes la rtsol drag dupa/ /rnam pa kun du spang bar bya/ /zla phyed dus su gang sbyin pa/ /de ni ci bzhin sngar bshad yin/ /sha li ho tra'i gnas bdun pa las rjes su btung ba bstan pa'i le'u'o// //sha li ho tra ⑦thub mchog la/ /legs thos kyis ni yang ⑧dris pa/ /sman pa mchog gis rta rnams la/ /ro drug po ni dgos par gsungs/ /ro drug po ni dgos pa la/ /'di la shas cher lan tshwa ni/ /sbyor ba kun la rab shes te/ /lus ni rtas ⑨par byed pa dang / /kha zas len par ⑩nus pa dang / /lto bar phyin par gyur pa ni⑪/ /legs nyes ci 'gyur rgyu de gsungs/ /de skad dris tshe 114—1663

byed— sde—— ——— ——— legs ldan ni/ /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /rta ni rlung gi shugs ldan zhing / /rlung shas lhag par che ba yin/ /rlung 'joms pas ni ro drug las/ /lan tshwa rta la mchog tu bsngags/ /mdangs ni rnam par 'phel byed cing / /sbyor ba kun dang rjes mthun la/ /ljang pa shas cher mngar bas na/ /'ju dka' bar ni bshad pa yin/ /de bas lan tshwa phan gyur cing / /rta rnams rtas ①par byed pa yin/ /gzhan yang lan tshwa'i yon tan rnams/ /nga yis bshad kyis de nyan gyisaske/ /'drul zhing drod ni skyed byed la/ /zas 'ju lus rgyas byed pa'i mchog /drags na bad kan skyed byed cing / /lus kyang lhod par 'gyur ba pe bshad—/ /ran pas kha ni sbyong byed cing / /stobs skyed ④mdog ni dag byed yin—/ /gang zhig rlung nad kyis nyen dang / /gang zhig rtswa tha)dang 'gras pa dang / /gang yang yid mi bder gyur dang / /gnyid ni med par gyur pa dang / /gang zhig me drod nyams pa 'am/ /gang zhig me drod ma snyoms dang / /lus gzungs ①rnams la gnod bya las/ /brtas ⑦kyang tshon por ma gyur dang / /de la tshad ldan lan tshwa ni/ /byin na nad rnams sel byed yin/ /lan tshwa 'ba' zhig byin pa 'am/ /chang dang sbyar te sbyin (ṣpe)par bya/ /lan tshwa shepho ba'i me drod ni/ /skyed ⑩cing mdog stobs 'phel byed yin/ /lus ni rnam par rgyas byed yin⑪/ /zas kyang mang du za bar nus/ /de ltar lan tshwa'i yon tan ni—/ /bshad nas so so'i dbye ba bstan/ /rgyam tsha dang ni kha ru tsha/ /rgya mtsho'i tsha dang mtsho tsha dang / /ya bakṣa ra sro sgo ⑫ka /rtsal 7ru tsha ni bdun pa yin/ /bul tog brgyad pa nyid yin no/ /'di ni lan bo'i tshogs su 'dod//kun la rgya tsha nyepamachog yin te/ /de nas rim gyis yon tan chung / /'di 1/4 /664

bdag cag cha ni skog ①tu bshad/ /'di ni rta yi khang ④pa na/ /gnas tshe nad ni ci ltar bskyed/ /zas snekyi nang du ro gang zhig /chu yis rnam par rgyas par byed/ /sman pa mchog las 'di dag gi/ /nges pa bdag ni mnyan par 'tshal/ /bu yis de skad dris pa dang / /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /legs thos 'di dag thams cad ni/ /yang dag ④nyid du mnyan par gyis/ /chu dang shing ni mang ba dang / /rlung mang than pa med gyur pa/ /de ni rlan ⑤can yin zhes bya/ /rta la mchog ni yin par 'dod/ /gang na shing dang chu nyung zhing / /rlung med than pa che gyur pa/ /yul de skams pa rjocan zhes bya/ /rta la rtag tu bzang ma yin/ /rlan can skams pa 'dren ⑦ma ni/ /de ni thun mong yin par bshad/ /de ltar rnam pa gsum po yi/ /yul las goms par 'byung ba yin/ /yul ni yon tan mang ba las/ /bu yi ⑧yon tan chen por sti'agyur—/ /chu yi yon tan chu las ni/ /sman rnams kyi ⑩ni yon tan 'byung / /sman gyi yon tan rdzogs gyur na/ /lus kyi yon tan chen po skyed⑪/ /de phyir rta ⑫yi lus 'dzin pa/ /gtso bo yul ni yin par bshad/ /bsel zhing 'tsho byed rlan par byed/ /shin tu phra zhing brtags ⑫pa dang / /khyab cing ri yi gnas gyur la/ /yang zhing snum pa bcud len 'gyur/ /chu ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /dgos pa'i gtso yin rigs drug ldan/ /de las char chu mchog yin te/ /de ni rlung dang 'dre bar 'gyur/ /ldud ⑫cing phyogs kyi gtsor gyur la/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mkha' la gnas/ /chu la ro gang mi snang ba / /de ni yul las brtag ⑫par bya/ /ro ni gang yang mi bro zhing / /gtsang zhing dwangs la dri med pa/ /ma 'dres sla ⑩la bsel zhing yang / /chu de 114—1667

par byed pa yin/ /rnga mo'i tsha zhing lan tshwa 1 bro/ /gzhang 'brum skrangs dang lto nad sel/ /lug gi phyi stizhing bad kan skyed/ /mngar zhing snum shas che ba yin//rta yi 'o ma zhu rjes tsha/ /yang zhing phan par byed pa yin/ /ba ①glang 'o ma tsha zhing zhim/ /yang zhing lud pa thams cad sel/ /bud med 'o ma mngar bcas snum—/ /mig nad rnams la phan pa yin/ / skye gnas goms pas lus rtas ④byed / /mngar bas bad kan 'phel byed yin/ /bsel bas snum pa skyed byed yin/ /grang bas khu ba 'phel bar byed/ /'di dag phyi dang yang ba dang //'dres na nus hūṃpa 'dren par byed/ /yang na sgrum dang ldan par ni/ /bya ba de dag rnams la sbyin/ /sos ka'i tshe na ma te'i ⑥mchog /dgun ni lug gi'ang bsngags pa yin/ /ba yi 'o ma dbyar gyi tshe/ /rta la byin na bsngags pa yin / /ra dang ma te dpyid tshe bzang / /mar yang 'o ma dang 'drar bshad/ /mar gsar ro tsa 'khru gcod ⑦cing / /bska la bad kan sel byed yin/ /zho ni snum skyur dro ba bsre/ /'khru gcod lus ni rtas dābyed yin/ /dkyugs pya pa sgyur ba nyes chung zhing / /me drod skyed byung bad kan sel/ /dar ba bad rlung sel byed yin/ /skra dang gzhang 'brum dag la phan/ /'di ni drud nyes nyes pa yis/ /'o mas khong pa'i nad skyed yin/ /tshad las ches sam 6 dus min par / /'o ma 'thungs na gnod pa skyed/ /chang 'thungs 'o ma 'thungs pa 'am—/ /'o ma'i rjes la chang 'thungs pa'am/ /rta ni rtsol drags ⑪byas gyur nas / /gal te 'o ma blud pa las/ /de rjes rjen pa zos gyur na/ /'o ma ma zhur gyur pa des/ /bad kan gnas las bskyod ⑫gyur nas/ /de rjes snying la gnod par byed/ /bad kan g.yos par gyur pa na/ /me drod nyams par byed 114—1672

pa'i dugs ni so sor bya/ /dkri ba'i dugs zhes bya ba ni/ /gong bu'i dugs kyang yin par bshad/ /til dang ma sha zar ma phabs/ /nas dang gro dang ku lattha—/ /la phug e raṇḍa'i stis bon/ /de bzhin ga gon gso ma yi/ /sa bon yungs kar thang ⑤shing dang / /sa la ra dang ru rta dang / /shu ti dang ni po son cha/ /ra sna rgya spos chu srin san④/ /de bzhin rlung 'joms pa yi sman/ /phye mar zhib tu btags par bya/ /sdum ni bzhi po gzhug bya zhing / /sbrang rtsi zho dang 'o ma gzhug /de ltar snum rab ldan sbyar la/ /lan tshwa btab la btso bar bya/ /tshos nas gong bur gyur pa ni/ /gong bu'i dugs zhes bya bar bshad//rlung dang bad kan las gyur na/ /tshil dang smin bur bcas gang yin/ /de la gong bu'i dugs bya nguyin/ /'di ni shin tu bsngags pa yin/ /sman ni phan tshun sbyar ba 'am/ /de bzhin nyi ma me drod kyis/ /gang phyir rdul ni 'byin byed pas/ /de phyir dugs zhes bya bar bshad/ /'di yis lus ni ⑤mnyen byed cing / /'gags pa 'byin par byed pa yin/ /zhu ba'i phyir ni 'byin byed cing / /'thas pa zhu bar byed pa yin/ /skrangs pa zhi bar byed pa dang / /rlung ni bde bar rgyu bar byed/ /nad ni tshar gcod par byed cing / /de bzhin gso ma'i skyegrogs kyang byed/ /smin par bya ba'i nang na ni/ /nang 'jig byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /dper na shing la snum bsgus shing / /dkri zhing bltos ⑦na dbug pa sla/ /de bzhin dus tshigs thams cad du/ /legs par sbyar na lus bde byed/ /'jam dang drag po'i spyor ba ni/ /nad kyi tshod las dpag ste du bya/ /legs par bskus la dugs bya yi⑨/ /rtsub por nam yang dugs mi bya/ /dper na shing ni rlan med par/ /bsros na 'jig par 114—1679

bya—/ /lcags nag las ni rab zlum pa'i/ /rtse mo dgug ①pa'i bzhar spyad bya/ /'dzam bu'i tshi ①gu yu ba 'jam/ /sor ni bco brgyad tshad du bya/ / 'jal da tsheg ①gu 'dra ba la/ /zlum zhing legs pa nyid du bya/ /thur ma sor ni bcu drug pa'o/ /mar me'i rtse ltar zlum pa ni/ /spu bsreg ④pa yi cha spyad 'di/ /beegs las legs par brdung ⑤bar bya/ /lcags de me yi mdog 'dra b.raspyo/ /bsregs pa'i gnas cha shes byas la/ /'dzam thu'i tshi ④gu 'dra ba yi⑧ / /dbyebs ni du mar bsreg par bya/ /tshigs kyi cha yi phyogs su ni/ /dbyibs gang bya ba ni nyon cig /cha bzung bar ni gnas pa las/ /dang por bri ba nyid du 'dod/ /pir ram yang na btsag gam ni/ /sa dkar gyis ni bri bar bya—/ /de nas thur ma bsregs pa yis/ /gnas dar spu ni bsreg par bya/ /skreg par byed tshe tshigs ⑨ las ni/ /gzhan du dbyibs 'di 'gyur srid la/ /de bas me btsa'i khya 7 las la ni/ /dang bor mtshan ma bri bar bya/ /shin tu drang ⑪dang tsha ba yi/ /dus su me yi las mi bya/ /grang ba'i tshe na rtsa rgyus ni/ /rengs shing 'thas par 'gyur ba yin/ /nad 'di 'thas par gyur pa dag /me yi las kyis sel mi nus/ /de nas kṛshāgrang bas nyen gyur rta'i/ /nad mi sel bas de mi bya/ /shin tu tsha tshe khong tsha dang / /rmongs bag mgo 'khor dbugs rgod bskyed/ /sos ka dbyar gyi tshe na ni/ /srog ni nges par zad par byed/ /de bas snga dro'i tshe na ni/ /shin tu grang ⑫min tsha min pa'i/ /me ⑩las tshad tsam byas gyur pa/ /rta yi bde ba skyed ⑩pa yin/ /'dug pa ngal ⑩ni legs bcings la/ /phyogs gcig tu ni skyel bar bya/ /thag pa sra zhing sgom pa yis/ /lag pa gnyis ni bsdam ⑫par bya/ /phyi rkang gnyis kyang bcings 114—1683

gzung ①bya la/ /lag pa g.yon pas bcug nas ni/ /g.yas pa yis ni bcir bar bya/ /rengs na shin tu dal min par/ /rgyun gyis rjes su 'bab par gtang / /lan cig gtang bar bya ba 'am/ /yang na dus ni gnyis su gtang //dus gsum du ni mi gtong zhing / /bag med par ni mi bcir ro/ /rgyab ni bsgu 7ste btang gyur na/ /de las snum ni snyoms par 'gro/ /bde bas nad rnams gsos ③nas ni/ /slar yang bzlog par 'gyur ba yin/ /rlung ni mang du 'byin byed cing / /nad ni slar yang 'jug par byed/ /'jam rtsi btang bar gyur pa la/ /rgyab mnye sen mos 'phrug par bya/ /til mar 'jam rtsi btang gyur na/ /sa zhag gis ni bsku bar 'dod/ /til mar dro zhing thu tsha bas na—/ /rta yi mkhris 5 pa skyed par byed/ /de bas rked pa'i logs ⑥ gnyis su/ /sa zhag gis ni bsku ba bsngags⑦ / /'jam rtsi gtong mebar byed pa na/ /gal te rlung ni zhugs gyur na/ /'jam rtsi dang ni 'dres pa yi/ /nad ni de ru gnas par 'gyur/ /de bas shin tu mi lhod cing dzipho/ /drag tu btsir ⑪bar mi bya'o—/ /'jam rtsi phyed tsam btang ba ⑪na/ /gal te rta ni dbugs stong na/ /sbu ⑫gu myur du dbyung bya zhing / /rlung dgag par ⑫ni mi bya'o/ /rlung de btang bar gyur pa na/ /rta ni mnyam du legs gzhag la/ /de nas snum gyi lhag ma yis / /'jam rtsi gnyis pa gtang 6bar bya/ /gang phyir rjes mthun btang bas nisnye/ /de phyir 'jam rtsi yin par bshad/ /'jam rtsi zung du ma gyur pas / /btang klun tshe dang stobs 'phel byed/ /mkhris pa can la lan gsum gtang / /bad kan can la lnga 'am bdun/ /de bzhin rlung nad can la ni/ /dgu 'am yang na bcu gcig gtang / /nad bu can la ci srid du/ /nad ni zhi 114—1692

bskol—/ /rta yi gso ba thams cad la/ /ba yi mar ni mchog yin no/ /ston skyes til ni nag po la/ /lag pas babyung ba'i til mar yang 'jam rtsi dang ni bsku rmyeb la/ /rta la phan par 'gyur ba bsngags/ /'jam rtsi gtong ba'i dus su ni/ /kha nas gtang bar mi bya'o/ /rta ni skyon med shes byas la /lto ba ran 'grangs ⑤legs gnas la/ /tshad ni legs par brtags nas ni/ /mar byu 'jam rtsi gtang bar bya/ /phyi zhude nyin ni lto stong rjol/ /rta yi zas ni ran par sbyin/ /'grangs zin pa la brtag khyami bya/ /ltogs la 'jam rtsi mi gtong ngo / /gal te rmongs pas btang gyur na/ /mas gtong de las gnod 'byung ste/ /de ni rno bas ma byen par/ /zas ni 'byin par byed pa yin/ /'khru ba skyed kyepar 'gyur ba dang / /de bzhin mi bzad spo ⑦bar 'gyur/ /gang tshe lto stong gyur pa ⑤la/ /'jam rtsi btang bar gyur na ni/ /de yi khong pa stong pas na/ /rta sbangs dang ni ma 'dres par/ /sbar yang don med 'byung 'gyur zhing / /nad kyang skyed kyepar byed pa yin/ /de bas rta sbangs btang gyur cing / /lto ni zas dang bcas pa la ⑨/ /tsha dang kha dang dro ba yis/ /'jam rtsi tshad tsam gtang bar bya/ /'jam rtsi rkub las btang gyur kyang / /cho ga legs na rim gyis ni/ /lus kyi ⑩steng 'og thad ka ru/ /rnam par khyab par byed pa yin/ /mdog dang 7kha dog skyed byed cing / /nad kyang sel bar byed pa yin/ /dbang po gsal zhing dga' ba dang / /lus zungs rnams kyang 'phel byed yin⑫/ /rnge drod skye zhing brtan pa dang / /gcin rtug bde bar 'byung ba yin/ /mngal ni legs par byed pa dang / /lus kyang brtan par byed pa yin/ /'di ni 'jam rtsi btang gyur pa/ /legs par gyur pa'i mtshan nyid 114—1694

abyu ma ti ba su ga① /rtsa ba lnga pa chung ngu ru/ /gnyis pa 'di ni shes par bya / bṛkṣa dang ni sre tres ⑤dang / /mi ①da ri dang sha ri ba/ /a dza rjoshriṅga lcug ma las / /skyes pa lcug ma yin zhes bya/ /bya bra na ga ⑤she ya dang / /ka ra ma ti tri kan ra⑨/ /'di ni rtsa ba las byung ba'i/ /rtsa ba lnga par ⑦bzhi par bshad/ /ku sha 'jag ma 'dam bu dang / /kun dza rū ⑧la dar ba ni/ /'di ni rtsa las byung ba yi/ /rtsa ba lnga pa lnga pa yin/ /ko sha pha la ba ru na/ /shi kru bi ra rta pyaru dang / /rta ru zhes bya lnga pa ni/ /lnga pa'i phyi ma ⑪ drug pa yin/ /sri brtag ⑪ par ni ba la gnyis/ /de bzhin pu na rna ⑫ba gnyis/ /'di ni gcod byed lnga pa ste/ /bdun pa yin par rab tu bshad/ /dur byid tsandan tsi tra ka /sa ra de bzhin shing mngar dang / /ku sha na sa sha ma dang / /be dza yan ti tra ban ti/ /dong ka nim po 'u ti ka /de bzhin ga pur sle tres dang / /de bzhin sapta parte tso5dang / /ma hā 6 nim pa'i 'bras bu dang / /nas dang rgya shug ku lad dang / /'di ni 'jam rtsi'i skyosman sde tshan/ /'di dag thams cad bsdus ⑫nas ni/ /chu bye bzhi nang me chung la/ /legs par btsos pa'i srang brgya ni/ /rta ni mchog gyur pa la gtang / /bar ma rnams dang chung ngu la/ /bzhi bcas phri ba gtang bar bya/ /sman khu de ni blangs nas kyang / /bzhi cha lus kyi bar du bskol/ /yungs kar sha ra putpa dang / /pi pi ling dang bca' lda ⑫/dang / /na le sham dang byi dang ga /sa ra la dang thang shing dang / /sug smel ru rta ha re rku⑫/ /bya bra na kha sha ma dang / /ha ti pi pi leng rtsa ba de bzhin yungs kar ser bo dang / /pu tse shel dang bong nga dang / /de bzhin du ni ga ru rnams/ /chang dang til mar gcin dang ni/ /de bzhin lan tshwa 114—1696

yang / /nad pa spyod lam 'chol ba las/ /nad kyi tshul ni byung gyur pa/ /de ni gso bar sla ba yin/ /gtsag lho7bus bcad dam yug pa na/ /sman pa'i nyes pa las nad gyur/ /de yi bye dbang po ma tshang ba/ /'chi ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin—/ /sman pa ra ro nad bu can/ /de bzhin dub dang tsha bas nyen/ /smyos sam shin tu 'khrug gyur pa'am/ /rmongs pas 'khrul par gyur pa'amakyi ngo tshas 'khyams sam 'dar gyur tam/ /las la the tshom bcas pa dang / /rgan po'am yang na byis pa'am/ /yid mi bde ba'am 'jigs gyur pa/ /dam pa la ni mi brten ④pa'am/ /gang zhig rmongs snyepar gyur pa yi/ /thos pa nyung zhing nga rgyal che/ / bdag nyid gyemi spyod nor la sdang / /glen zhing don tshom ྅yin la mkhas/ /sman pa snagazhan mi bzod cing smod thu/ /yul la brkam ⑫zhing khro la gdug /rtag tu rang gi don la brtson/ /bdag po 'am ni bla ma dang / /de bzhin legs par spyod pa na/ /'dzem pa med cing ngor mi lta/ /ngo tsha dang ni 'jigs pa spangs/ /rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis gso yang / /rgyal po'i mdzod ni stong ⑪bar byed/ /de 'dra'i sman pa nam yang ni/ /rta yi gnas su gnyen mi bya⑩ / /de 'dra'i sman pa drag 11ldan pas/ /rta la mtshon gyis gnod pa skyedakhyeshā/ /tshad las rgyal ba'am shā5gnas nor ba'am/ /steng dang 'og tu gnod ⑩pa 'am/ /phug drags 7pa 'am ma phugs /5 pa/ /rtsa ni blo ngan des mi shes—/ /de bas phug ni drags pa yi /bye / /gnod pa bshad kyis mnyan par gyes—/ /khrag ni phug drags ༄ bye ma byung na/ /dbugs mi bde dang lud pa skyed/ /'dug pa na ni na 'gyur zhing / /yan lag nyams dang brtson chen skyed 0/ /sha snying rma ni 'drul spyob dang / /khong tsha skrangs pa mi bzod skyed/ /spu yang 114—1701

'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /de bas nad dang rus tshigs su/ /byung ba gsum po gsor mi rung / /gsor rung ba ni bshad pa gsum/ /de yi gso ba khye bshad par bya/ /de la yug drags lagyur pa na/ /snum dang dugs kyi cho ga bya//snum ni bzhi pos bskus nas ni/ /khrag ni beer yang bskyed ①par bya/ /khrag 'phel gyur pas dhin ba dang / /tsha bas gdungs par gyur na yang / /'o ma bsil sman khu ba yis/ /bsku zhing yongs su blugs par bya/ /gnas dang kha zas bzang bo dang / /mngar bag dag gis de bsal bya/ /sman khu bsil ba'i 'jam rtsi yang / /sman pas bsgrims ⑤te bya ba yin/ /btsags du pa dang ni sman khu ⑦blugs/ /dus gnyis su ni bya ba yin/ /ji ltar 'ju bar gyur pa'i tshod/ /shes nas 'o ma'i btung ba skyed/ /chu la til mar blud ⑦pa dang / /de bzhin ⑨ljang pa sbyin par bya/ /de yi 'og tu 'di la ni/ /sna sman gye ni las kyang bya/ /shin tu khrag mang byung gyur na/ /gdon bsrung pa yi cho ga'ang bya/ /'o ma'i 'jam rtsi gtang ⑩bya zhing / /de bzhin nas chag kha zas sbyin/ /sman pas 'di la nas thug dang / /nya sha yi ni sha khu sbyin/ /gtsag ⑪bu las byung nad rnams kun/ /sngar ni rnam par bshad pa yin/ /de las bshad pa'i gso ⑫ba ni/ /byas na'ang bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /sha li ho tra'i ⑫grub pa'i gnas bdun ④pa las gtsag ⑫bu las gyur pa'i nad bstan pa'i le'u'o// //sha li ho tra ⑫bde gnas la/ /legs thos kyis ni yang ⑩dris pa/ /brta spyobya'i cho ga ma lus pa/ /don gyis ⑩ yang dag shes par 'tshal 'o ma'i 'jam rtsi'i yon tan dang / /'jam rtsi gzhan yang bstan du gsol/ /bu yis 114—1703

rta yi tshul gyi de nyid shes/ /rta yi bstan bcos la mkhas shing / /rta yi tshe yi rig byed bya/ /rta la phan par rtag dga' ba/ /sha li ho tra bdag nyid thul / /tshangs pa nyi ma me'i gzi can/ /dka' thub kyis ni gtsor tsho7byas la//legs thos the tshom skyes gyur nas/ /de yi rkang gnyis la btud de/ /'dri ba'i tshul ni 'di dag smras/ /spyod kyis rta (sheyi bstan bcos su/ /zug rngu zhu/lus kyi gso ba dang / /de bzhin rte'u'i ④gso ba dang / /mtshon dang bsrung ba'i cho ga dang / /dug gi gso ba nyid dag ni/ /yan lag drug ni legs gsungs na/ /khyed kyis bcud kyis 1len dang ni/ /ro tsar bya ba bka' ma stsalashe / /rta ni khu ba mang gyur na/ /'gros yang rtsol ba che bar 'gyur/ /rang bzhin de dag nyid kyis ni/ /rgod ma rnams la ngoms )7pa med/ /rgyu de nyid kyis blo ldan pa/ /gzhan gyis rta ltar byed ces bshad/ /de bas la lar mi la yang / /rta ltar byed pa nyid ces zer/ /rta yi de nyid mkhyen gyur pa/ /ro tsa bar lduni ci ltar 'gyur/ /bcud kyis len gyi ⑪sbyor ba dang / /de dag gi ni rgyu nyid kyang / /legs ldan blo gros mchog gyur pa/ /khyed las yongs su shes par 'tshal/ /de ṅkultar yongs su dris pa na/ /legs ldan drang srong gis smras pa/ /legs thos 'di yi rgyu yi tshul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs yod pa yikye/ /re zhig rta yi bcud kyis ⑩len/ /thog ma kho nar bshad par bya/ /de ni tshe 'phel blo skyed cing / /skra dkar gnyer ma 'jig byed la/ /dpal ldan mdog dang kha dog skyed/ /na tshod 'jog pa'i dam pa yin/ /dbang po gsal zhing mdangs skyed byed/ /dge zhing tshim la mgyogs par byed/ /de yi rgyud dang bya 114—1714

gnas ni bsel zhing bde ba dang / /'jam zhing dbeen pa byed du gzhug /sman gyi tsodus kyi nyis 'gyur ram/ /yang na de yi sum khu'agyur du/ /'jam rtsi btang ba'i spyor ba ltar/ /rta ni 'bad de bsrung bar bya/ /de ltar legs par spyod pa yis gu/ /rta la bcud len byin gyur na/ /sngar bshad pa yi yon tan dang / /de ltar rīgazhan yang thob par 'gyur/ /rta rnams kyi ni ro tsa ba'i / /cho ga yang dag mnyan par gyis/ /ro tsa ba yi cho ga yi/ /dri ba khyed kyis 5legs par smras/ /ro tsa bar ni byed pa yi/ /rgyu ni 'di tsam nyid yin no/ /rta ni su yang rung ba la/ /ro tsa 'di ni bya ba min/ /sbeg dang rgan dang nyam chung dang / /stobs chung khu ba zad pa dang / /rgod ma dang ni spyor 'dod la/ /ro tsa ba yi cho ga bya/ /de rnams yon tan bcas 'gyur gyi/ /lhag ma rnams la de ltar min/ /khyod la yang dag bshad pa yi/ /yon tan 'di ni rim gyis nyon/ /yid bde shugs ni che ba dang / /spro ba che zhing khu ba mang / /'jug dga' bu skyes 'upa la bzang / /bu ni mang po nyid skyed byed/ /lus drang mdzes shing mdangs ldan pa/ /ro tsa las byung yon tan yin/ /de bas rta 'am gzhan dag la/ /ro tsar bya ba de nyid nyon/ /legs par snum btang sbyangs dzwabyas pa'i/ /khong pa dag 'gyur rta yi ni/ /khu ba legs par 'phel byed pa'i/ /btung ba 'di ni blud par bya/ /'o ma dang ni bi ra ti/ /dzi da ka da ri sha ba/ /ma sha parte ram nye ba/ /adma 3gupta nye'u shing / /muṅga pri tags 9paṇi dang / /sa mad ga dang ma du ka /me dang meshu ga na pa nyid / /tso /—1ra ka dang bcas pa dgalku /bskol ba'i khu ba grang mo ni/ /kha ra dang ni sbrang rtsir bcas/ /lde gu dang sbyar btung ba ni/ /snga dro'i tshe na 114byed1716

steng gi char gnyis 'og khar ①gnyis/ /ri mo rta ni gang la snang / /de ni lo ni bcu bdun na/ /mtshon gyis 'chi ba thob par 'gyur/ —/de lta bu yi ri mo ni/ /gyen du lta ba gang la yod/ /rta de lo ni bco brgyad na/ /khrag nad kyis ni srog zad 'gyur/ /ri mo gyen du lta zhing mnyam/ /snum pa bzhi ni gang la yod//rta de lo ni bcu dgu na/ /gcin 'gag pa yis dus byed 'gyur/ /ri mo nyams shing ring ba ②lnga/ /gang gi mchu ltag mnyam yod pa/ /de yang lo ni nyi shu na/ /mgo nad kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang la rta phyis 'on te nad/ /'dra yod de ni gseb kyi mchog /lo ni nyi shu rtsa gcig na/ /kha nad kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang gi mchu ltag ri mo ni/ / bcud gug pa ni ④yod gyur pa—/ /de ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis na/ /smad dhind kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /mchu ltag lcags kyu ⑤'dras brgyan pa/ /rgyal po la gces dpal yon can/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa gsum na/ /brang tsha ba yis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rus sbal chu srin 'dra gang yod/ /de yang rgyal po'i rjes mthun yin/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi na/ /rna ba'i nad kyis 'chi bar 'gyur/ /rta ni gang gi mchu ltag na/ /padma'am utpal 'dra yod pa/ /bdag po'i nor ni rtag tu bskyed/ /lo legs par yang byed pa yin/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa lnga na/ /gzhong 'dra'i nad kyis dus byed 'gyuraske/ /de ni tha rjoskar bcas yod pa/ /bdag po'i nor dang bud med bskyedadzeeske/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa drug na/ /snum nad kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /ba dan bcas pa gang ⑧la yod/ /bdag po bsten na nor ster ⑨'gyur/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa bdun la/ /sprul gyis bzung ste 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang la mchod sdong 'dra ris yod/ /bdag po mchod sbyin gyis 'byor 'gyur/ /lo ni nyi shu 114—1726

rtsa brgyad na/ /gzer nad 1kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang la ri mo blugs gzar 'dra/ /mchu ltag dbus na nye bar skyes/ /de yi bdag po mchod sbyin byed—/ /sbyin gtong khyertag tu 'gyed par 'gyur/ /lo ni nyi shu rtsa dgu na/ /mgo nad kyis ni dus byed 'gyur/ /g.yung drung ris dang rin chen 'dra/ / dpal gyi shing ngam lha yi shing / /dga' ba 'khyil pa'am phreng ba 'dra/ /①gang gi mchu ltag nyid na snang / /rta mchog de ni bdag po yi/ /dpal ni mchog tu 'phel bar byed/ /bu dang tsha bo ④'phel bar byed/ /bde bar rnam par rgyal bar byed/ /gang la 'di 'dra'i rta yod pa/ /rgyal po de ni rnam rgyal 'gyur/ /bdag po tshim zhing bde ba dang / /nor rnyed pa ni tshim byas nas/ /de ni lo ni sum cu na/ /khong pa'i srin bu'i nad kyis 'chi/ /'khor lo'am rdo rje lta bu'i dbyibs/ /rta gang gi ni mchu ltag gnas ⑤/ /rta de rgyal bo'i bzhon ⑥par 'gyur/ /bdag po ④rtag tu bde skyid byed/ /rgyal pos de ni bzhon ⑪gyur na—/ /dgra yi tshogs ni kun las rgyal/ /rta de sum cu rtsa gcig na/ /nad med par ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /gang la mchu ltag dbus na ni/ /zla ba kham pa'i ⑨nyi 'dra yod/ /rgyal po gang la'ang 'di 'dra yi/ /rta yod de ni 'byor chen yin/ /lo ni sum cu rtsa gnyis na/ /bde bar 'dug bzhin dus byed 'gyur / /gal te ri mo rtsub bam chad/ /dum bu'am ⑩yon po yod gyur na/ /de ni bsngags pa ma yin gyi/ /drang zhing mdangs snum bsngags pa yin/ /de ltar tshe ni shes bya ba/ /nga yis khyod la bshad pa yin/ /de dag shes kyang brjod mi bya/ /brjod na nyes par 'gyur ba mi ⑪yin/ /nyo ba dang ni 'tshong ba dang / /gso dpyad tshe yang brjod mi bya/ /sha li ho tra'i mdo'i gsang ba'i 114—1727

gnas brgyad pa las/ ri mo las na tshod dang tshe brtag pa'i le'u'o// //nad ni shin tu mi bzad pas/ /rta rnams zad par gyur pa na/ /gzhi spyinas brlag par 'gyur ba yis(sno/ /bzhon pa'i bde 1las nyams par 'gyur/ /de tshe rgyal po skam po rtswa④/ /gan da ra dang ma tra ka /sen ⑤du so pi ⑥ ra dang ni/ /lho phyogs pa yi gtso bo sogs/ /rgyal po dang ni gling bar pa'i /mi rnams gang dag yin pa dang / / yul gyi 3 skye bo thams cad kyang / /rta yi 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas nyen/ /sha li ho tra drang srong che/ /de yi lduganas su nye bar lhags/ /nyi ma lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ /de la dul bas phyag byas nas/ /rta yi tshul la brten nas ni/ /thams cad kyis ni dris pa lakye/ /sna tshogs nad kyis nyen gyur pa/ /rta rnams shin tu ma rung 'gyur⑫/ /srog dang bral gyur nye ba na/ /de rnams kyi ni skyabs khyed lags/ /khyed ni rta yi de nyid mkhyen / /ci nas de dag 'tsho gyur pa/ /de dag spyod kyis bstan par mdzod//de nas sha li ho tra yis/ /mi dbang 'khor bcas la smras pa/ /sems ni sdug bsngal gyis gdungs shing ⑪/ /'jig rten 'di nas log nas ni/ /'jig rten gzhan du 'gro gyur pa/ /srog sbyin pa yi thabs med do/ /de yi srog ni shes bya dang / /'chi 'dod pa ni shes bya dag /shes la goms pa'i mig ldan las/ /sman pa yis ni shes par bya/ /blo med bstan bcos mi shes pas/ /gso bar nus pa ma yin no/ /gang zhig dus la bab ⑫gyur pa/ /de la sman par byar 11med de/ /sems can kun la 'chi ba ni/ /bcos su med pa mdun ⑪na bstod/ /sems can kun kyi dus min 'chi/ /nad las byung bar gyur pa ni//114—1728

sman dang sbyor ba rnams dang ni/ /sngags rnams kyis kyang bzlog par bya/ /gang zhig sngon gyi las kyis ni/ /tshe ni nges par zad gyur pa/ /de la lha sogs bcas pas kyang / /bzlog par nus pa ma yin no/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba bzlog pa dang / /nad rnams bsal bar bya ba la/ /tshe yi rig byed yan lag brgyad / /rtag tu nus dang ldan par bshad/ /nad rnams zhi bar byed pa dang / /de bzhin tshor ba gsal gyur pa/ /'di dag sman pa'i las yin gyi/ /tshe yi bdag po sman pa yin①/ /'chi ltas kyis ni zil gnon pa/ /'chi bar 'gyur gyis srog yod min/ /'chi ltas med par gyur na ni/ /de la 'chi ba yod ma yin/ /gang tshe dus la bab pa na/ /de tshe 'chi ltas mang du 'byung / /dus ni go bzlog gyur pa dang / /rgyal po'i skyes skar mi 'phrod dang / /sngon gye las kyi nyes pa 'am/ /de bzhin rgyal po'i sdig spyod las/ /log par spyod par gyur pa las/ / ltos nas ②mang du 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'chi ltas kyi ni mtshan nyid dang / /nad ni sna tshogs de las 'byung / /mi bzad rgyatshul can du ma ni/ /srog ni 'jig par byed pa ④'byung / /de tshe gso ba sngags khyabacas pas/ /don ni ci bzhin byed mi nus/ /sman rnams kyis kyang nad kyi tshogs / /legs par sel bar byed mi nus/ /de tshe lha tshogs mchod pa dang / /sdom pa gnas dang zhi ba'i las/ /sngags dang sbyin sreg gtor ma yis/ /nad kyi dutshogs rnams zhi bar bya/ /yams kyi nad ni zhi bya'i phyir/ /sngar bshad pa yi zhi ba'i las/ /byas pas srung ⑦zhing 'tshe ba bsal/ /des ni sna tshogs nad gzhi 'gyur/ /sman pas gang zhig mthong gyur na/ /rta ni nges par brlag 'gyur ba'i/ /tshe zad pa yi rtags dang ni/ /mtshan ma yang dag bshad par bya//114—1729

mthong mi nus/ /mig ni dmar zhing 'tshubs ①par byed/ /gcin ni khrag 'dra 'byung 'gyur la/ /sems khong ②chud par gyur pa dag /de 'dra 'tsho bar 'gyur ma yin/ /gang gi mig ni ser gyur cing ①/ /'khrul pa'i mig gis lta ba 'am/ /rkang pa la ni rtog byed pa/ /rta de'ang 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin/ /gang gi mig ni dmar gyur cing / /dkar po'i cha ni mi mngon la/ /rab tu g.yogs par gyur pa gang / /de yang myur du ma rung ④'gyur/ /'gro ba'i tshe na rnam par 'khyor/ /rkang pa 'dzugs rjopar mi nus shing / /'tshe'u tshe 'khums par byed pa dang / /gnye'u rengs gyur pa dhide mi 'tsho/ /rtsib ⑦logs dag ni re re yis/ /yang dang yang du 'gre byed cing / /gsus che mchu 'phyang lce nag pa⑧/ /'gro bar byed pas de mi 'tsho/ /'gro bzhin du ni phyi ba dang / /dku la yang dang yang du lta⑨/ /kha nas btung ⑩bar gyur pa rnams/ /sna nas 'byung bar byed pa dang / /mig gis mthong bar mi nus shing / /rna ba dag kyang rengs gyur pa/ /de ni 'chi ba dang 'dra bas/ /sman gyi sbyor ba ⑪mi bya'o—/ /gang zhig rlung 'khyel drag tu sbo/ /yang dang yang du drag tu 'khru/ /'khru ba ring du 'byen byed cing / /'khrus nas slar yang sbo ba dang / /gcin dang rtug pa zad gyur kyang / /rtsa ⑫ni za bar mi byed pa/ /de yang 'chi ba dang 'dra bas/ /sman gyi sbyor ba ⑫mi bya'o/ /gang gi ④rngog ma mthor ⑫gyur cing / /dkur ⑩ni lta bar byed pa dang / /lce rkan ⑩kha dang mchu gnag cing / /'gram pa 'thas spyopar gyur pa dang / /pags pa spu dang lus dri nga spyo/ /'jig rten pha rol 'gror shes bya/ / kha'i tshong 'dra ma ⑫sha rul pa'am/ /mda' sgro bsregs pa lta bu 0yi/ /rta ⑫ni gang la yod gyur pa/ /de yang 'chi bar shes 114—1731

yang yang rkyong lha/ /'dar zhing mig ni dmar ba dang / /lus phyi yan lag rengs gyur pa/ /de yang 'chi bar 'gyur zhes bya/ /gang gi bu ga'i sgo skya zhing / /mchu ltag skrangs par gyur pa dang / /mig ni thur du 'gebs shing 'gro/ /spu ni shin tu gshor gyur pa/ /yid mi bde bas ring 1/du 'dug /phrag so'i steng ni skam por snang / /gnye'u rengs kyis kyang btab gyur pa/ /rta de'ang 'tsho bar 'gyur ma yin/ /rtsol ba chung zhing chu nyung 'thung / /zas kyang za bar mi byed kyang / /rta sbangs gcin ni mang gyur pa/ /de yang ro dang 'dra shes bya/ /gang zhig tshul ni 'di 'dra ba'i/ /'chi ltas snang bar gyur pa na/ /de yang legs par snang khyagyur na/ /gzhan du 'gyur ba de ma yin/ /nad pa gang dag lus 'jam zhing / /mdog dang spyod pa mang gyur krul/ /mig dang spyod pa skyon med snang ⑤/ /thams cad du yang spyod pa yang / / dro grang 'udus ni ci bzhin shes/ /gcin rtug kluganod pa med par 'byung / /sa la 'gre bar gyur nas ni/ /slar yang chur 'jug par mi byed/ /sman gyi sbyor ba byas pa na//phan dang gnod pa'i khyad par snang / /de ni gso ba'i las rnams la/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu yod pa yin/ /de ltar gsor rung gsor mi rung / /shes nas gso ba'i las rnams brtsam/ /de ltar shes nas gang spyod pa/ /sman pa des ni las grub 'gyur/ /gso ba'i bya ba byas kyang ni/ / 'chos par khyami 'gyur 'chi 'dod pa/ /de la sman kyi sbyor ba ni/ /yon tan skyed par 'gyur ba 'uyin/ /'chi ltas kyi ni mtshan nyid 'di/ /yon tan med la sbyin mi bya/ /bu dang slob ma yon tan gyi/ /snod ldan rnams la sbyin par bya/ /'chi ltas byung ba gsang ba ni / /nam yang su la'ang brjod mi bya/ /sha li ho tra'i ⑫gnas te brgyad pa 114—1733

dang / /sha li ho tras slar smras pa/ /'di ni rta yi pho nya yihūṃ/ /mtshan nyid nga yis bshad par bya/ /nad pa'am zhum pa'am rtags can nam/ /yang na gos ni dri ma can/ /sdang dang gdug pa'i las can dag /pho nyar 'ongs pa mthong gyur na/ /sman pa mchog gis na ba yi2/ /rta de 'chi bar shes par bya/ /nad pa'i don du pho nya ni/ /rta dang rnga mo mi la ni/ /zhon te 'ongs par mthong gyur na/ /rta de 'chi bar shes par bya/ /pho nyar bud med 'ongs pa 'am—/ / mgo reg skra bcings 1ral pa can/ /gos ni rdul can gyon pa 'am/ /yang na nag gam rnyog can gyon/ /mthong na sman pas rta gso'i phyir/ /der ni 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /gang zhig gos dmar rlog (thupa yis/ /lus ni kun nas dkris gyur cing / /sman pas dris par 'gyur ba ⑤na/ /med ces bya ba'i tshig smra dang / /so 'dar ba dang de bzhin du/ /sen mo phan tshun 'dar byed la / /skra dang kha sru rgyu 'umed par/ /shin tu sprug 1snacing nyed byed pa'i/ /pho nya 'ongs par mthong gyur na/ /sman pa der ni 'gro mi bya/ /rtswa dang shing dang rdo ba dag /gcod dam gcod ༄8snapar byed pa 'am/ /yang na bcog cing nyed pa 'am/ /skra dang thal ba 'thor byed pa/ /de lta bu yi tshul ston pa/ /yongs su spang bar bya ba yin/ /thal ba phyag dar sol phub dang / /gyo mo bdar ⑨ bar byed bzhin du/ /pho nya 'ongs par gyur na ni/ /des rmyeni don ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /skyes bu lag na 'khar thogs pa/ /khros pa'am shin tu zhum pa yi7/ /yang na mig ni mchi mas khengs/ /gos dang phreng ba dmar po thogs / /gang gi pho nya 'di 'dra ba/ /rta ni de ru 'tsho mi 'gyur/ / rna bcad ⑩ yan lag nyams pa dang / /yang na cung zad tshig ⑫ gyur pa/ /kha nas 114—1737

g.yer ma shing kun a ru ra/ /ma nu dang ni lan tshwa brgyad/ /nas bskol khyekhu ba dang sbyar sbyin/ /nad gzhi gsum skyes gzer rnams 'joms/ /gnas brgyad pa las gzer 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i phye ma'o// //pi tsu mar da tso7pa to la/ / kaṇḍa ka ri bṛ ha tishe/ /sle tres dang ni 'bras bu gsum/ /g.yer ma chu dang lhan cig bskol/ /de bcags ④pa yi khu bar ni/ /mud ga legs par btso byebar bya/ /de ni legs par tshos pa dang / /thab ༅nas slar yang phog 7nas ni/ /der ni tsha ba gsum po dang / /lan tshwa dag kyang tshad tsam gzhug /mar dang til mar zhag sbrang rtsi/ /de dag thams cad gcig tu bsre/ /tsha yi phye ma dag dang ni/ /mud ga'i khu ba sbyar bar bya/ /de nas tsha ba'i kha zas te/ /nya chol cho ga bzhin du sbyin/ /des kyeni bad rlung sel byed cing / /lud pa dbugs mi bde ba 'joms/ /snying nad zhi bar byed pa dang / /skrangs pa dag kyang sel bar byed/ / 'go ba'i lku nad dang rna 11nad rnams/ /nges par sel bar byed pa yin/ /sgog nad rnam par spyong byed cing / /mchog tu me drod nyams la phan/ /gnas brgyad pa skyolas tsha ba'i phye ma dang bsres pa zhes bya ba ste phye ma'i le'u'o// //til mar de bzhin mar cha mnyam/ /zhag dang rkang ni ci rnyed dang / /de bzhin sgyur yang ci rnyed dang / /'dir ni zho ni bzhi 'gyur gzhug /der ni sman ni 'di dag rnams/ /lde gu /5btags pa gzhug rngupar bya/ /shu dag ra ⑫sna shing mngar dang / /'tsho byed dang ni dzi ban ti/ /a shu ma ti 'di 1bye 114—1748

'brum bu 'brum phran de bzhin shu ba ni/ /sel zhing rta yi mdog dang stobs ni skyed / /nad kyi tshogs 'joms bdud rtsi dang 'dra yin/ /sha li ho tra'i gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las bdud rtsi lta bu'i khyesman mar ro// //ka ran dza 1dang ba sha ka / sgo ra 3khyem gyi dud pa dang / /ka pid tha dang dong ga 4dang / /yug snam dang ni padma dang / /ka ra bī ra bong ⑤ nga dang / /ro hi ta kyedang sle tres dang / /dṛ /naha ti yi 'bras bu ni/ /ra thug gi ni gcin dang btags/ /'di dag srang gnyis sbyar ba la/ /mar srang sum cu rtsa gnyis bskol/ /mar dang mnyam pa'i 'o ma gzhug /bskol ba'i sman mar stobs chen yin/ /mdze yi nad ni thams cad la/ /rtag tu bskus dang blud na phan/ /sha tshil rus pa skyed byed cing / /pags par zhugs pa'i khrag spyong byed/ /mdze nad 'dzag par byed pa yang cho/ /thams cad zhi bar byed pa yin / /legs ldan sha li ho tra yis/ /de skad rjes 4/bstan smras pa yin/ /sha li ho tra'i gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las ka ran dza chol sogs pa'i sman mar ro / /sman mar 11gyi le'u'o// //de nas gzhan yang til mar gyi/ /le'u nges par bshad bya ste/ / pra sa shābyer ni srang brgya ni/ /chu bye bcu drug nang du bskol/ /bzhi cha lus par gyur pa namu / /khu ba de ni thab las mudabog /sman khu de dang mnyam pa yi/ /til mar nye bar gzhug par bya/ /kañdzi rang sgyur nyis 'gyur gzhug /de la sman wani 'di dag gi/ /sde gu nye bar gzhug par bya/ /ra sna ba la gze ma dang / /114—1756

dang / /me da tsakra hwa gan dang / /e raṇḍa'i ⑨rtsa dzi ban ti/ /ru rta byeshu dag sa ha tsar/ /po son cha ni bzang po dang / /de bzhin mang du sra ba dang / / sa bon zu dza na ser po gnyis/ /a shwa gadzha ha pu 5sha /ba ma seng phrom mi chorkang dang / /gre ya se ni cha mnyam gzhug /'di ni bsku dang sna sman dang / /btung dang 'jam rtsi dag la gtang / /rlung gi nad ni thams cad dang / /de bzhin gyegazhan kun sel bar mebyed/ /smyo dang 'byung po brjed byed dang / /de bzhin gdon nad sna tshogs dang / / zha bo ⑤me dbal gyis jebs la/ /til mar bsten na rmye bde thob 'gyur/ /skam dang rus pa'i nad rnams la/ /til mar 'di ni gtang bar bya/ /rgod ma bu ni mi chags ⑪pa/ /'di blud na ni bu chags ⑪'gyur/ /rgod ma dang ni rta pho yi/ /rlung nad brgyad cu sel bar byed/ /gnyer ma 'dus shing na tshod rgas/ /slar yang lang tsho thob par 'gyur/ /pra ⑫sa ra yi til mar 'di / /rta la phan byed mchog tu bshad/ /tshe dang stobs ni skyed byed cing / /dran pa ⑫ sems gsal dpal skyed byed/ /rgyus che pa chad dang rtsa chad la/ /til mar 'di yis sna sman gtang / /sha li ho tra'i gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las pra sa ra'i til mar gnyis pa'o// //sle tres chu yi nang bskol la/ /khu ba bzhi cha'i til mar gzhug /'o ma de dang mnyam bcug la/ /sman 'di dag gi lde gu gzhug /pi pi ling rtsa tsha ba gsum/ /tsi tra ha nyi pi bee ling / /shu dag ru rta byi dang gaspyo /skyer pa dang ni lce myang tsha/ /pra sa ra ni ba la dang / /ra sna gze ma ha pus ⑩pa/ /114—1758

chal gyis sel ltar/ /de bzhin mas gtong ni ru ha/ /phra ba'i lam nas zhugs gyur pas/ /mgo nas rkang pa'i bar kyi ni/ /nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin①/ /sha li ho tra'i gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las mas gtong ba'i las kyi yon tan bstan pa'o // //②sna sman gtong ba'i sbu gu ni/ /sor bcu ru ni bya bar bshad/ /yang na steng nas blugs dzeebya ste/ /de yang ras bal nyid la gzag④ /snga dro lto stong gyur pa yi/ /rta yi lus ni drang por gzhag /'phral du blugs ⑤kyis rgyun du min—/ /dbugs dbyung tshe na spyad par bya/ /sna sman gtong ba rtsol ba dang / /chu 'thungs pa las bsrung bar bya/ /gsang ba'i gnas las sna sman btang ba'i ཿdza ba/ma // // duru rta yung ba pi pi ling / /bca' lda shing kun ⑦skyer khaṇa dang / /pri yang ku dang ra sna ni/ /lhan cig sbyar te btags par bya/ /sman khu de la ra sna ni/ /bzhi cha slar yang gzhag par bya/ /sna sman 'di ni gnye'u rengs dang / /rna ④rtse'i nad la gtang bar bya/ /de ni 'jeng dang brang kha na/ /'gram pa dang ni brla rengs dang / /rlung dang bad kan las gyur pa'i/ /nad kun sel bar byed pa yin/ /gsang ba'i gnas las ⑨ru rta la sogs pa'i sna sman no // //⑩ bu ram bca' bee'i ⑪ra ba 'am/ /pi pi ling dang rgyam tshar sbyar/ /sna 114—1766

sman btang na 'gram pa snad/ /dpung pa mgo bo'i lkund rnams dang / /gog nad dang ni rna ba'i nad/ /rgyab rengs sel bar byed pa yin/ /gsang ba'i gnas las bca' bee zhul sogs pa'i sna sman no// //rngupi pi ling dang bca' bee ngudang / /rgyam tsha dṛ ha ti'i khru'abras bu/ /ba gcin dang ni sbyar ba dag /sna sman du ni gtang bar bya/ /sna sman 'di yis rengs pa'i nad/ /cung zad rnying 67par 'gyur ba yin/ /gsang ba'i gnas las pi pi ling la sogs pa'i sna sman no // //(pebṛ ha nyi yi rngo — 'bras bu ni/ /chu dang bcas pa zhib tu btags/ /sna sman sbyar bar btang gyur na/ /ni ra na ka'i nad sel 'gyur/ /gsang ba'i gnas las dṛ ha ti'i ⑨'bras bu la sogs pa'i sna sman no // //⑪shri sha ni dang dzi ban ti/ /shu dag ra sna thang shing dang / /a ra sha dang bcas pa ni/ /ba gcin gyi ni nang du bskol/ /rlung las gyur pa'i nad brgyad cu/ /sel bar byed par the tshom med/ /gsang ba'i gnas las shri sha la sogs pa'i sna sman gyi le'u'o // //nyunye.a shwa ganta shu dag dang / / nye'u shing biru rta thang shing dang / /a ba dang ni a pu ⑫sha /sen ngu skeb ra ser po gnyis/ /chu yi nang du ⑫bskol nas ni/ /bzhi cha lus par gyur pa ni/ /rlung nad can gyi rta rnams la/ /mas gtong ba yi 114—1767

yi ni yon tan rnams/ /bshad kyis de ni mnyan par gyes/ /rgyam tsha rta la phan pa'i mchog /rlung dang bad kan sel bar byed/ /de yis snying nad ma zhu ba'i/ /nad rnams sel bar byed pa yin/ /rta rnams gyond med par 'gyur zhing / /rnga rngog kyang ni legs par skye/ / me drod bri bar mi 'gyur zhing / /khyepho ba'i nad rnams 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zos pa myur du 'ju 'gyur zhing / /bde ba kho nar smin par byed/ /lan tshwas rta yi gcin rtug dag /bde ba kho nar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lan tshwa rta yi tshe yin pasarngu / /dus ni rtag tu bsngags pa yin/ /sman pas dgun stod dgun smad tshe/ /lan tshwa snga dro sbyin par bya/ /dpyid dang sos ka dbyar dang ston/ /phyi dro'i dus su sbyin par bya/ /rta ni mchog tu gyur pa la/ /lan tshwa srang drug sbyin par bya/ /bar ma la ni srang bzhi sbyin/ /chung ba la ni srang gsum sbyin/ /dbyar gyi tshe na lan tshwa ni/ /nim pa'i lo ma dang sbyar sbyin/ /dgun gyi tshe ni dgu thi ④yi/ /lo ma dang bcas sbyin par bya/ /pa to la yi lo mar bcas/ /dgun smad dang ni dpyid dus sbyin/ /sos ka dang ni ston gyi tshe/ /mar dang sbyar ba sbyin par bya/ /lan tshwa yi ni spyor 5ba 'di/ /bu la nga yis skyebashad pa yin/ /sha li ho tra'i gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las lan dza' cho ga'o// //thutshangs pa drag po khyab 'jug ni/ /bad kan mkhris pa rlung dag can/ /phan tshun bsten 8par byed pa dang / /gcig la gcig ni ma 'dres gnas/ /de la tshangs pa bad kan te/ /drag po mkhris pa yin par bshad/ /khyab 'jug rlung gi bdag nyid can/ /de ltar tshul ni rnam gsum yin/ /sa la 114—1772

mngon du 'phrog byed a ru ra/ /skyur bas rlung ni sel bar byed/ /mngar dang kha bas mkhris pa sel/ /tshwa ①dang bska bas bad kan sel/ /de bas nyes gsum 'joms zhes bshad/ /rta la ci dultar sbyin bya ba/ /de yi nyes pa nyan gepar gyis/ /ba gcin nang du zla ba gcig /a ru ra ni gzhag par bya/ /dang po'i zhag ni rdog ma lnga/ /gnyis pa la ni bcu sbyin bya/ /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig bar/ /lnga lnga yis ni bskyed par bya④/ /nim pa yi ni khu ba dang / /seng ldeng khu ba dang btags la/ /lcags kyi snod nang du ⑤bcug ste/ /mtshan mo bkab ste dben par gzhag /lde gu btags pa'i tshad gang yin/ /snum gyi tshad kyang de tsam du/ /sman pa mchog gis sbyin bya yi⑥ / /snum mang ⑦skyon ni yod shes bya/ /shu ba g.yan pa 'brum bu dang / /mdze dang ldurkang shu 'bras dang ni/ /nad ni rkang la zhugs pa dang / /gzhang 'brum dang ni sha bkra dang / /de bzhin rta yi rkang pa'i nad/ /a ru ra yis sel bar byed/ /dbyar tshe rgyam tsha dang bcas sbyin/ /ston ni kha ra a ru ra/ /dgun ni bca' lda ⑨dang bcas pa—/ /dgun smad kha ru tsha dang bcas/ /sbrang rtsi dang sbyar dpyid tshe sbyin/ /sos ka bu ram sbyar ba sbyin/ /de 'dras me yis shing bsregs lkultar/ /nad kyi tshogs rnams zad par byed/ /gnad dang rus pa tshigs rnams ⑪dang / /drug mdo dang ni gnas pa'i nad/ /rlung mkhris las ni gyur pa dang / /de bzhin bad kan las gyur dang / /khrag dang gyur las rmyeyan lag gi/ /nad ni sna tshogs gnas pa sel/ /blo dang stobs dang ⑫dbang po yi/ /tshogs kyi kha ni 'byed kṛrtepa yin/ /rlung dang mkhris pa bad kan gyi/ /nad rnams kha ni 'dzums par byed/ /gcin dang de bzhin rtug pa dang / /dri ma rnams ni 114—1775

shar phyogs su ni kha bstan gzhag /g.yas su bskor zhing bkra shis dang / /shis par brjod pa legs par bya/ /de yi kyerna ba g.yas par byeni/ /sngags kyi tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /khyod ni dri za'i rigs su skyes/ /rigs sun par ni ma byed cing / /khyod gyeni dngul las byung gyur cing / /dpal mo'i lag tu gnas na 'phel/ /me yi bu nyid khyod dran byos/ /ko tu ba yi ④nor bu'ang dranasnye / /'o ma'i mtsho las bdud rtsi'i phyir/ /lha dang lha min gyis bsrubs tshe/ /dang po u tsa sra ba byung / /de las khyod ⑥skyes dran par gyis/ /shugs mchog ston de nga yis ni/ /dgra dpung ma lus las rgyal gyis/ /tshangs pa dang ni zla ba dang / /chu lha yi ni bden tshig dang / /nyi ma yi ni gzi brjid dang / /de bzhin drang srong dka' thub dang / /stobs bzang gi ni tshangs spyod dang / /de bzhin rlung gi shugs nyid dang / /me nyid kyi ni nus mthu yis/ /rta khyod rgyal ba skyed gyur cing khye/ /'thab pa'i tshe na rta khyod kyisaskye/ /gal te log par 'gro 'gyur na/ /bram ze pha ma gsod 'dra yi/ /nyes de khyod kyis 'thob kyepar 'gyur / /gal te g.yul las rgyal gyur na/ /bdag po 6bde ba nyid skyed byed/ /o na ma/ ā di da kyetya ya u pa ya ga ga ga swā hā/ /rta yi rna ba g.yas par ni//'thab pa'i tshe na brjod gyur na/ /skye ba dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /don med nyid du 'gyur ma yin/ /de 'dra'i stobs dang snying stobs ldan/ /rta dang sbyar ba'i shing rtar zhugs/ /go bgos mtshon char ldan brtson pa/ /yul 'khor 'jigs pa las bskyab rkyebya/ /sha li ho tra'i ⑫gsang ba'i gnas te brgyad pa las shing rta dang skresbyar ba'i cho ga'o // //8 174—1784
